zh.tag: 自改进的递归语言模型编程代理，支持长期自主任务
zh.what: Prime Agent 是一个开源的编码与研究代理，专为通用和长期运行的工作设计。它基于递归语言模型（RLM）和持续工作台（Continual Harness）两大核心抽象，将上下文视为变量，工具视为函数调用，在持久的 REPL 环境中运行。代理结合了持久化的 Python 控制环境和可持久化的工作台状态，使得有用的工作上下文和可复用的操作模式能够超越单个聊天窗口而存在。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心代理实现、文档（packages/coding-agent/docs）、CI 配置和构建脚本。代理支持程序化的一切操作，包括内置的持久化 IPython 工具、子代理调用（rlm(...)）、技能系统（可导入的 Python 包）以及后台守护进程。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 Python 环境（IPython）作为模型工具，并与 verifiers、PRIME-RL 等 Prime Intellect 生态组件集成。
zh.hot: 今日新增 2293 星，总星数达 6510，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第一。其自改进的 RLM 架构和长期自主任务能力吸引了大量开发者关注，尤其是对 AI 代理工具链感兴趣的人群。
uses: 开发者：用于编码工作流自动化，如代码生成、重构和测试，可长期后台运行。
研究人员：作为研究代理，执行需要多步骤推理和工具调用的复杂任务。
AI 工程师：探索 RLM 和持续学习机制，构建自改进的代理系统。
团队协作：通过技能系统共享可复用的工作流，提升团队效率。

en.tag: A self-improving RLM agent for coding workflows and long-running autonomous tasks.
en.what: Prime Agent is an open-source coding and research agent designed for general and long-running work. It is built around two core abstractions: the Recursive Language Model (RLM) treats context as variables and tools as function calls within a persistent REPL, and the Continual Harness stores supplemental prompts, memories, and skills as durable state. By combining a persistent Python control environment with durable harness state, it enables useful context and reusable patterns to outlive a single chat session.
en.content: The repository contains the core agent implementation, documentation (packages/coding-agent/docs), CI configuration, and build scripts. The agent supports programmatic everything, including a persistent IPython tool, subagent calls via rlm(...), a skill system with importable Python packages, and background daemon sessions.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, it relies on a Python environment (IPython) as the model tool and integrates with Prime Intellect ecosystem components like verifiers and PRIME-RL.
en.hot: With 2,293 stars added today and a total of 6,510, it ranks #1 on GitHub Trending daily. Its self-improving RLM architecture and capability for long-running autonomous tasks have attracted significant attention from developers interested in AI agent toolchains.
uses: Developers: Automate coding workflows like code generation, refactoring, and testing, with long-running background execution.
Researchers: Use as a research agent for complex tasks requiring multi-step reasoning and tool use.
AI engineers: Explore RLM and continual learning mechanisms to build self-improving agent systems.
Teams: Share reusable workflows via the skill system to boost productivity.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理打包资深工程师工作流与质量门禁
zh.what: 这个仓库提供一套生产级工程技能，将资深工程师的流程、质量门禁和最佳实践编码为 AI 代理可遵循的规范。它通过斜杠命令和自动触发，覆盖从规格定义到发布的完整开发生命周期。

zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上获得 8.3 万星标，今日新增 593，位居趋势榜第二。它解决了 AI 编码代理缺乏工程纪律的痛点，将资深工程师的经验系统化，受到开发者广泛关注。
uses: 使用 AI 编码代理进行开发的工程师，希望提升代码质量和一致性
团队想将内部最佳实践标准化并让代理自动遵循
对 AI 辅助开发流程感兴趣的技术管理者或架构师

zh.tag: 给 AI 代理一个虚拟文件系统与执行环境
zh.what: Cloudflare Computer 是一个位于 Durable Object 内的虚拟文件系统，为 AI 代理提供可插拔的执行环境。它通过 workspace.runtime.exec 作为统一入口，支持容器、隔离 shell 和隔离 JavaScript 三种后端。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心包 @cloudflare/computer、文档（docs/）、示例（examples/）以及贡献指南。示例展示了容器、worker-shell 和 worker-javascript 三种用法。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Cloudflare Durable Objects、SQLite、Workers RPC、capnweb 协议，以及 just-bash 和 ECMAScript 模块。
zh.hot: 今日新增 2802 星，总星数 4891，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 3。它展示了在边缘运行 AI 代理的新范式，引发开发者关注。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为代理提供文件系统与执行环境，构建可交互的代理应用
边缘计算爱好者：探索在 Cloudflare Workers 上运行容器和隔离环境的可能性
原型验证：适合实验和探索，不适合生产环境

en.tag: Give your agent a virtual filesystem and execution environment
en.what: Cloudflare Computer is a virtual filesystem living inside a Durable Object, providing a pluggable execution surface for AI agents. It exposes a single entry point via workspace.runtime.exec, with three backends: container, isolate shell, and isolate JavaScript.
en.content: The repo contains the core package @cloudflare/computer, docs/, examples/, and contribution guides. Examples demonstrate container, worker-shell, and worker-javascript usage.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, leveraging Cloudflare Durable Objects, SQLite, Workers RPC, capnweb protocol, and just-bash or ECMAScript modules.
en.hot: Gained 2802 stars today, reaching 4891 total, ranking #3 on GitHub Trending. It showcases a new paradigm for running AI agents at the edge, sparking developer interest.
uses: AI agent developers: provide agents with a filesystem and execution environment to build interactive agent apps
Edge computing enthusiasts: explore running containers and isolates on Cloudflare Workers
Prototyping: suitable for experiments and exploration, not for production

zh.tag: 开源身份认证与单点登录平台
zh.what: authentik 是一个开源的身份提供商（IdP），为现代应用提供单点登录（SSO）功能。它支持 SAML、OAuth2/OIDC、LDAP、RADIUS 等多种协议，适用于从个人实验室到大型生产集群的自托管场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 authentik 的核心服务、Outpost（用于代理和认证的组件）以及 Web 前端。提供 Docker Compose、Kubernetes Helm Chart、AWS CloudFormation 和 DigitalOcean Marketplace 等多种部署方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，后端基于 Django，前端使用 Web 技术（如 JavaScript/TypeScript）。依赖 PostgreSQL、Redis 等常见基础设施组件。
zh.hot: 作为开源替代 Okta、Auth0 等商业 IdP 的方案，authentik 在自托管社区中广受欢迎。今日新增 138 星，总星数达 23168，位列 GitHub 趋势榜第五。

中小企业：需要替代昂贵商业 IdP 的可靠身份管理方案。
开发者：需要为应用集成 SSO 或统一认证流程的开发者。
DevOps 工程师：在 Kubernetes 或云环境中部署和管理身份服务。

en.tag: Open-source identity provider and SSO solution
en.what: authentik is an open-source Identity Provider (IdP) that provides single sign-on (SSO) for modern applications. It supports protocols like SAML, OAuth2/OIDC, LDAP, RADIUS, and more, designed for self-hosting from small labs to large production clusters.
en.content: The repository contains the core server, outposts (for proxy and authentication), and web frontend. Deployment options include Docker Compose, Kubernetes Helm, AWS CloudFormation, and DigitalOcean Marketplace.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python, with backend based on Django and frontend using web technologies (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript). It relies on common infrastructure components like PostgreSQL and Redis.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to commercial IdPs like Okta and Auth0, authentik is popular in the self-hosting community. With 138 stars today and 23,168 total, it ranks #5 on GitHub Trending.
uses: Self-hosting enthusiasts: individuals or teams wanting full control over their identity infrastructure.
SMBs: seeking a reliable identity management solution to replace costly commercial IdPs.
Developers: needing to integrate SSO or unify authentication flows in their applications.
DevOps engineers: deploying and managing identity services in Kubernetes or cloud environments.

zh.tag: AI 代理的图原生基础设施，开源版 Palantir

zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Python 库、CLI 工具、文档、示例和配置文件，支持 RDF 和 LPG 图存储，遵循 W3C 标准，并提供本体管理和知识建模功能。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.8+，采用多语言图存储，支持 RDF 和 LPG，集成 W3C 标准，并可能依赖图数据库和推理引擎。
zh.hot: 作为开源版 Palantir，它填补了 AI 代理在可问责性和决策溯源方面的空白，吸引了大量关注，今日新增 122 星，总星数达 2345。
uses: 企业数据团队：构建可解释的 AI 决策系统，满足合规要求

AI 安全研究者：研究 AI 系统的可追溯性和因果推理

en.tag: Graph-native infrastructure for AI agents, open-source Palantir
en.what: Semantica is graph-native infrastructure for building context-aware and accountable AI systems. It ingests enterprise data, extracts what matters, builds a Context Graph and knowledge graph, and runs graph analytics and causal reasoning over it, with full decision provenance baked in for explainability, traceability, and trustworthiness.
en.content: The repository includes the core Python library, CLI tools, documentation, examples, and configuration files, supporting RDF and LPG graph storage, adhering to W3C standards, and offering ontology management and knowledge modeling.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.8+, with polyglot graph storage supporting RDF and LPG, integrating W3C standards, and likely leveraging graph databases and reasoning engines.
en.hot: As an open-source Palantir, it fills the gap in accountability and decision provenance for AI agents, attracting significant attention with 122 stars today and 2345 total.
uses: Enterprise data teams: build explainable AI decision systems for compliance
Knowledge graph developers: leverage RDF/LPG support for knowledge modeling and reasoning
AI safety researchers: study traceability and causal reasoning in AI systems
Regulated industry practitioners: deploy trustworthy AI in finance, healthcare, etc.

en.tag: Multi-agent swarm intelligence engine simulating digital worlds to predict futures
en.what: MiroFish is an AI prediction engine powered by multi-agent technology. It extracts seed information from the real world (e.g., breaking news, policy drafts, financial signals) to automatically build a high-fidelity parallel digital world, where thousands of agents with independent personalities, long-term memory, and behavioral logic interact and undergo social evolution. Users can inject variables from a 'God's-eye view' to deduce future trajectories, rehearsing the future in a digital sandbox to win decisions after countless simulations.
en.content: The repository contains full source code, documentation (README in both English and Chinese), static assets (e.g., logo images), Docker configuration, and community links (Discord, X, Instagram). The project is primarily in Python, offering API interfaces and an interactive digital world.
en.stack: Built primarily with Python, likely involving multi-agent frameworks, NLP, and simulation engines. Supports Docker deployment, with DeepWiki documentation and Trendshift badges integrated.
en.hot: With over 70K stars and a daily increase of 141, MiroFish combines swarm intelligence with prediction, offering a novel 'digital sandbox rehearsal' concept that attracts developers and decision-makers.

zh.hot: mise 在 Rust 社区中热度高，今日新增 258 星，总星数达 31926。它解决了开发环境配置的痛点，将多个工具整合为一个 CLI，受到开发者的欢迎。

团队：希望统一开发环境配置，减少新成员上手成本的团队
CI/CD：需要确保 CI 作业与本地环境一致的持续集成场景
多语言开发者：频繁切换 Node、Python、Go 等语言的开发者

en.tag: All-in-one dev environment manager
en.what: mise is a unified CLI for dev tools, environment variables, and task runner. It manages project tools, env vars, and tasks in one mise.toml file, ensuring new shells, checkouts, and CI jobs start from the same setup.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation, demo GIFs, and configuration files. Core features include installing and switching between hundreds of dev tools, loading environment variables per project directory (including .env files), and defining and running tasks for building, testing, linting, and deploying.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging the crates.io ecosystem. Supports various backends like npm, pip, go, etc., for installing tools.
en.hot: mise is trending in the Rust community with 258 stars today and 31,926 total. It solves the pain point of dev environment setup by consolidating multiple tools into one CLI, gaining popularity among developers.
uses: Developers: individuals managing multiple project tool versions and environments
Teams: teams wanting to unify dev environment config and reduce onboarding cost
CI/CD: continuous integration scenarios needing consistency with local environments
Polyglot developers: those frequently switching between Node, Python, Go, etc.

zh.tag: 用自然语言构建、部署并运行 AI 代理的开源平台
zh.what: AutoGPT 是一个开源平台，允许用户用自然语言描述目标，自动生成并运行 AI 代理来完成完整的工作流程。它提供可视化构建器、调度和触发功能，让非程序员也能轻松使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 AutoGPT 平台的源代码、文档、示例和可视化构建器。它提供四种交互界面：AutoPilot（对话式创建代理）、代理仪表盘、构建器和调度器，并支持自托管。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 构建，依赖现代 AI 模型和工具链，支持与外部服务集成。
zh.hot: AutoGPT 拥有超过 18.6 万星标，是 AI 代理领域的先驱项目，被 Andrej Karpathy 等专家誉为提示工程的下一个前沿。它让非程序员也能轻松创建 AI 代理，因此广受关注。
uses: 希望自动化重复性工作流程的职场人士，通过自然语言创建代理来节省时间。
对 AI 代理感兴趣的开发者，用于学习和构建自定义代理。
企业团队需要部署可调度的 AI 代理来处理数据、报告等任务。
教育者或研究者探索 AI 代理的潜力，进行实验和教学。

en.tag: Open-source platform to build, deploy, and run AI agents with plain English
en.what: AutoGPT is an open-source platform that lets users describe goals in plain English and automatically builds and runs AI agents to complete entire workflows. It offers a visual builder, scheduling, and triggers, making it accessible even to non-programmers.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, examples, and visual builder for the AutoGPT platform. It offers four interaction surfaces: AutoPilot (conversational agent creation), agent dashboard, builder, and scheduler, with self-hosting support.
en.stack: Built primarily with Python, leveraging modern AI models and toolchains, with integrations for external services.
en.hot: With over 186k stars, AutoGPT is a pioneering project in the AI agent space, praised by experts like Andrej Karpathy as the next frontier of prompt engineering. Its accessibility to non-programmers drives its popularity.
uses: Professionals looking to automate repetitive workflows by creating agents with natural language to save time.
Developers interested in AI agents, for learning and building custom agents.
Teams needing to deploy scheduled AI agents for tasks like data processing or reporting.
Educators or researchers exploring the potential of AI agents for experiments and teaching.

zh.tag: Google 核心 Java 库，集合、并发、I/O 等工具集
zh.what: Guava 是 Google 提供的一组核心 Java 库，包含新的集合类型（如 multimap 和 multiset）、不可变集合、图库，以及并发、I/O、哈希、基本类型、字符串等工具。它被 Google 内部大多数 Java 项目广泛使用，也被许多其他公司采用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Guava 的源代码、构建配置（Maven/Gradle）、文档和示例，分为 JRE 和 Android 两个版本，支持通过 Maven 或 Gradle 依赖引入。
zh.stack: 基于 Java 开发，支持 JDK 1.8+，提供 JRE 和 Android 两种 flavor，使用 Maven 和 Gradle 构建。
zh.hot: 作为 Java 开发的事实标准库，Guava 拥有超过 5.1 万 star，今日新增 13 个，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: Java 开发者：在日常项目中简化集合、并发和 I/O 操作
Android 开发者：使用 Android flavor 获得兼容支持
库作者：利用 Guava 的工具类提高代码质量和效率

en.tag: Google core Java libraries: collections, concurrency, I/O, and more
en.what: Guava is a set of core Java libraries from Google that includes new collection types (such as multimap and multiset), immutable collections, a graph library, and utilities for concurrency, I/O, hashing, primitives, strings, and more. It is widely used in most Java projects at Google and by many other companies.
en.content: The repository contains Guava's source code, build configuration (Maven/Gradle), documentation, and examples, with two flavors: JRE and Android, and can be added via Maven or Gradle dependencies.
en.stack: Developed in Java, requires JDK 1.8+, offers JRE and Android flavors, built with Maven and Gradle.
en.hot: As a de facto standard library for Java development, Guava has over 51k stars, with 13 new stars today, remaining popular among developers.
uses: Java developers: simplify collections, concurrency, and I/O in daily projects
Android developers: use the Android flavor for compatibility
Library authors: leverage Guava's utilities to improve code quality and efficiency

zh.tag: 基于 tmux 的多 AI 代理编排平台，让代理群像专业工程师一样协作
zh.what: SwarmForge 是一个 AI 代理协调系统，通过 git worktree、tmux 会话和消息传递，让多个代理在同一项目上协作而不互相干扰。它提供角色提示、工作树分配和共享操作脚本，并支持多种工作流分支（如 two-pack、four-pack、six-pack），每个分支定义特定的角色和流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含文档性的 main 分支（含共享操作脚本和默认宪法条款）以及可运行的工作流分支（如 two-pack、four-pack、six-pack），每个分支包含 swarmforge.conf、本地宪法条款和角色提示。启动时通过 ./swarm 包装脚本从 main 复制共享脚本并启动本地配置。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 Clojure，但实际运行依赖 tmux、git worktree 和 shell 脚本（./swarm 包装器）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 81 星，总星数 1828，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 13 名。它提供了一种纪律严明的多代理协作方式，吸引了对 AI 代理编排感兴趣的用户。
uses: 希望用多个 AI 代理协作完成编码任务的开发者，尤其是需要 TDD 和重构的场景。
需要结构化工作流（如规范驱动开发）的团队，可选用 four-pack 或 six-pack 分支。
对 tmux 和 git worktree 熟悉的用户，希望在不引入重型平台的情况下编排代理。

en.tag: A disciplined tmux-based agent orchestration platform turning swarms of AI agents into reliable software engineers
en.what: SwarmForge is an agent coordination system that enables multiple AI agents to collaborate on the same project via git worktrees, tmux sessions, and message passing without stepping on each other. It provides role-specific prompts, worktree assignments, shared operational scripts, and multiple workflow branches (e.g., two-pack, four-pack, six-pack) each defining specific roles and processes.
en.content: The repo contains a documentary main branch with shared operational scripts and default constitution articles, plus runnable workflow branches (e.g., two-pack, four-pack, six-pack) each containing swarmforge.conf, local constitution articles, and role prompts. At startup, the ./swarm wrapper copies shared scripts from main and launches the branch's local configuration.
en.stack: Primary language is Clojure, but runtime relies on tmux, git worktrees, and shell scripts (./swarm wrapper).
en.hot: Gained 81 stars today, total 1828, ranking #13 on GitHub Trending daily. It offers a disciplined multi-agent collaboration approach, attracting users interested in AI agent orchestration.
uses: Developers wanting multiple AI agents to collaborate on coding tasks, especially with TDD and refactoring.
Teams needing structured workflows like specification-driven development via four-pack or six-pack branches.
Users familiar with tmux and git worktrees who want lightweight agent orchestration without heavy platforms.

zh.tag: 自托管分布式 Durable Objects 运行时
zh.what: celld 是一个开源守护进程，让你在自己的机器上运行 Cloudflare Workers 和 Durable Objects。每个对象都是一个独立的 SQLite 数据库，按名称寻址，并复制到你拥有的 S3 兼容存储桶中；节点仅通过该存储桶协调，无需控制平面或共识。
zh.content: 仓库包含 celld 的 Rust 源码、安装脚本、Docker 镜像配置以及文档。它嵌入 V8 引擎执行 Wrangler 构建的 Worker 包，并通过 S3 存储桶实现状态复制和所有权协调。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 V8 引擎和 S3 兼容对象存储（如 AWS S3、Cloudflare R2）。使用 esbuild 打包 Worker 项目。
zh.hot: 今日新增 516 星，总星数 2202，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。它解决了分布式 Durable Objects 的痛点，通过去中心化设计简化了部署和运维。
uses: 希望在自有基础设施上运行 Cloudflare Workers 的开发者
需要分布式持久化状态且不想依赖云厂商锁定的团队
对边缘计算和 Durable Objects 感兴趣的研究者
寻求低成本、可扩展的分布式应用架构的架构师

en.tag: Self-hosted distributed Durable Objects runtime
en.what: celld is an open-source daemon that runs Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects on your own machines. Each object is its own SQLite database, addressed by name and replicated to an S3-compatible bucket you own; nodes coordinate through that bucket alone, with no control plane or consensus.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust source code, installation scripts, Docker image config, and docs. It embeds V8 to execute Wrangler bundles and coordinates state and ownership via an S3 bucket.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging V8 and S3-compatible object storage (e.g., AWS S3, Cloudflare R2). Uses esbuild for bundling Worker projects.
en.hot: Gained 516 stars today, reaching 2202 total, trending on GitHub. It addresses the pain point of distributed Durable Objects with a decentralized design that simplifies deployment and operations.
uses: Developers who want to run Cloudflare Workers on their own infrastructure
Teams needing distributed persistent state without vendor lock-in
Researchers interested in edge computing and Durable Objects
Architects seeking low-cost, scalable distributed application architectures

zh.tag: 开源情报（OSINT）工具与资源精选清单
zh.what: 这是一个精心整理的开源情报（OSINT）工具与资源列表，涵盖人员搜索、社交媒体、航空、海事、铁路、域名/IP、钓鱼邮件、恶意软件分析、暗网、搜索引擎、地理空间、新闻监控等多个领域。主要面向欺诈调查员、CTI分析师、KYC/AML合规人员等。
zh.content: 仓库以 Markdown 文档形式组织，按主题分为 25 个类别，每个类别有独立的文档（如 people-social.md、aviation.md 等），包含工具链接和简要说明。还包含贡献指南、行为准则和 CC0 许可证。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Markdown 和 GitHub 平台，无特定编程语言。工具链接指向第三方服务或开源项目，覆盖 Web 应用、API、命令行工具等。
zh.hot: 今日新增 109 星，总星数达 1424，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜。因其系统化整理 OSINT 资源，覆盖领域广泛且持续更新，吸引了安全、调查和合规领域从业者的关注。

CTI 分析师：获取威胁情报、恶意软件分析、暗网监控资源
KYC/AML 合规人员：用于客户尽职调查和反洗钱筛查
OSINT 学习者：按分类浏览学习资源，系统提升技能

en.tag: A curated list of OSINT tools & resources for investigators, analysts, and more
en.what: This is a curated list of OSINT tools and resources covering people search, social media, aviation, maritime, railways, domains/IPs, phishing, malware analysis, dark web, search engines, geospatial, news monitoring, and more. It targets fraud investigators, CTI analysts, KYC/AML professionals, and others.

en.stack: Primarily Markdown and GitHub-based, with no specific programming language. Tool links point to third-party services or open-source projects, covering web apps, APIs, CLI tools, etc.
en.hot: Gained 109 stars today, reaching 1424 total, and hit #15 on GitHub Trending. Its systematic organization of OSINT resources across diverse domains and ongoing updates attract security, investigation, and compliance professionals.
uses: Fraud investigators: quickly find tools for people, social, and corporate investigations
CTI analysts: access threat intel, malware analysis, and dark web monitoring resources
KYC/AML compliance staff: for customer due diligence and anti-money laundering screening
OSINT learners: browse categorized learning resources to systematically improve skills

zh.tag: 一键追溯进程/端口/容器/文件来源的 CLI+TUI 工具
zh.what: witr 是一个命令行工具，用于回答“为什么这个在运行？”的问题。它能追溯进程、端口、容器或文件是由谁启动的，并展示完整的启动链，如 systemd → PM2 → node。支持 CLI 输出、机器可读 JSON 和交互式 TUI。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 和 TUI 程序，提供安装脚本、文档和浏览器演示。核心功能是解析进程树、服务管理器、容器和文件系统，生成因果链。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖系统工具如 ps、lsof、ss、systemctl、docker 等来收集信息。支持 Linux、macOS、Windows 和 FreeBSD。
zh.hot: 解决了开发者常遇到的“这个进程/端口是谁启动的”痛点，提供直观的因果链展示，且支持多平台和多种包管理器，上线后迅速获得近 2 万星。
uses: 系统管理员排查异常进程或端口占用，快速定位源头。
开发者在容器或微服务环境中追踪服务启动链，便于调试。
安全分析师调查可疑进程或文件来源，辅助取证。
DevOps 工程师理解系统启动流程，优化服务管理。

en.tag: Trace any process, port, container, or file back to its origin with CLI+TUI
en.what: witr is a CLI tool that answers 'Why is this running?' by tracing any process, port, container, or file back to the exact chain that started it, such as systemd → PM2 → node. It offers CLI output, machine-readable JSON, and an interactive TUI.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based CLI and TUI program, along with installation scripts, documentation, and a browser demo. It parses process trees, service managers, containers, and file systems to generate causal chains.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it leverages system utilities like ps, lsof, ss, systemctl, and docker to gather information. Supports Linux, macOS, Windows, and FreeBSD.
en.hot: It solves the common pain point of 'who started this process/port' with intuitive causal chain visualization, multi-platform support, and multiple package managers, quickly gaining nearly 20k stars.
uses: System admins investigating abnormal processes or port usage to quickly locate the source.
Developers tracing service startup chains in container or microservice environments for debugging.
Security analysts investigating suspicious processes or file origins for forensics.
DevOps engineers understanding system startup flows to optimize service management.

zh.what: 这是一个包含 Google 产品和技术的 Agent Skills 仓库，提供可复用的技能模块，帮助 AI 代理执行云平台操作、解决方案架构等任务。通过 npx 命令即可安装和选择所需技能。

Solution architects: Use pre-built skill templates to design cloud architectures and data analytics workflows.
AI platform admins: Manage model deployment, tuning, and monitoring to improve operational efficiency.

zh.tag: 模块化节点式 AI 创作引擎，支持图像/视频/3D/音频生成

开发者：利用 API 集成 ComfyUI 到生产管线，构建 AI 应用。
研究人员：快速实验最新模型，定制和优化生成流程。

It natively supports the latest open-source models and provides API nodes for top closed-source models, enabling generation of images, videos, 3D models, audio, and more.

uses: AI artists and designers: create high-quality images, videos, and 3D content via visual node workflows.
Developers: integrate ComfyUI into production pipelines via API to build AI applications.
Researchers: quickly experiment with latest models, customize and optimize generation pipelines.
Educators: demonstrate AI generation principles and model workflows in teaching.

zh.tag: 系统设计面试与大规模系统学习一站式指南

zh.what: TencentDB Agent Memory 是一个为 AI 代理设计的团队级记忆中枢，将对话、文档和代码转化为四种可复用的记忆资产（聊天记忆、技能、LLM 维基、代码图谱），并支持跨代理和框架的治理、共享与装备。它旨在减少重复工作，让代理在团队中持续积累知识。
zh.content: 仓库包含部署脚本（一键启动 memory-core、memory-hub 和 proxy）、核心服务代码、迁移工具，以及详细的安装文档（中英文）。提供面板用于管理记忆资产。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，依赖 Node.js >=22.16，支持 OpenClaw 和 Hermes 等代理框架，使用 TencentDB 作为存储后端。
zh.hot: 今日新增 1057 星，总星数达 16543，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。其“团队记忆”理念切中 AI 代理协作痛点，且提供一键部署，迅速吸引开发者关注。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为代理添加持久记忆，减少重复上下文输入。
团队协作场景：共享代理记忆，提升团队知识复用效率。
个人开发者：构建“一人公司”式的代理团队，自动化工作流。
研究爱好者：探索代理记忆管理与跨框架集成。

en.tag: Team-level memory hub for AI agents, turning conversations, docs, and code into reusable assets
en.what: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI agents, transforming conversations, docs, and code into four reusable memory assets (Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, Code-Graph) that are governed, shared, and equipped across agents and frameworks. It aims to reduce repetitive work by enabling agents to accumulate knowledge persistently.
en.content: The repo includes deployment scripts (one-click start for memory-core, memory-hub, and proxy), core service code, migration tools, and detailed installation docs (EN/CN). A panel is provided for managing memory assets.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, requires Node.js >=22.16, supports agent frameworks like OpenClaw and Hermes, and uses TencentDB as the storage backend.
en.hot: Gained 1,057 stars today, reaching 16,543 total, and topped the GitHub Trending daily chart. Its 'team memory' concept addresses the pain point of AI agent collaboration, and one-click deployment quickly attracts developers.
uses: AI agent developers: add persistent memory to agents, reducing repetitive context input.
Team collaboration: share agent memory to improve knowledge reuse efficiency.
Solo developers: build a 'one-person company' agent team for automated workflows.
Researchers/enthusiasts: explore agent memory management and cross-framework integration.

zh.tag: 聚合28家免费LLM，统一OpenAI兼容接口
zh.what: FreeLLMAPI 是一个开源代理，将28家LLM提供商的免费层（每月约40亿token）聚合到一个OpenAI兼容的/v1端点后面。它提供智能路由、自动故障转移和加密密钥管理，专为个人实验设计。
zh.content: 仓库包含TypeScript编写的代理服务器、模型目录更新机制、Docker镜像、桌面应用以及详细的文档和安装指南。
zh.stack: 基于TypeScript构建，支持Docker部署，兼容所有OpenAI客户端，并包含加密存储和动态模型目录更新功能。
zh.hot: 凭借18040颗星和日增114颗，FreeLLMAPI因免费聚合大量LLM资源而爆火，解决了开发者免费使用多种模型的需求。
uses: 个人开发者：免费体验多种LLM，无需分别注册和付费
AI应用原型开发：快速集成多个模型进行测试和对比
学习与研究：探索不同模型的能力和差异

en.tag: Aggregate 28 free LLM providers into one OpenAI-compatible API
en.what: FreeLLMAPI is an open-source proxy that aggregates the free tiers of 28 LLM providers (~4B tokens/month) behind a single OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint. It offers smart routing, automatic failover, and encrypted key management, designed for personal experimentation.
en.content: The repository contains a TypeScript-based proxy server, a self-updating model catalog, Docker images, a desktop app, and comprehensive documentation and installation guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, supports Docker deployment, compatible with any OpenAI client, and includes encrypted storage and dynamic model catalog updates.
en.hot: With 18,040 stars and 114 daily additions, FreeLLMAPI is trending because it aggregates a massive amount of free LLM resources, addressing developers' need to use multiple models for free.
uses: Individual developers: try multiple LLMs for free without separate sign-ups and costs
AI prototyping: quickly integrate multiple models for testing and comparison
Learning and research: explore capabilities and differences across models

zh.tag: 开源 24/7 AI 代理协作桌面应用
zh.what: AionUi 是一款免费开源的桌面应用，让用户与多种 CLI AI 代理（如 OpenClaw、Hermes、Claude Code、Codex 等）进行协作。它内置代理、零配置、支持任意 API 密钥，并可实现多代理协同、远程访问和跨平台自动化。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用源码、资源文件（如 banner 图片）、多语言 README（中英日韩等）以及社区链接。应用支持自定义助手、团队协作，并提供与 Kimi 合作的贡献者奖励计划。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，跨平台支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。依赖包括各类 CLI 代理工具，并集成 API 密钥管理。
zh.hot: 凭借 31.6k 星标和日增 105 星的热度，AionUi 在 TypeScript 趋势榜位列第 4。其零配置、多代理协作和 24/7 自动化能力吸引了大量开发者，且与 Kimi 的合作提供了免费高级套餐，进一步推动增长。
uses: 开发者：希望统一管理多个 CLI AI 代理，提高编码效率。
团队：需要协作式 AI 工作流，实现 24/7 自动化任务。
AI 爱好者：探索多代理协同和远程访问场景。

en.tag: Open-source 24/7 cowork app for AI agents
en.what: AionUi is a free, open-source desktop app that lets users collaborate with various CLI AI agents like OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, and Codex. It features built-in agents, zero setup, any API key support, multi-agent collaboration, remote access, and cross-platform automation.
en.content: The repository contains the desktop app source, resources like banners, multi-language READMEs, and community links. It supports customizing assistants and teaming them up, with a contributor bonus program in partnership with Kimi.
en.stack: Primary language is TypeScript, cross-platform on macOS, Windows, and Linux. It integrates with various CLI agents and manages API keys.
en.hot: With 31.6k stars and +105 today, AionUi ranks #4 on the TypeScript trending list. Its zero-setup, multi-agent collaboration, and 24/7 automation appeal to developers, and the Kimi partnership offering free premium plans boosts its growth.
uses: Developers: to manage multiple CLI AI agents in one place and boost coding efficiency.
Teams: needing collaborative AI workflows and 24/7 automation.
AI enthusiasts: exploring multi-agent coordination and remote access scenarios.

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的架构感知开源基础框架
zh.what: Open Mercato 是一个开源基础框架，旨在解决 AI 编程助手只生成代码、不关心代码放置位置和架构一致性的问题。它提供架构感知的 AI 工具链，让 AI 代理知道代码应放在哪里，并内置了 CRM/ERP 等业务模块，使开发团队能从 80% 完成度开始构建生产级应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Next.js 应用（apps/mercato）、架构规范与技能定义（AI harness and skills）、CRM/ERP 领域模块、文档站点等。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 和 Next.js，利用 AI 代理（如 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex）进行开发，遵循 spec-first 开发模式。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编程助手普及，团队发现仅靠生成代码不够，Open Mercato 提供架构决策和规范，让 AI 输出可复现，因此迅速获得关注，今日新增 11 星，登上 TypeScript 趋势榜第 6。
uses: CTO 和技术负责人：已部署 Cursor/Copilot 但发现不够用，需要架构一致性
开发者：希望用 AI 代理快速构建专业业务应用和后端，而无需担心架构细节
企业：需要 CRM/ERP 等业务模块，希望从 80% 完成度开始定制

en.tag: Open-source architecture-aware foundation framework for AI agents
en.what: Open Mercato is an open-source foundation framework that addresses the issue of AI coding assistants generating code without regard for placement or architectural consistency. It provides an architecture-aware AI harness that guides agents on where code should go, and includes ready-made CRM/ERP business modules, enabling teams to start building production-grade apps at 80% completion.
en.content: The repository contains a Next.js app (apps/mercato), architecture specs and skill definitions for AI agents, CRM/ERP domain modules, and documentation site.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Next.js, leveraging AI agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) and spec-first development.
en.hot: As AI coding assistants become widespread, teams realize code generation alone is insufficient; Open Mercato provides architectural decisions and specs for reproducible AI output, quickly gaining traction with 11 stars today and ranking #6 on TypeScript trending.
uses: CTOs and tech leads who have deployed Cursor/Copilot and need more architectural consistency
Developers who want to build professional business apps and backends with AI agents without worrying about architecture
Enterprises needing CRM/ERP modules and wanting to start at 80% completion

zh.tag: Vue 3 组件库，Element 团队出品
zh.what: Element Plus 是一套基于 Vue 3 的桌面端组件库，提供丰富的 UI 组件（如按钮、表单、表格等），帮助开发者快速构建高质量 Web 应用。它由饿了么 Element 团队维护，是 Element UI 的 Vue 3 升级版。
zh.content: 仓库包含组件源码、文档、示例、迁移工具（gogocode-plugin-element）以及 Playground 等，支持按需引入和主题定制。
zh.stack: 基于 Vue 3 Composition API，使用 TypeScript 编写，依赖 Node.js >= 20，并支持 Vite 等构建工具。
zh.hot: 作为 Element UI 的官方 Vue 3 版本，拥有 27k+ star，是 Vue 生态中最受欢迎的 UI 库之一，今日新增 3 star 并登上 TypeScript 趋势榜。
uses: Vue 3 项目开发者，需要快速搭建中后台界面
从 Element UI 迁移到 Vue 3 的团队，可使用官方迁移工具
追求 TypeScript 类型安全和组件可定制性的前端工程师

en.tag: A Vue.js 3 UI library made by Element team
en.what: Element Plus is a Vue 3 based UI library for desktop, offering a rich set of components (buttons, forms, tables, etc.) to help developers build high-quality web apps quickly. It is maintained by the Element team and is the Vue 3 upgrade of Element UI.
en.content: The repo contains component source code, docs, examples, a migration tool (gogocode-plugin-element), and a playground, supporting on-demand imports and theme customization.
en.stack: Built on Vue 3 Composition API, written in TypeScript, requires Node.js >= 20, and supports build tools like Vite.
en.hot: As the official Vue 3 version of Element UI, it has 27k+ stars, making it one of the most popular UI libraries in the Vue ecosystem, with 3 new stars today and trending in TypeScript.
uses: Vue 3 developers needing to quickly build admin dashboards
Teams migrating from Element UI to Vue 3, using the official migration tool
Frontend engineers seeking TypeScript safety and component customization

zh.tag: 开源全栈 Next.js 框架，自带后端与后台面板
zh.what: Payload 是一个开源的全栈 Next.js 框架，提供完整的 TypeScript 后端和管理面板。它既可以作为无头 CMS 使用，也可以用于构建强大的应用程序。
zh.content: 仓库包含框架核心代码、文档、示例模板（如 website 模板）以及用于快速启动的 CLI 工具（create-payload-app）。

zh.hot: 作为首个 Next.js 原生 CMS，可直接安装到现有 /app 目录，提供无供应商锁定和开源优势，吸引了 4.4 万 star。
uses: 开发者希望快速搭建全栈应用，无需单独构建后端和后台
团队需要一个可扩展、可定制的无头 CMS 来管理内容
希望将前后端统一在 Next.js 项目中的开发者
寻求开源替代方案，避免商业 CMS 的锁定和成本

en.tag: Open-source fullstack Next.js framework with instant backend and admin panel
en.what: Payload is an open-source fullstack Next.js framework that provides a complete TypeScript backend and admin panel. It can be used as a headless CMS or for building powerful applications.
en.content: The repository contains the framework core code, documentation, example templates (like the website template), and CLI tools (create-payload-app) for quick start.
en.stack: Built on Next.js and TypeScript, supports React Server Components, deployable to serverless environments like Vercel.
en.hot: As the first Next.js native CMS, it can be installed directly into existing /app folder, offering no vendor lock-in and open-source benefits, attracting 44k stars.
uses: Developers who want to quickly build fullstack apps without separately building backend and admin
Teams needing an extensible, customizable headless CMS for content management
Developers who want to unify frontend and backend in a Next.js project
Those seeking open-source alternatives to avoid vendor lock-in and costs

zh.tag: 开源项目管理工具，Jira/Linear 替代品
zh.what: Plane 是一个开源的项目管理平台，用于管理任务、冲刺、文档和问题分类。它旨在替代 Jira、Linear、Monday 和 ClickUp 等商业工具，提供现代、简洁的界面和丰富的功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的项目源码，包括前端（TypeScript/React）和后端（Python/Django），以及 Docker 和 Kubernetes 部署配置。提供 Cloud 和自托管两种部署方式，支持丰富的功能如工作项、周期、模块和视图。
zh.stack: 技术栈包括 TypeScript、React（前端）和 Python、Django（后端），数据库使用 PostgreSQL，支持 Docker 和 Kubernetes 部署。
zh.hot: 作为开源替代品，Plane 在开发者社区中广受欢迎，Star 数已超过 5.5 万，今日新增 95 星，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 6。其现代 UI 和丰富功能吸引了大量寻求自托管项目管理方案的用户。
uses: 团队希望从 Jira 等商业工具迁移到开源方案
需要自托管、数据可控的项目管理平台
开发者想要定制和扩展项目管理功能
个人或小团队寻找免费且功能全面的项目管理工具

en.tag: Open-source project management tool, Jira/Linear alternative
en.what: Plane is an open-source project management platform for managing tasks, sprints, docs, and triage. It aims to replace commercial tools like Jira, Linear, Monday, and ClickUp with a modern, clean interface and rich features.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, including frontend (TypeScript/React) and backend (Python/Django), along with Docker and Kubernetes deployment configs. It offers both Cloud and self-hosted deployment, with features like work items, cycles, modules, and views.
en.stack: Tech stack includes TypeScript, React (frontend) and Python, Django (backend), with PostgreSQL as database, supporting Docker and Kubernetes deployment.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative, Plane is popular among developers, with over 55k stars and 95 new stars today, ranking #6 on the TypeScript daily trending. Its modern UI and rich features attract users seeking self-hosted project management solutions.
uses: Teams looking to migrate from commercial tools like Jira to open-source
Organizations needing self-hosted, data-controlled project management
Developers wanting to customize and extend project management features
Individuals or small teams seeking a free and feature-rich project management tool

zh.tag: 免费AI编码代理，多产品覆盖终端、桌面、网页与云端
zh.what: Freebuff 是一套免费的AI编码代理产品，包括桌面端、CLI、Web、云和聊天五种形态，无需订阅或API密钥即可使用。它通过专用代理和模型选择帮助用户编码、构建和研究。

zh.hot: 免费且无需API密钥的AI编码工具，提供多产品覆盖和多种模型选择，今日新增105星，登上GitHub趋势榜。

全栈开发者：使用Web版构建和部署完整应用
研究者：通过聊天版进行AI驱动的研究与思考
团队：在GitHub仓库上运行云端代理进行协作

en.tag: Free AI coding agent suite across terminal, desktop, web, and cloud
en.what: Freebuff is a suite of free AI coding agents available as desktop, CLI, web, cloud, and chat products, requiring no subscription or API key. It uses specialized agents and a choice of models to assist with coding, building, and research.
en.content: The repository includes product documentation, quick start guides, model catalog details, and descriptions/links for each product (Desktop, CLI, Web, Cloud, Chat).
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, CLI installable via npm, supports multiple models (DeepSeek, GPT-5.6 Luna, etc.), and Desktop can integrate local Claude Code and Codex agents.
en.hot: Free AI coding tool with no API key required, offering multi-product coverage and model variety; gained 105 stars today and hit the GitHub trending list.
uses: Developers: AI-assisted coding from terminal or desktop
Full-stack developers: build and ship apps with the Web version
Researchers: AI-driven research and thinking via Chat
Teams: run cloud agents on GitHub repositories for collaboration

zh.tag: 面向 AI 代理的网页搜索、抓取与交互 API
zh.what: Firecrawl 是一个开源 API，用于大规模搜索、抓取网页并将其转换为干净的 Markdown 或结构化数据，供 AI 代理使用。它处理代理轮换、速率限制等复杂问题，提供高可靠性和低延迟。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 API 端点（搜索、抓取、爬取、映射等）、SDK（Python/Node）、MCP 集成、自托管部署选项以及文档和示例。

zh.hot: GitHub 星标超 16 万，今日新增 583，因其为 AI 代理提供可靠、快速的网页上下文获取能力，成为构建 AI 应用的关键基础设施。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要实时网页数据来增强 LLM 应用
数据科学家：抓取结构化数据用于分析和训练
企业：构建可扩展的网页数据管道，无需维护代理基础设施

en.tag: The context API to search, scrape, and interact with the web at scale.
en.what: Firecrawl is an open-source API for searching, scraping, and converting web pages into clean Markdown or structured data at scale, designed for AI agents. It handles proxies, rate limits, and JS-heavy pages, offering high reliability and low latency.
en.content: The repository includes core API endpoints (search, scrape, crawl, map, etc.), SDKs (Python/Node), MCP integration, self-hosting options, and documentation with examples.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, uses Playwright for browser automation, supports various deployment options (Docker, cloud).
en.hot: With over 162k stars and 583 new today, Firecrawl is hot because it provides reliable, fast web context for AI agents, making it essential infrastructure for AI applications.
uses: AI agent developers: need real-time web data to enhance LLM apps
Data scientists: scrape structured data for analysis and training
Enterprises: build scalable web data pipelines without proxy infrastructure

zh.tag: 构建代理原生应用的前端全栈框架
zh.what: CopilotKit 是一个用于构建全栈代理应用、生成式 UI 和聊天应用的最佳 SDK。它支持 React、Angular、Vue、React Native 等框架，并扩展到 Slack 等平台。它也是 AG-UI 协议的发起者，该协议已被 Google、LangChain、AWS 等采用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CopilotKit 的核心库（如 @copilotkit/react-core）、文档、示例、以及用于安装 agent skills 的命令行工具。它提供了快速启动模板和与主流 LLM 的集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 React 等前端框架，支持多种 LLM 提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 等）。通过 npm 分发，并遵循 AG-UI 协议。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理应用的兴起，CopilotKit 提供了统一的前端解决方案，支持多平台，且由 AG-UI 协议背书，因此获得了大量关注。36k+ 的 star 数反映了其在开发者社区中的高人气。
uses: 前端开发者：希望快速为 React/Vue/Angular 应用添加 AI 代理功能。
全栈开发者：需要构建跨 Web、移动端和 Slack 的代理应用。
AI 应用创业者：利用生成式 UI 和共享状态构建交互式 AI 产品。
技术团队：采用 AG-UI 协议实现代理 UI 的标准化。

en.tag: Frontend stack for building agent-native apps with Generative UI
en.what: CopilotKit is a best-in-class SDK for building full-stack agentic applications, Generative UI, and chat applications. It supports React, Angular, Vue, React Native, and extends to Slack and other surfaces. It is also the creator of the AG-UI Protocol, adopted by Google, LangChain, AWS, and more.
en.content: The repository contains CopilotKit's core libraries (e.g., @copilotkit/react-core), documentation, examples, and CLI tools for installing agent skills. It provides quick-start templates and integrations with major LLMs.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on frontend frameworks like React, with support for multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.). Distributed via npm and follows the AG-UI Protocol.
en.hot: With the rise of AI agent applications, CopilotKit offers a unified frontend solution with multi-platform support and is backed by the AG-UI Protocol, gaining significant traction. Its 36k+ stars reflect high popularity in the developer community.
uses: Frontend developers: want to quickly add AI agent features to React/Vue/Angular apps.
Full-stack developers: need to build agent apps across web, mobile, and Slack.
AI app entrepreneurs: leverage Generative UI and shared state for interactive AI products.
Tech teams: adopt the AG-UI Protocol for standardizing agent UI.

zh.tag: AI 智能体工具链：统一 LLM API、代理循环、TUI 与编程代理 CLI
zh.what: 提供模块化 AI 代理开发框架，整合多厂商 LLM API、代理运行时与终端交互界面。内置可自扩展的编程代理 CLI，支持工具调用、状态管理与交互式编码任务。

en.tag: Context intelligence layer for AI agents — local Rust binary, cuts tokens by 60–90%.
en.what: LeanCTX is a local context engineering layer for AI coding agents. It decides what agents read, compresses what they send to the model, remembers learned information across sessions, guards what they touch, and proves token savings with a verifiable ledger.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust binary offering a local proxy, optional compression proxy, real-time dashboard, budget control, plus 76 MCP tools and 30+ agent integrations.
en.stack: Written in Rust, distributed via crates.io, npm, AUR, and Pi.dev.
en.hot: With the rise of AI coding agents, context management is a pain point; LeanCTX promises 60–90% token reduction, zero config, and local-first, quickly gaining traction with 3,533 stars.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents like Cursor or Copilot to cut token costs and improve context efficiency.
Teams needing persistent memory and context compression across sessions to avoid re-reading files.
Users privacy-conscious, preferring local context processing.
Developers building custom AI agent toolchains requiring MCP integration and budget control.

zh.tag: Windows 上的 i3wm 风格平铺窗口管理器
zh.what: GlazeWM 是一款受 i3wm 启发的 Windows 平铺窗口管理器，通过键盘命令轻松组织窗口并调整布局。它支持多显示器、自定义规则和 YAML 配置，提供类似 Linux 的平铺体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源代码、安装程序、示例配置、默认键位速查表、贡献指南和与 Zebar 状态栏集成的说明。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 开发，依赖 Windows API 实现窗口管理，支持通过 Winget、Chocolatey、Scoop 等包管理器安装。
zh.hot: V3 版本发布带来重大更新，加上 Windows 用户对平铺窗口管理器的需求，star 数已超 1.2 万，今日新增 25 星，位列 Rust 日榜第 8。
uses: Windows 高级用户，希望获得类似 Linux 的平铺窗口管理体验
开发者和多任务处理者，追求键盘驱动的高效窗口布局
喜欢自定义配置的用户，可通过 YAML 灵活调整窗口行为

en.tag: An i3wm-inspired tiling window manager for Windows
en.what: GlazeWM is a tiling window manager for Windows inspired by i3wm, allowing users to organize windows and adjust layouts via keyboard commands. It supports multi-monitor, custom rules, and YAML configuration, bringing a Linux-like tiling experience to Windows.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, installers, sample config, default keybinding cheatsheet, contributing guide, and integration instructions with Zebar status bar.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, leveraging Windows API for window management, and installable via package managers like Winget, Chocolatey, and Scoop.
en.hot: The release of V3 brought major updates, and with the demand for tiling window managers on Windows, stars have exceeded 12.5k, with 25 new stars today, ranking #8 on the Rust daily trending list.
uses: Power Windows users seeking a Linux-like tiling window manager experience
Developers and multitaskers who prefer keyboard-driven efficient window layouts
Users who enjoy customizing configurations via YAML for flexible window behavior

zh.tag: AI 编程代理的一站式配置切换桌面管理器
zh.what: CC Switch 是一个跨平台桌面应用，用于统一管理和切换 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等多个 AI 编程代理的配置。它让用户无需手动编辑配置文件，即可快速切换不同代理或 API 提供商，提升开发效率。
zh.content: 仓库包含基于 Tauri 2 的桌面应用源码，提供图形界面管理代理配置，支持多平台（Windows/macOS/Linux），并附带多语言 README 和变更日志。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 Tauri 2 构建，前端可能使用 Web 技术（如 React/Vue），依赖系统文件操作和进程管理。
zh.hot: 12.5 万星标表明其精准解决了 AI 编程工具碎片化问题，今日新增 352 星，持续受开发者追捧。
uses: 频繁切换 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程代理的开发者
需要管理多个 API 提供商配置的团队或个人
希望简化 AI 工具链配置的跨平台用户

en.tag: All-in-one desktop manager for configuring and switching AI coding agents
en.what: CC Switch is a cross-platform desktop app that centrally manages and switches configurations for multiple AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode. It eliminates manual config file editing, enabling quick switching between agents or API providers for enhanced productivity.
en.content: The repo contains the Tauri 2-based desktop app source code, offering a GUI to manage agent configs, supporting Windows/macOS/Linux, with multilingual README and changelog.
en.stack: Built with Rust and Tauri 2, frontend likely uses web tech (e.g., React/Vue), leveraging system file operations and process management.
en.hot: 125k stars indicate it precisely solves the fragmentation of AI coding tools, with 352 new stars today, remaining highly popular among developers.
uses: Developers who frequently switch between AI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex
Teams or individuals managing multiple API provider configurations
Cross-platform users seeking simplified AI toolchain configuration

zh.tag: Cloudflare 开源的 Rust 网络代理框架，每秒处理超 4000 万请求
zh.what: Pingora 是一个 Rust 框架，用于构建快速、可靠且可编程的网络系统，如代理和负载均衡器。它已在 Cloudflare 生产环境中运行多年，每秒处理超过 4000 万个互联网请求。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个 crate，如 pingora（公共接口）、pingora-core（核心协议）、pingora-proxy（代理逻辑）、pingora-load-balancing（负载均衡）等，以及文档和快速入门指南。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，支持异步 I/O，可选用 OpenSSL、BoringSSL、s2n-tls 或 rustls 进行 TLS，并集成多种可观测性工具。
zh.hot: 作为 Cloudflare 的核心网络组件开源，star 数已达 27k+，因其高性能、内存安全和高度可定制性而备受关注。
uses: 需要构建高性能代理或负载均衡器的开发者
关注内存安全、希望替代 C/C++ 网络服务的团队
需要高度可定制网络逻辑的场景，如自定义负载均衡策略
希望学习 Rust 网络编程和异步框架的开发者

en.tag: Cloudflare's open-source Rust framework for building fast, reliable network services, handling 40M+ req/s
en.what: Pingora is a Rust framework for building fast, reliable, and programmable networked systems, such as proxies and load balancers. It has been battle-tested in Cloudflare's production, serving over 40 million requests per second.
en.content: The repository contains multiple crates, such as pingora (public interface), pingora-core (core protocols), pingora-proxy (proxy logic), pingora-load-balancing (load balancing), along with docs and quick start guide.
en.stack: Written in Rust, supports async I/O, TLS via OpenSSL, BoringSSL, s2n-tls, or rustls (experimental), and integrates with various observability tools.
en.hot: As Cloudflare's core network component open-sourced, it has gained 27k+ stars, attracting attention for its high performance, memory safety, and high customizability.
uses: Developers building high-performance proxies or load balancers
Teams prioritizing memory safety, seeking alternatives to C/C++ network services
Scenarios requiring highly customizable network logic, e.g., custom load balancing strategies
Developers learning Rust network programming and async frameworks

zh.tag: OpenAI 官方轻量级终端 AI 编码代理
zh.what: Codex CLI 是 OpenAI 推出的终端原生 AI 编码代理，可在本地计算机上直接运行。它能理解自然语言指令，协助完成代码编写、重构、调试等任务。用户可通过 ChatGPT 账户或 API 密钥接入，无需离开终端即可进行智能开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Codex CLI 的 Rust 源码、跨平台编译构建脚本，以及支持 macOS/Linux/Windows 的预编译二进制发布。除终端版外，项目还指向 IDE 插件和云端 Codex Web 的入口。
zh.stack: 核心采用 Rust 开发，保证高性能与低资源占用；提供 curl、npm、Homebrew 等多种安装方式，支持通过 ChatGPT 账号或 OpenAI API 密钥进行身份验证。
zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方出品的终端编码工具，凭借 99.2k Stars 的超高人气和单日新增 328 Stars 的强劲势头，成功登顶 Rust 日榜第二。它将 AI 编程能力直接嵌入开发者最熟悉的终端环境，轻量且开源。
uses: 终端重度使用者 —— 希望在命令行中直接调用 AI 辅助编程的开发者
全栈工程师 —— 需要快速完成代码生成、重构与调试的敏捷开发场景
开源贡献者 —— 希望基于 Apache-2.0 协议研究或扩展 AI Agent 能力的工程师
ChatGPT 订阅用户 —— 想将现有 Plus/Pro/Edu 等计划权益延伸至本地开发环境

en.tag: OpenAI's official lightweight coding agent for your terminal
en.what: Codex CLI is a terminal-native AI coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your machine. It interprets natural language instructions to help write, refactor, and debug code without leaving your terminal. Users can authenticate via their ChatGPT plan or an OpenAI API key.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust source code for Codex CLI, cross-platform build scripts, and precompiled binaries for macOS, Linux, and Windows. It also points to IDE extensions and the cloud-based Codex Web agent.
en.stack: Core is built in Rust for high performance and low resource usage. It supports multiple installation methods including curl, npm, and Homebrew, and authenticates via ChatGPT accounts or OpenAI API keys.
en.hot: As an official OpenAI terminal coding tool, it commands massive attention with 99.2k Stars and 328 new Stars today, ranking second on the Rust daily trending list. It brings AI coding directly into the familiar terminal environment in a lightweight, open-source package.
uses: Terminal power users — developers who want AI assistance directly in their command line
Full-stack engineers — those needing rapid code generation, refactoring, and debugging
Open-source contributors — engineers looking to study or extend an Apache-2.0 AI agent
ChatGPT subscribers — users wanting to extend their Plus/Pro/Edu benefits to local development

zh.tag: 开源语义层，统一指标定义，服务 BI 与 AI
zh.what: Cube Core 是一个开源语义层，允许你在代码中定义指标、维度、连接和访问规则，然后通过 SQL、REST 和 GraphQL API 暴露给下游工具。它无头（headless），不提供 UI，可集成到任何分析产品中。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Cube Core 的 Rust 核心实现、文档、示例和 Docker 镜像配置。核心功能包括语义模型定义、缓存引擎、多数据源连接（如 Snowflake、BigQuery、Postgres 等）以及 API 服务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，提供 Node.js 包（@cubejs-backend/server）用于部署。支持所有 SQL 数据源，内置关系型缓存引擎以实现亚秒级延迟和高并发。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 代理和嵌入式分析的需求增长，Cube Core 作为独立、开源的语义层，解决了指标定义重复和专有锁定的痛点，因此获得 20k+ stars 并持续上榜。
uses: 数据团队：统一指标定义，避免重复建模，确保一致性
应用开发者：通过 API 嵌入分析功能，无需从零构建
AI 代理开发者：为 AI 提供结构化的语义数据访问
企业：替代专有 BI 语义层，实现多工具复用

en.tag: Open-source semantic layer for unified metrics across BI, embedded analytics, and AI
en.what: Cube Core is an open-source semantic layer that lets you define metrics, dimensions, joins, and access rules in code, then expose them via SQL, REST, and GraphQL APIs to downstream tools. It is headless, meaning it ships no UI, so you can build the analytics experience that fits your product.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust core implementation of Cube Core, documentation, examples, and Docker configuration. Key features include semantic model definition, a caching engine, multi-source data connectivity (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Postgres), and API serving.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with a Node.js package (@cubejs-backend/server) for deployment. Supports all SQL data sources and includes a relational caching engine for sub-second latency and high concurrency.
en.hot: With the rise of AI agents and embedded analytics, Cube Core addresses the pain of repeated metric definitions and proprietary lock-in by providing a standalone, open-source semantic layer, earning 20k+ stars and consistent trending.
uses: Data teams: unify metric definitions to avoid duplication and ensure consistency
Application developers: embed analytics via APIs without building from scratch
AI agent developers: provide structured semantic data access for AI
Enterprises: replace proprietary BI semantic layers for multi-tool reuse

zh.tag: 终端里的邮件客户端，支持多协议与多账户
zh.what: Himalaya 是一个用 Rust 编写的命令行邮件管理工具，支持 IMAP、SMTP、JMAP、Gmail REST API 和 Microsoft Graph 等协议。它提供统一的 API 来操作邮箱、信封、标志、消息和附件，并支持 Maildir 等本地存储格式。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Rust 源码、安装脚本、截图、logo 以及详细的 README 文档，涵盖功能列表、安装配置、使用说明和常见问题。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 rustls、native-tls 等 TLS 库，支持通过 cargo features 切换后端。
zh.hot: 作为终端邮件客户端，它提供了丰富的协议支持和可脚本化的 JSON 输出，吸引了许多追求高效和可定制性的开发者。尽管 star 数不算特别高，但今日新增 29 星，说明仍有一定热度。
uses: 喜欢在终端中高效处理邮件的开发者或系统管理员
需要自动化邮件处理或脚本化操作的场景
追求隐私和轻量级工具的用户，避免使用重量级 GUI 客户端

en.tag: A terminal-based email client supporting multiple protocols and accounts
en.what: Himalaya is a command-line email management tool written in Rust, supporting protocols like IMAP, SMTP, JMAP, Gmail REST API, and Microsoft Graph. It provides a unified API for mailboxes, envelopes, flags, messages, and attachments, and supports local storage formats like Maildir.
en.content: The repository contains the complete Rust source code, installation scripts, screenshots, logo, and a detailed README covering features, installation, configuration, usage, and FAQ.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, using TLS libraries like rustls and native-tls, with backend support gated by cargo features.
en.hot: As a terminal email client, it offers extensive protocol support and scriptable JSON output, attracting developers who value efficiency and customization. Despite a moderate star count, it gained 29 stars today, indicating ongoing interest.
uses: Developers or sysadmins who prefer handling email in the terminal
Scenarios requiring automated or scripted email processing
Users seeking privacy and lightweight tools over heavy GUI clients

zh.tag: 面向云工作负载的 Rust 虚拟机监视器
zh.what: Cloud Hypervisor 是一个开源虚拟机监视器（VMM），运行在 KVM 或微软 Hypervisor 之上，专注于现代云工作负载。它支持 CPU、内存和设备热插拔，可运行 Linux 和 Windows 客户机，并通过 vhost-user 实现设备卸载，具有极小的内存占用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 VMM 实现，基于 Rust VMM 系列 crate，支持 x86-64 和 AArch64 架构（riscv64 实验性）。提供预编译二进制、包管理及从源码构建的指南，并包含详细的文档、状态和路线图。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，基于 rust-vmm 项目，依赖 KVM 或 MSHV 作为底层虚拟化接口。
zh.hot: 该项目以安全性和极简设计著称，在云原生领域备受关注。今日新增 11 个 star，总星数达 6062，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 14 名。
uses: 云服务提供商：用于构建轻量级、安全的虚拟机运行时
边缘计算场景：需要低内存占用和快速启动的虚拟化
开发者和研究者：探索 Rust 在虚拟化领域的实践

en.tag: A Rust-based VMM for modern cloud workloads
en.what: Cloud Hypervisor is an open-source Virtual Machine Monitor (VMM) that runs on KVM or Microsoft Hypervisor, focusing on modern cloud workloads. It supports CPU, memory, and device hotplug, runs Linux and Windows guests, and offloads devices via vhost-user with a minimal footprint.
en.content: The repository contains a full VMM implementation built on Rust VMM crates, supporting x86-64 and AArch64 (riscv64 experimental). It provides pre-built binaries, packages, and build-from-source instructions, along with extensive documentation, status, and roadmap.
en.stack: Written in Rust, based on the rust-vmm project, leveraging KVM or MSHV as the underlying virtualization interface.
en.hot: Known for its security focus and minimal design, it's gaining traction in cloud-native circles. With 11 new stars today and 6,062 total, it ranks #14 on the Rust trending list.
uses: Cloud providers: building lightweight, secure VM runtimes
Edge computing: virtualization with low memory footprint and fast boot
Developers and researchers: exploring Rust in virtualization

zh.tag: 开源工具，检测手机基站模拟器（IMSI捕获器）
zh.what: Rayhunter 是一个用于检测 IMSI 捕获器（又称基站模拟器或 stingray）的 Rust 工具。它最初设计运行在廉价的 Orbic RC400L 移动热点上，但社区已支持其他设备。该项目旨在让安装和使用尽可能简单，并尽量减少误报。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源代码、文档（安装指南、支持设备列表、Rayhunter Book）以及用于构建和测试的 CI 配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，可能依赖一些 Rust 生态库用于处理蜂窝网络信号和 USB 通信。
zh.hot: 该工具由 EFF 发布，针对隐私保护热点话题，star 数达 5449，在 GitHub Trending 日榜 Rust 类别排名第 13，受到关注。
uses: 隐私倡导者和记者，用于检测潜在的监控设备
安全研究人员，分析蜂窝网络攻击面
普通用户，希望了解周围是否存在基站模拟器
开源社区贡献者，可参与支持更多设备

en.tag: Open-source tool to detect cell-site simulators (IMSI catchers)
en.what: Rayhunter is a Rust tool for detecting IMSI catchers, also known as cell-site simulators or stingrays. It was initially designed to run on the cheap Orbic RC400L mobile hotspot, but community efforts have extended support to other devices. It aims to be easy to install and use, minimizing false positives.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation (installation guide, supported devices list, Rayhunter Book), and CI configuration for building and testing.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, likely leveraging Rust ecosystem libraries for cellular signal processing and USB communication.
en.hot: Released by EFF, this tool addresses privacy concerns, with 5,449 stars and ranking #13 on GitHub Trending (Rust) today, gaining significant attention.
uses: Privacy advocates and journalists to detect potential surveillance devices
Security researchers analyzing cellular network attack surfaces
General users curious about nearby cell-site simulators
Open-source contributors who can help support more devices

zh.tag: 把每个任务变成可打开应用的桌面 AI 代理
zh.what: BitFun 是一个桌面 AI 代理，它将代码代理的深度与通用任务能力相结合，不仅限于软件开发。它能为每个任务创建专属界面（如图表、看板、表单），并将对话绑定到该界面的实时状态。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心代理运行时、桌面应用（支持 macOS/Windows/Linux）、Mini Apps 框架、自托管设备同步服务器，以及文档和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Rust，桌面应用可能使用 Tauri 或类似框架，支持跨平台。依赖包括 MCP、Skills/Hooks 等定制机制，以及用于快速搜索的 flashgrep。
zh.hot: BitFun 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 19 颗星，总星数达 1496，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 10。其独特的 Agentic Mini Apps 概念和自托管多设备控制功能吸引了开发者关注。
uses: 开发者：希望使用 AI 代理进行编码、调试和代码审查，并享受桌面应用的便利。
办公人员：需要 AI 辅助研究、写作、制作演示文稿和会议记录。
技术爱好者：喜欢自托管服务，希望控制自己的数据和设备同步。
AI 应用开发者：希望基于 BitFun 构建自定义 Agent 和 Mini Apps。

en.tag: A desktop AI agent that turns every task into an app you can open
en.what: BitFun is a desktop AI agent that combines the depth of a code agent with open, general-purpose capabilities for work beyond software development. It creates a dedicated interface for each task—such as charts, boards, forms, or panels—and binds a conversation to that interface's live state.
en.content: The repository contains a high-performance agent runtime written in Rust, a polished desktop application for macOS/Windows/Linux, a Mini Apps framework, a self-hostable device-sync server, along with documentation and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: The primary language is Rust, with a desktop app likely built on Tauri or similar, supporting cross-platform. It leverages MCP, Skills/Hooks for customization, and flashgrep for fast search.
en.hot: BitFun is gaining traction on GitHub, with 19 new stars today and a total of 1496, ranking #10 on the Rust trending list. Its unique Agentic Mini Apps concept and self-hosted multi-device control are drawing developer attention.
uses: Developers: who want an AI agent for coding, debugging, and code review with a desktop app.
Office workers: needing AI assistance for research, writing, presentations, and meeting notes.
Tech enthusiasts: who prefer self-hosting and controlling their data and device sync.
AI app builders: looking to create custom agents and Mini Apps on top of BitFun.

zh.tag: AI 代理的浏览器自动化 CLI，原生 Rust 实现
zh.what: 这是一个专为 AI 代理设计的浏览器自动化命令行工具，提供快速的原生 Rust 实现。它允许 AI 代理通过命令行操作浏览器，如打开网页、点击元素、填写表单、截图等，并支持可访问性树快照和引用操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心二进制、Node.js 包装器（用于 npm 安装）、安装脚本（支持 npm、Homebrew、Cargo）以及构建工具。提供全局安装和项目本地安装方式，并自动检测现有 Chrome 等浏览器。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，通过 Node.js 和 pnpm 进行构建和分发，依赖 Chrome（通过 Chrome for Testing 下载），支持 Linux 系统依赖安装。
zh.hot: 作为 Vercel Labs 推出的 AI 代理浏览器自动化工具，凭借原生 Rust 的高性能和简洁的 CLI 设计，在 GitHub 上迅速获得 4 万+ star，成为 Rust 语言趋势榜常客。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要让代理与网页交互时，可用此 CLI 实现自动化操作。
测试工程师：利用快照和引用操作简化端到端测试脚本编写。
命令行爱好者：无需编写代码即可快速操作浏览器，适合自动化日常任务。

en.tag: Browser automation CLI for AI agents, fast native Rust
en.what: A browser automation CLI designed for AI agents, with a fast native Rust implementation. It enables AI agents to control a browser via command line, including opening pages, clicking elements, filling forms, taking screenshots, and supports accessibility tree snapshots with refs.
en.content: The repo includes a Rust core binary, a Node.js wrapper for npm installation, install scripts (npm, Homebrew, Cargo), and build tooling. It supports global and project-local installation, and auto-detects existing Chrome installations.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built and distributed via Node.js and pnpm, depends on Chrome (downloaded via Chrome for Testing), and supports Linux system dependency installation.
