en.what: RPCS3 is a PlayStation 3 emulator and debugger written in C++, supporting Windows, Linux, macOS, and FreeBSD. It enables users to run PS3 games on PC and offers debugging capabilities.
en.content: The repository contains the full emulator source code, build scripts, documentation (e.g., BUILDING.md), Wiki links, and contribution guidelines. It also includes GitHub Actions workflows and Discord community links.
en.stack: Primarily C++, with dependencies like Qt, and supports multi-platform builds.
en.hot: As a pioneer in PS3 emulation, it continues to attract attention, gaining 74 stars this week and reaching 19,377 total, ranking 16th on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: Gamers: Experience PS3 exclusive titles on PC.
Developers: Study PS3 hardware emulation and debugging techniques.
Testers: Participate in game compatibility testing and reporting.

zh.tag: 统一云端与本地离线推理的跨平台 AI 客户端
zh.what: 这是一个生产就绪的跨平台 AI 聊天客户端，支持在 Android 设备上本地运行 GGUF 模型（GPU 加速，无需联网），同时可无缝切换到 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google Gemini 或 Kimi 等云端 API。它提供多模态聊天、持久化会话、后台任务和智能自动配置等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Flutter 应用源码，包括 UI 层（聊天、任务、模型、设置视图）、GetX 控制器、服务层（本地推理、云服务、下载服务）以及推理管线的架构说明。
zh.stack: 基于 Flutter 3.x（Dart >=3.3.0），使用 GetX 管理状态，Hive 本地存储，Dio 网络请求，以及 Firebase 消息推送。本地推理依赖 Vulkan 加速。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 日榜（C++）排名第 5，今日新增 23 星，总星数 834。其亮点是同时支持本地离线运行和云端 API，且针对多种 Android 设备进行了图像生成测试，满足了用户对隐私和灵活性的需求。
uses: 注重隐私的用户：希望在本地运行模型，避免数据上传到云端。
移动开发者：需要参考 Flutter 跨平台 AI 客户端架构和本地推理集成。
AI 爱好者：希望在没有网络或低配设备上体验 LLM 和图像生成。

en.tag: Unified cross-platform AI client bridging cloud APIs and on-device offline LLM inference
en.what: A production-ready cross-platform AI chat client that runs GGUF models locally on Android with GPU acceleration (no internet after download) and seamlessly switches to cloud APIs like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or Kimi. It offers multimodal chat, persistent sessions, background tasks, and smart auto-configuration.
en.content: The repository contains the complete Flutter app source code, including UI layer (chat, task, model, settings views), GetX controllers, service layer (local inference, cloud service, download service), and architecture documentation for the inference pipeline.
en.stack: Built with Flutter 3.x (Dart >=3.3.0), uses GetX for state management, Hive for local storage, Dio for networking, and Firebase for push notifications. Local inference relies on Vulkan acceleration.
en.hot: Ranked #5 on GitHub Trending (C++) with 23 stars today and 834 total. Its appeal lies in combining local offline execution with cloud API fallback, tested on various Android devices for image generation, addressing privacy and flexibility needs.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want to run models locally without data leaving their device.
Mobile developers looking for a reference Flutter cross-platform AI client architecture and local inference integration.
AI enthusiasts who want to experiment with LLMs and image generation offline or on low-end devices.

zh.tag: Windows 官方包管理器 CLI
zh.what: WinGet 是微软官方的 Windows 包管理器，提供命令行工具来安装、升级和卸载软件。它支持从 Microsoft Store 和社区仓库获取应用，并可通过 PowerShell 模块和 COM API 进行扩展。
zh.content: 仓库包含 WinGet 客户端的源代码，包括 CLI、PowerShell 模块和 COM API 的实现。还有文档、测试和构建配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Windows 平台 API。构建系统采用 MSBuild 和 CMake，并包含 PowerShell 模块和 COM 组件。
zh.hot: 作为 Windows 官方包管理器，拥有 2.6 万星标，本周新增 43 星，持续受开发者关注。
uses: Windows 开发者：快速安装和更新开发工具，如 VS Code、Git 等。
系统管理员：通过脚本批量管理软件安装和更新。
普通用户：用命令行轻松安装常用应用。
PowerShell 用户：利用模块自动化软件管理。

en.tag: Official Windows package manager CLI
en.what: WinGet is Microsoft's official package manager for Windows, offering a command-line tool to install, upgrade, and uninstall software. It supports apps from the Microsoft Store and community repos, and can be extended via PowerShell modules and COM API.
en.content: The repo contains the source code for the WinGet client, including the CLI, PowerShell modules, and COM API implementations. It also includes docs, tests, and build configs.

Sysadmins: script bulk software installs and updates.
Regular users: easily install common apps via CLI.
PowerShell users: automate software management with modules.

zh.tag: 最强开源围棋AI引擎，自对弈训练
zh.what: KataGo 是一个基于 AlphaZero 式自对弈训练的围棋 AI 引擎，能从零开始训练达到顶尖水平。它提供强大的棋力和分析功能，支持多种 GPU 加速后端，是围棋爱好者和开发者的重要工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的引擎源码、训练脚本、预训练模型下载链接，以及详细的文档（如编译指南、性能调优、常见问题）。还提供 GTP 扩展和分析引擎，方便集成到 GUI 或自定义工具中。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 OpenCL、CUDA、TensorRT 或 Eigen 进行加速，支持多平台（Windows/Linux/MacOS）。
zh.hot: KataGo 是当前最强的开源围棋 AI 之一，持续活跃的分布式训练和社区贡献使其保持热度。本周新增 50 星，总星数近 5000，位列 C++ 周榜第六。
uses: 围棋爱好者：使用 KataGo 进行棋局分析、打谱和陪练
AI 研究者：研究自对弈训练、强化学习算法，或将其应用于其他棋类游戏
开发者：集成 KataGo 到 GUI 或自定义围棋工具中，或利用其分析引擎开发应用

en.tag: Top open-source Go engine with self-play training
en.what: KataGo is a Go AI engine trained via AlphaZero-like self-play, capable of reaching top levels from scratch. It offers strong play and analysis features, supporting multiple GPU backends, making it a key tool for Go players and developers.
en.content: The repo contains full engine source code, training scripts, links to pretrained models, and extensive docs (compilation, tuning, FAQ). It also provides GTP extensions and an analysis engine for GUI integration.
en.stack: Written in C++, accelerated via OpenCL, CUDA, TensorRT, or Eigen, cross-platform (Windows/Linux/MacOS).
en.hot: KataGo remains one of the strongest open-source Go bots, with ongoing distributed training and community contributions. Gaining 50 stars this week, it ranks 6th on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: Go enthusiasts: use KataGo for game analysis, study, and practice
AI researchers: study self-play training and RL, or apply techniques to other games
Developers: integrate KataGo into GUIs or custom tools, or leverage its analysis engine

zh.tag: 免费开源的 PlayStation 2 模拟器
zh.what: PCSX2 是一款免费开源的 PlayStation 2 模拟器，通过模拟 PS2 硬件，让你能在 PC 上玩 PS2 游戏。它结合了 MIPS CPU 解释器、动态重编译器和虚拟机来管理硬件状态和系统内存。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的模拟器源码、构建脚本、文档和兼容性列表，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 平台。提供稳定版和夜间版的安装程序与二进制文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake 构建系统，并利用多种第三方库（如 wxWidgets、OpenGL/Vulkan 等）实现图形和界面。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 20 年的开发历史，近期更新频繁，本周新增 38 个 star，总星标超过 1.5 万，在 C++ 周榜中排名第 20，因其成熟稳定且能流畅运行众多经典游戏而备受关注。
uses: 怀旧玩家：在 PC 上重温 PS2 经典游戏，如《最终幻想 X》和《鬼泣 3》。
游戏开发者：测试游戏兼容性或研究 PS2 硬件模拟技术。
开源爱好者：参与贡献代码、翻译或测试，加入活跃的社区。

en.tag: Free and open-source PlayStation 2 emulator
en.what: PCSX2 is a free and open-source PlayStation 2 emulator that lets you play PS2 games on your PC by emulating PS2 hardware. It uses a combination of MIPS CPU interpreters, recompilers, and a virtual machine to manage hardware states and system memory.
en.content: The repository contains the full emulator source code, build scripts, documentation, and compatibility lists, supporting Windows, Linux, and macOS. Installers and binaries for stable and nightly builds are provided.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, using CMake as the build system, and leveraging various third-party libraries (e.g., wxWidgets, OpenGL/Vulkan) for graphics and UI.
en.hot: With over 20 years of development history and frequent updates, it gained 38 stars this week, totaling over 15k stars, ranking 20th on the C++ weekly trending. Its maturity and ability to run many classic games at full speed attract attention.
uses: Retro gamers: Relive classic PS2 games on PC, such as Final Fantasy X and Devil May Cry 3.
Game developers: Test game compatibility or study PS2 hardware emulation techniques.
Open-source enthusiasts: Contribute code, translations, or testing, and join the active community.

zh.tag: 去中心化蓝牙+ Nostr 双协议即时通讯
zh.what: Bitchat 是一款去中心化、点对点的即时通讯应用，支持蓝牙 Mesh 网络（离线）和 Nostr 协议（互联网）双传输架构。无需账户、手机号或中央服务器，注重隐私与抗审查。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 iOS/macOS 原生应用源码，支持蓝牙 Mesh 多跳中继、Nostr 全球中继、地理频道、IRC 风格命令、端到端加密（Noise 协议 + NIP-17）及紧急擦除等功能。
zh.stack: 使用 Swift 开发，依赖 Bluetooth LE（CoreBluetooth）和 Nostr 协议栈，集成 Noise Protocol 加密、LZ4 压缩、Geohash 地理编码。
zh.hot: 凭借去中心化、无服务器、离线可用等特性，在隐私和抗审查需求高涨的当下迅速走红，24 小时内获 1720 星，总星数达 28722。
uses: 隐私敏感用户 —— 无需手机号或账户，完全匿名通信
离线/灾难场景 —— 蓝牙 Mesh 在无网络环境下仍可通信
抗议或审查环境 —— 去中心化架构难以被封锁
技术爱好者 —— IRC 风格命令和开源代码便于探索

en.tag: Decentralized messaging with Bluetooth mesh & Nostr
en.what: Bitchat is a decentralized peer-to-peer messaging app with dual transport: Bluetooth mesh for offline and Nostr for internet. No accounts, phone numbers, or central servers; privacy-first and censorship-resistant.
en.content: Full source code for iOS/macOS native app with Bluetooth mesh multi-hop relay, Nostr global relays, location-based channels, IRC-style commands, end-to-end encryption (Noise + NIP-17), and emergency wipe.
en.stack: Built with Swift, leveraging Bluetooth LE (CoreBluetooth) and Nostr protocol stack, with Noise Protocol encryption, LZ4 compression, and Geohash geocoding.
en.hot: Its decentralized, serverless, offline-capable design resonates with privacy and censorship concerns, gaining 1720 stars in 24h and 28722 total.
uses: Privacy-conscious users — anonymous without phone or account
Offline/disaster scenarios — Bluetooth mesh works without internet
Protests or censorship — decentralized architecture resists blocking
Tech enthusiasts — IRC-style commands and open-source code

zh.tag: 多 AI 编程代理并行编排的桌面与移动工作平台
zh.what: Orca 是一款 Agent Development Environment（ADE），让用户能够并行运行多种主流 AI 编程代理（如 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等），各自在隔离的 git worktree 中执行任务。同时提供移动端伴侣应用，方便用户随时随地监控、接收通知并追加指令。
zh.content: 仓库包含跨平台桌面端应用源码（支持 macOS/Windows/Linux）、移动端配套应用（iOS/Android），以及用于多代理并行执行、git worktree 管理与结果对比合并的核心模块。
zh.stack: 主要基于 TypeScript 构建，提供跨平台桌面客户端与移动端配套应用，通过集成多家第三方 AI 编程代理的 API 实现统一调度。
zh.hot: 在 AI 编程代理百花齐放的背景下，Orca 以「并行工作树 + 移动端遥控」解决了多代理对比与随时监控的痛点；一周内新增 5,409 Star 并以 21.3k 总星数冲上 GitHub 周榜第 7，足见开发者对统一代理调度界面的强烈需求。
uses: 需要同时对比多个 AI 编程代理输出的开发者——在独立 git worktree 中并行运行多个代理，择优合并结果
追求随时随地掌控编码任务的技术团队——通过移动端伴侣应用远程监控代理状态并追加指令
希望统一调度自有 AI 订阅工具的高级用户——将 Codex、Claude Code 等集中在一套桌面环境中管理
需要保持代码库隔离的谨慎工程师——每个代理在独立工作树中操作，避免污染主分支

en.tag: Parallel AI coding agent orchestrator for desktop and mobile
en.what: Orca is an Agent Development Environment (ADE) that lets developers run a fleet of popular coding agents—such as Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode—in parallel within isolated git worktrees. It also offers a mobile companion app to monitor progress, receive notifications, and send follow-up instructions from anywhere.
en.content: The repository houses the cross-platform desktop application source (macOS/Windows/Linux), a mobile companion app (iOS and Android), and core modules for parallel agent execution, git worktree management, and result comparison/merging.
en.stack: Built primarily in TypeScript, it provides cross-platform desktop clients and mobile companion apps, integrating third-party AI coding agent APIs for unified orchestration.
en.hot: As AI coding agents proliferate, Orca's parallel worktrees and mobile companion solve the pain of comparing multiple agents and monitoring them on the go; the project gained 5,409 stars this week, hitting #7 on GitHub Trending with 21.3k total stars, reflecting strong demand for a unified agent orchestration interface.
uses: Developers who want to benchmark multiple AI agents side-by-side—run several agents in isolated git worktrees and merge the best result
Teams needing on-the-go oversight—monitor and steer agents from the mobile companion app anywhere
Power users with multiple AI subscriptions—unify Codex, Claude Code, and others under one desktop orchestrator
Engineers prioritizing code safety—each agent operates in its own git worktree to avoid polluting the main branch

zh.tag: AI 驱动的全球实时态势感知仪表盘
zh.what: World Monitor 是一个实时全球情报仪表盘，利用 AI 聚合新闻、监控地缘政治事件和基础设施状态，提供统一的态势感知界面。它支持多个垂直领域（科技、金融、大宗商品、能源等）的定制化视图。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Web 应用源码、CLI 工具和 npm 包，提供多种主题变体（科技、金融、大宗商品、能源等），以及 MCP 服务器集成。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，使用 npm 包管理，支持 Web 应用和 CLI 两种形态，集成了 MCP 服务器。
zh.hot: 凭借 AI 驱动的实时全球情报聚合和多个垂直领域定制视图，上线后迅速获得 6.5 万+ Star，日增近 1300，登顶 GitHub 日榜。
uses: 地缘政治分析师 —— 实时监控全球事件与基础设施状态
金融投资者 —— 跟踪大宗商品、能源等市场动态
科技从业者 —— 获取科技领域新闻与趋势
普通用户 —— 通过 Happy 变体关注积极新闻

en.tag: AI-powered real-time global intelligence dashboard for situational awareness
en.what: World Monitor is a real-time global intelligence dashboard that uses AI to aggregate news, monitor geopolitical events, and track infrastructure status in a unified situational awareness interface. It offers customized views for various verticals like tech, finance, commodities, and energy.
en.content: The repository contains full web application source code, CLI tools, and npm packages, offering multiple theme variants (tech, finance, commodities, energy, etc.), along with MCP server integration.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, managed via npm, supports both web app and CLI, and integrates MCP server.
en.hot: With AI-powered real-time global intelligence aggregation and multiple vertical-specific views, it quickly gained over 65K stars, adding nearly 1,300 daily, topping GitHub's daily trending chart.
uses: Geopolitical analysts — monitor global events and infrastructure in real time
Financial investors — track commodities, energy, and market movements
Tech professionals — stay updated with tech news and trends
General users — follow positive news via the Happy variant

zh.tag: 为设计工程师打造的 AI 技能包，提升 UI 动画品味
zh.what: 这是一套面向设计工程师的 AI 技能集合，旨在帮助构建更好的用户界面。它基于作者在 Vercel 和 Linear 等公司的多年经验，列出了 AI 代理在动画和设计上常犯的细微错误，并给出修复方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个技能模块，如 emil-design-eng（动画与设计建议）、review-animations（严格审查动画）、improve-animations（审计并优化代码库动画）等，每个模块都是一个独立的 SKILL.md 文件。
zh.stack: 基于 npx 命令行工具安装，依赖 Node.js 环境。技能本身是 Markdown 文件，可被 AI 代理读取执行。
zh.hot: 本月新增 17933 星，总星数超 2.1 万，排名 GitHub Trending 月榜第 8。它精准切中了 AI 代理在 UI 设计上的痛点，提供“品味”解决方案，受到设计工程师和 AI 开发者的追捧。
uses: 设计工程师 —— 提升 UI 动画和设计决策的品味
AI 代理开发者 —— 为代理注入设计专业知识，避免常见错误
前端开发者 —— 学习动画最佳实践和设计原则

en.tag: AI skill pack for design engineers to level up UI animation taste
en.what: A collection of AI skills for design engineers to build better user interfaces. Based on the author's years of experience at Vercel and Linear, it lists common subtle mistakes AI agents make in animation and design, and provides fixes.
en.content: The repo contains multiple skill modules like emil-design-eng (animation & design advice), review-animations (strict animation review), improve-animations (audit and optimize codebase animations), each as a standalone SKILL.md file.
en.stack: Installed via npx CLI tool, requires Node.js. Skills are Markdown files that can be read and executed by AI agents.
en.hot: Gained 17,933 stars this month, total over 21k, ranked #8 on GitHub Trending monthly. It precisely addresses the pain point of AI agents' lack of design taste, offering a 'taste' solution, popular among design engineers and AI developers.
uses: Design engineers — improve taste in UI animation and design decisions
AI agent developers — inject design expertise into agents to avoid common mistakes
Frontend developers — learn animation best practices and design principles

zh.tag: 专治「AI 味」网页的设计 skill，让 AI 生成的 UI 不像模板货
zh.what: Together AI 出品的设计 skill 包：装进 Claude Code、Cursor 或 Codex 后，AI 生成网页 UI 时会从 20 套主题里选宏观结构，并跑 57 项「anti-slop」检查加自我批判，拒绝 LLM 默认那套千篇一律的渐变卡片风。提供生成、hallmark audit（给现有代码打分）、hallmark redesign（换结构重写）、hallmark study（从截图/URL 提取设计 DNA）四个动词。
zh.content: 核心是 skills/hallmark/ 下的 SKILL.md + references/ 规则文件；docs/ 有 recipes 和示例，site/ 是官网及大量自包含 HTML+CSS 示例页（语言占比因此显示为 CSS）。
zh.stack: Markdown 规则 + 参考文档的 skill 包（符合 Agent Skills 规范），示例为纯 HTML/CSS，MIT，无运行时依赖，一行 npx skills add nutlope/hallmark 安装。
zh.hot: 它直指 AI 生成网站同质化这一普遍痛点，并用在线 Demo 降低验证门槛，定位清晰且易于传播。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 没有设计师，也能让 AI 生成不撞脸的官网和落地页
设计师 —— 用 hallmark study 从优秀网站提取设计 DNA 做参考
前端工程师 —— 用 audit 给存量项目打分，找出「AI 味」重灾区

en.tag: The anti-'AI-slop' design skill — AI-built UIs that don't look like templates
en.what: A design skill pack from Together AI: once installed in Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, your agent picks a macro-structure from 20 themes when generating web UIs, then runs 57 'anti-slop' checks plus self-critique — rejecting the default LLM look of identical gradient cards. Four verbs: generate, hallmark audit (score existing code), hallmark redesign (rewrite with a new structure), hallmark study (extract design DNA from a screenshot or URL).
en.content: The core is SKILL.md plus rule files under skills/hallmark/ and references/; docs/ holds recipes and examples; site/ contains the homepage and many self-contained HTML+CSS example pages (which is why the language stat reads CSS).
en.stack: A Markdown-rules skill pack (Agent Skills compliant) with pure HTML/CSS examples; MIT, zero runtime dependencies; install via npx skills add nutlope/hallmark.
en.hot: Its anti-slop positioning addresses a common complaint about AI-generated websites, while the live demo makes the claim easy to evaluate.
uses: Indie devs & small teams — generate distinctive sites and landing pages without a designer
Designers — extract design DNA from great sites with hallmark study
Frontend engineers — audit existing projects to find the worst 'AI-slop' offenders

zh.tag: 在聊天里一键生成可交互系统架构图
zh.what: Archify 是一个 Agent 技能，让 AI 编程助手（如 Cursor、Claude Code 等）根据代码库或系统描述，直接在对话中生成精美的交互式技术地图。它支持五种图表类型、四种视觉预设、明暗主题和有限动画，并能在合并前对比架构快照，确保每次交互都有据可依。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、文档、示例和画廊，核心是生成自包含的 HTML 文件（含 PNG/SVG/WebM 导出和分享卡片）。
zh.stack: 基于 HTML/JavaScript，通过类型化 JSON IR 和确定性校验生成图表，支持 npx 安装，兼容多个 AI 代理。
zh.hot: 本月 star 新增 7074，总星数近万，说明开发者急需在 AI 工作流中直观呈现架构，而 Archify 提供了开箱即用的解决方案。
uses: 开发者用 AI 助手快速理解陌生代码库的运行时架构
架构师在代码审查前对比不同版本的架构差异
技术写作者生成可分享的交互式系统说明文档
团队在演示或培训中用可视化地图讲解系统设计

en.tag: Turn codebases into interactive system maps right in chat
en.what: Archify is an agent skill that lets AI coding assistants (like Cursor, Claude Code) generate polished, interactive technical maps directly in chat from a codebase or system description. It supports five diagram types, four visual presets, dark/light themes, and optional motion, and can compare architecture snapshots before merge, keeping every interaction grounded.
en.content: The repo contains the skill definition, docs, examples, and a gallery; the core output is a self-contained HTML file with PNG/SVG/WebM exports and share cards.
en.stack: Built on HTML/JavaScript, generates diagrams via typed JSON IR and deterministic checks; installable via npx, compatible with multiple AI agents.
en.hot: With 7,074 new stars this month and nearly 10k total, developers clearly need intuitive architecture visualization in AI workflows, and Archify delivers an out-of-the-box solution.
uses: Developers using AI assistants to quickly understand unfamiliar codebases
Architects comparing architecture changes before code review
Technical writers creating shareable interactive system docs
Teams presenting or training with visual system maps

zh.tag: 开源低延迟语音代理框架，支持全本地模块化VAD-STT-LLM-TTS流水线
zh.what: Hugging Face 推出的开源语音代理框架，通过一条 VAD → STT → LLM → TTS 的模块化流水线，让用户能在本地或混合环境中搭建低延迟语音对话系统。它对外暴露兼容 OpenAI Realtime API 的 WebSocket 接口，任何兼容客户端都能直接接入，且每个环节均可替换为自托管或开源模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含可插拔的流水线引擎、OpenAI Realtime 兼容的 WebSocket 服务端、开箱即用的 CLI，以及支持多语言和 Pocket TTS 的脚本与文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 构建，默认集成 Parakeet TDT（STT）与 Qwen3-TTS（语音合成），LLM 端支持 OpenAI API、HF Inference Providers、vLLM 及 llama.cpp 等任意兼容后端。
zh.hot: 在语音 Agent 爆发期，它以「全模块可替换 + 全本地可运行」直击开发者对隐私与可控性的痛点；本月新增 1,334 Star，总星数 6,149，冲上 Python 月榜第 10，并已实际部署在数千台 Reachy Mini 机器人上。
uses: 希望搭建本地语音助手、避免数据外泄的开发者与初创团队
需要将 LLM 快速接入语音交互、并要求兼容 OpenAI Realtime 协议的硬件/机器人厂商
关注低延迟对话系统、想自定义 VAD/STT/TTS 模块的研究者与工程师

en.tag: Low-latency modular voice-agent pipeline with fully local VAD-STT-LLM-TTS stack
en.what: An open-source voice-agent framework from Hugging Face that chains VAD → STT → LLM → TTS into a low-latency, fully modular pipeline for local or hybrid deployments. It exposes an OpenAI Realtime-compatible WebSocket API so any compatible client can connect, with every component swappable for self-hosted or open-source models.
en.content: The repo includes a pluggable pipeline engine, an OpenAI Realtime-compatible WebSocket server, a ready-to-use CLI, plus scripts and docs supporting multi-language and Pocket TTS.
en.stack: Built in Python, defaulting to Parakeet TDT for STT and Qwen3-TTS for synthesis, with the LLM slot supporting any OpenAI-compatible backend including hosted APIs, HF Inference Providers, vLLM, and llama.cpp.
en.hot: It hits the sweet spot for privacy and control with a fully swappable, fully local stack amid the voice-agent boom; it gained 1,334 stars this month for a total of 6,149, hitting #10 on the Python monthly trending list, and already powers thousands of Reachy Mini robots in production.
uses: Developers and startups building local voice assistants who need to keep data on-premise
Hardware/robotics vendors looking to add LLM-powered voice interfaces via an OpenAI Realtime-compatible protocol
Researchers and engineers experimenting with low-latency dialog systems who want to swap VAD, STT, or TTS components

zh.tag: 港大出品的 AI 私人家教：个性化终身学习工作区
zh.what: 香港大学 HKUDS 实验室的「agent 原生」学习平台：聊天辅导、刷题测验、深度研究、可视化、解题、Mastery Path 掌握度练习跑在同一套 agent 循环上。支持多引擎 RAG 知识库（LlamaIndex、PageIndex、GraphRAG、LightRAG，可挂 Obsidian 库），可从任意对话呼叫 Claude Code / Codex 等子 agent；带三层可检查记忆（L1 trace / L2 摘要 / L3 综合）和 Memory Graph 溯源。
zh.content: 完整 Web 应用（Python 后端 + Next.js 16 前端），附 11 种语言 README、Docker 部署、CLI/agent-native 接口、EduHub 社区 skills 生态；发版极勤。
zh.stack: Python 3.11+ + Next.js 16，RAG 多引擎 + MCP 工具 + FAISS 向量库，Apache-2.0；2025 年 12 月底创建，有 arXiv 论文背书。
zh.hot: 它把 AI 教育与 Agent 原生工作流结合，并由高校实验室持续维护，概念清晰、可体验性强。
uses: 学生 / 自学者 —— 把教材和论文喂进去，得到 24 小时私人家教
考研 / 考证党 —— 用刷题测验 + 掌握度路径系统备考
知识管理玩家 —— 直接挂 Obsidian 库做 RAG 问答

en.tag: An AI personal tutor from HKU: a lifelong, personalized learning workspace
en.what: An 'agent-native' learning platform from HKU's HKUDS lab: chat tutoring, quizzes, deep research, visualization, problem solving and Mastery-Path practice all run on one agent loop. It supports multi-engine RAG knowledge bases (LlamaIndex, PageIndex, GraphRAG, LightRAG — even your Obsidian vault), lets you call Claude Code / Codex sub-agents from any conversation, and ships three-layer inspectable memory (L1 trace / L2 summary / L3 synthesis) with a Memory Graph for provenance.
en.content: A full web app (Python backend + Next.js 16 frontend) with READMEs in 11 languages, Docker deployment, CLI/agent-native interfaces and the EduHub community skills ecosystem; releases ship very frequently.
en.stack: Python 3.11+ + Next.js 16, multi-engine RAG + MCP tools + FAISS; Apache-2.0; created late December 2025 with an arXiv paper behind it.
en.hot: It combines AI education with an agent-native workflow and carries the credibility of a university research lab, making the concept easy to evaluate and share.
uses: Students & self-learners — feed in textbooks and papers, get a 24/7 personal tutor
Exam candidates — prepare systematically with quizzes and the mastery path
PKM enthusiasts — plug your Obsidian vault straight in for RAG Q&A

zh.tag: 100+ 个能直接跑起来的 AI Agent 和 RAG 应用合集
zh.what: 超大号 LLM 应用模板库：收录 100 多个亲手构建并端到端测试过的 AI agent、agent skill 和 RAG 应用，全部 Apache-2.0 可商用。兼容 Claude、Gemini、GPT、DeepSeek、Llama、Qwen 等主流模型，克隆下来装依赖就能跑，口号「clone, customize, ship」。
zh.content: 按难度和形态分目录：agent_skills/（npx 一键装技能）、starter_ai_agents/（单文件入门）、advanced_ai_agents/（多智能体团队）、voice_ai_agents/、always_on_agents/、RAG 教程等；每个模板配 README 和依赖清单，场景覆盖旅行规划、金融分析、播客生成、房屋装修等。
zh.stack: Python 为主，常见 Streamlit 前端 + 各家模型 SDK，部分用 CrewAI/AG2 等多智能体框架。
zh.hot: 它用大量可运行示例降低 LLM 应用试验成本，并通过 Agent Skill 模板与教程保持对实践者的持续价值。
uses: AI 入门开发者 —— 克隆单文件模板，一天跑通第一个 LLM 应用
创业团队 —— 基于成熟模板二开（旅行规划 / 金融分析 / 播客生成）快速验证 idea
企业技术选型 —— 横向对比 CrewAI / AG2 等框架的真实代码

en.tag: 100+ AI Agent & RAG apps you can actually run
en.what: A giant library of LLM app templates: 100+ hand-built, end-to-end-tested AI agents, agent skills and RAG apps, all Apache-2.0 (commercial use OK). Works with Claude, Gemini, GPT, DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen and more — clone, install deps, run. The motto: 'clone, customize, ship'.
en.content: Organized by difficulty and form: agent_skills/ (one-line npx installs), starter_ai_agents/ (single-file starters), advanced_ai_agents/ (multi-agent teams), voice_ai_agents/, always_on_agents/, RAG tutorials and more; each template ships a README and requirements, covering travel planning, financial analysis, podcast generation, home renovation…
en.stack: Mostly Python, usually a Streamlit frontend over OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic SDKs, some CrewAI/AG2 multi-agent frameworks.
en.hot: Its broad, example-led catalog lowers the cost of trying LLM applications, while agent-skill templates and tutorials keep the collection useful to practitioners.
uses: AI beginners — clone a single-file template and ship your first LLM app in a day
Startup teams — fork mature templates (travel planning, finance analysis, podcast generation) to validate ideas fast
Enterprise evaluators — compare CrewAI / AG2 and other frameworks on real code

zh.tag: 开源版 CapCut（剪映），免费跨平台视频编辑器
zh.what: 免费开源视频编辑器，对标 CapCut，目标覆盖 Web、桌面和移动端。项目正在从零重写：Editor API、插件优先架构、Rust 核心（一套代码跑桌面/移动/浏览器）、供 AI agent 调用的 MCP server、无头批量渲染模式和编辑器内置脚本页。旧版代码已迁至 opencut-classic 继续维护。
zh.content: monorepo：apps/web、apps/desktop、apps/api 三个应用，根目录 Cargo.toml（Rust 核心）；用 moonrepo + proto 管理工具链，moon run web:dev 即可起本地开发。
zh.stack: TypeScript（Web 前端）+ Rust 核心，Bun 包管理，MIT；重写期间暂不接受外部代码贡献。
zh.hot: 「开源视频剪辑工具」满足了广泛需求，Rust 重写与基于 MCP 的 AI 剪辑能力又形成了清晰的技术差异。
uses: 自媒体创作者 —— 免费替代剪映专业版，无水印跨平台剪片
开发者 / 自动化团队 —— 通过 MCP server 让 AI agent 批量剪视频
企业 —— 基于 Editor API 和插件架构搭建内部视频流水线

en.tag: The open-source CapCut alternative — free, cross-platform video editing
en.what: A free, open-source video editor rivaling CapCut, targeting web, desktop and mobile. The project is being rewritten from scratch: an Editor API, plugin-first architecture, a Rust core (one codebase for desktop/mobile/browser), an MCP server so AI agents can edit video, a headless mode for automated batch rendering, and built-in editor scripting. Legacy code lives on in opencut-classic.
en.content: A monorepo: apps/web, apps/desktop and apps/api, with a root Cargo.toml for the Rust core; toolchain managed by moonrepo + proto — `moon run web:dev` starts local dev.
en.stack: TypeScript (web frontend) + Rust core, Bun for packages, MIT; external code contributions are paused during the rewrite.
en.hot: The open-source alternative to CapCut addresses broad latent demand, while the Rust rewrite and MCP-based AI editing story give the project a distinct technical direction.
uses: Content creators — a free, watermark-free CapCut Pro alternative across platforms
Dev & automation teams — batch-edit video via AI agents over the MCP server
Companies — build internal video pipelines on the Editor API and plugin architecture

zh.tag: 为 Claude 等 AI 提供终端控制、文件搜索与 diff 编辑的 MCP 服务器
zh.what: DesktopCommanderMCP 是一个基于 Model Context Protocol（MCP）的服务器，它让 Claude 等 AI 客户端能够直接控制用户终端、搜索文件系统并执行基于 diff 的代码编辑。它超越了传统 AI 编辑器的局限，允许 AI 在获得授权后运行长时间命令、管理进程和自动化本地开发任务，且无需额外 API Token 成本。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MCP 服务器源码、基于 TypeScript 的终端与文件系统工具集，以及一个独立的 Desktop Commander App（Beta），后者提供可视化文件预览、Markdown 编辑器和对多模型（Claude/GPT-4.5/Gemini 等）的支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，基于 MCP Filesystem Server 构建，通过 Model Context Protocol 与 Claude Desktop 等客户端通信，并支持 npm 分发安装。
zh.hot: 在 AI 编程助手爆发式增长的背景下，该仓库凭借 8,467 Star（本周新增 1,657，冲至周榜第 5）的势头，精准解决了 AI 无法直接操作本地终端和文件系统的痛点，让开发者能用自然语言驱动完整的本地开发工作流。
uses: 开发者 —— 想通过自然语言让 AI 直接执行终端命令、批量修改代码文件
AI 工具链集成者 —— 需要在 Claude Desktop 或其他 MCP 客户端中扩展本地文件与命令行能力
追求效率的自动化用户 —— 希望在一个聊天界面中完成代码检索、编辑和进程管理的全流程

en.tag: MCP server granting Claude terminal control, file search & diff editing
en.what: DesktopCommanderMCP is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that grants Claude and other AI clients terminal control, filesystem search, and diff-based file editing capabilities. It goes beyond conventional AI editors by letting AI execute long-running commands, manage processes, and automate local development tasks using the host client's subscription instead of extra API tokens.
en.content: The repository contains the MCP server source code, a TypeScript-based toolkit for terminal and filesystem operations, and a standalone Desktop Commander App (Beta) with visual file previews, a Markdown editor, and support for multiple AI models.
en.stack: Built primarily in TypeScript on top of the MCP Filesystem Server, it communicates with clients like Claude Desktop via the Model Context Protocol and is distributed via npm.
en.hot: Amid the AI coding assistant boom, it has surged to 8,467 stars with 1,657 added this week (ranking 5th on GitHub Trending), precisely solving the pain point of AI being unable to directly operate local terminals and filesystems, enabling developers to drive entire local workflows via natural language.
uses: Developers who want to execute terminal commands and batch-edit code via natural language instructions
AI toolchain integrators looking to extend Claude Desktop or other MCP clients with local filesystem and shell capabilities
Automation-minded users seeking a unified chat interface for code search, editing, and process management

zh.tag: 让 AI 一键操控 Office 文档的开源命令行套件
zh.what: OfficeCLI 是专为 AI 智能体设计的 Office 办公套件，让 AI 能够通过一行代码读取、编辑和自动化生成 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 文件。它内置高保真 HTML 渲染引擎，可将文档转为 HTML 或 PNG，使 AI 具备可视化审阅与修正的能力。无需安装 Microsoft Office，单个二进制文件即可跨平台运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OfficeCLI 的核心源码、单一可执行二进制发布文件，以及丰富的示例资源（GIF 展示、文档模板等）和多语言 README。其核心是一个内置 HTML 渲染引擎的 C# 命令行工具，支持 .docx/.xlsx/.pptx 的高保真解析与渲染。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C# 开发，以单一二进制文件形式发布，不依赖 Microsoft Office 或任何外部运行时，支持跨平台运行。内置自研 HTML 渲染引擎负责将 Office 文档转换为 HTML/PNG 供 AI 视觉闭环使用。
zh.hot: 作为首个专为 AI 智能体打造的 Office 自动化工具，它精准切中了 Agent 时代 AI 处理办公文档的刚需；凭借「一行代码 + 无需 Office」的极简体验，一周内激增 4,611 Star，总星数逼近 1.9 万，强势登上 GitHub 周榜第 10。
uses: AI 智能体开发者 —— 需要让 Agent 具备读写 Office 文档能力的工程师
自动化办公场景 —— 批量生成报告、幻灯片、数据表格的无代码/低代码工作流
RAG / 企业知识库建设者 —— 需要高精度解析 Word/Excel/PPT 内容并供 AI 理解的团队
跨平台运维人员 —— 在无 Office 环境的 Linux/服务器上处理 Office 文件

en.tag: Open-source CLI suite that gives AI agents full control over Office documents
en.what: OfficeCLI is an open-source Office suite purpose-built for AI agents, enabling them to read, edit, and automate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files through a single command. It features a built-in high-fidelity HTML rendering engine that converts documents to HTML or PNG, giving AI agents visual 'eyes' for review and correction. It runs as a single binary without requiring any Microsoft Office installation or dependencies.
en.content: The repository contains the core C# source code, single-binary releases, and rich showcase assets including GIF demos and multi-language documentation. Its centerpiece is a CLI tool with a built-in HTML rendering engine that faithfully parses and renders .docx, .xlsx, and .pptx files.
en.stack: Built primarily in C# and distributed as a single, self-contained binary with zero external dependencies and no Microsoft Office installation required. It includes a custom-built HTML rendering engine that converts Office documents into HTML or PNG for AI visual feedback loops.
en.hot: As the world's first Office suite built specifically for AI agents, it directly addresses the urgent need for automated document processing in the Agent era. Its 'one-line command, zero Office install' experience fueled a surge of 4,611 stars this week, bringing the total to nearly 19,000 and landing it at #10 on GitHub Trending.
uses: AI agent developers who need to equip agents with the ability to read and write Office documents
Automation workflows that batch-generate reports, presentations, and spreadsheets with minimal setup
RAG and enterprise knowledge-base builders requiring high-fidelity parsing of Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files
Cross-platform DevOps users who need to process Office files on Linux or servers without Microsoft Office installed

zh.tag: 开源 SEO 分析平台，支持 AI Agent 与 MCP 工具链集成
zh.what: OpenSEO 是 Semrush 和 Ahrefs 的开源替代品，提供关键词研究、排名追踪、竞品洞察、外链审计与站点诊断等核心 SEO 工作流。它采用按量付费模式，用户只需接入自己的 DataForSEO API 密钥即可使用，无需订阅。同时，它内置 MCP 服务器和可复用的 Agent Skills，让 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等 AI 代理直接调用 SEO 数据完成自动化任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的前后端应用代码与现代化 UI，支持 Docker 和 Cloudflare 自托管，内置 MCP 服务器以及预设的 Agent Skills（如 keyword-research、competitor-analysis、link-prospecting）。文档涵盖 API 密钥配置、Google Search Console 接入、SEO 成本参考及本地开发指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，前端采用现代 UI 框架，后端依赖 DataForSEO API 获取 SEO 数据，并通过 MCP 协议与外部 AI Agent 通信；支持 Docker 容器化部署与 Cloudflare 边缘托管。
zh.hot: 在 SEO 工具普遍昂贵且功能臃肿的背景下，它以开源、按量付费、可自托管的定位迅速获得关注；4,405 Stars 中本月新增 2,187 颗，登上 GitHub TypeScript 月榜第 17 名，其对 MCP 与 AI Agent 的原生集成进一步放大了开发者与增长团队的兴趣。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 无需订阅高价 SaaS，用自有 API 密钥低成本完成 SEO 监控与关键词研究。
AI 工程师 / Agent 开发者 —— 通过 MCP 将实时 SEO 数据接入 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等智能体，实现自动化内容策略。
增长与营销团队 —— 利用预设 Agent Skills 快速完成竞品分析、外链挖掘和排名追踪。
隐私敏感企业 —— 支持 Docker/Cloudflare 自托管，完全掌控数据与成本。

en.tag: Open-source SEO suite with AI agent & MCP integration for self-hosting
en.what: OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, offering keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlink audits, and site audits. It uses a pay-as-you-go model with your own DataForSEO API key instead of expensive subscriptions. It also exposes an MCP server and reusable Agent Skills so AI agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw can interact directly with SEO data.
en.content: The repository contains a full-stack application with a modern UI, supporting Docker and Cloudflare self-hosting, along with a built-in MCP server and pre-built Agent Skills (e.g., keyword-research, competitor-analysis, link-prospecting). Documentation covers API key setup, Google Search Console integration, SEO cost references, and local development guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, it features a modern frontend UI, relies on the DataForSEO API for search data, and communicates with external AI agents via the MCP protocol. It supports Docker containerization and Cloudflare edge hosting.
en.hot: It gained rapid traction as a free, pay-as-you-go, self-hostable alternative to expensive and bloated SEO suites; with 4,405 stars and 2,187 added this month alone—ranking 17th on GitHub's monthly TypeScript trending list—its native MCP and AI Agent support has further driven interest from developers and growth teams.
uses: Indie developers and small teams —— Avoid expensive subscriptions by using your own API key for low-cost SEO monitoring and keyword research.
AI engineers and agent builders —— Feed real-time SEO data into Claude Code, OpenClaw, or other agents via MCP for automated content strategy.
Growth and marketing teams —— Use pre-built Agent Skills to quickly run competitor analysis, link prospecting, and rank tracking.
Privacy-conscious organizations —— Self-host via Docker or Cloudflare to maintain full control over data and costs.

zh.tag: 个人 AI 交易代理，一条命令赋予全栈交易能力
zh.what: Vibe-Trading 是一个个人化的 AI 交易代理框架，只需一条命令即可部署具备完整市场分析、策略执行与风险管理能力的交易 Agent。它支持通过 API 和 MCP 协议与外部工具链集成，并配备 Shadow Account 模拟环境用于策略验证。项目由香港大学数据科学研究院（HKUDS）维护，提供从后端到前端的一站式解决方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含基于 FastAPI 的 Python 后端、React 19 构建的可视化前端，以及支持 PyPI 一键安装的 CLI 工具。同时提供示例代码、API/MCP 接口文档和 Shadow Account 模拟交易模块。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.11+ 开发，后端采用 FastAPI，前端使用 React 19，通过 PyPI 包 `vibe-trading-ai` 分发。支持 API 与 MCP 协议扩展，便于接入外部数据源和交易工具。
zh.hot: 仓库已积累 24.7k Star，本周激增 5,616 并冲上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 4，反映出 AI Agent 与量化金融结合的巨大关注度。其「一键启动个人交易代理」的极低门槛和 HKUDS 的学术背书，持续吸引开发者与交易者涌入。
uses: 量化交易者 —— 希望用 AI Agent 自动化策略执行与风险监控。
AI Agent 开发者 —— 需要基于 MCP 协议扩展金融交易能力的工具链。
金融科技爱好者 —— 想通过 Shadow Account 零成本验证和迭代交易策略。
全栈开发者 —— 寻求基于 FastAPI + React 的开源交易系统参考架构。

en.tag: Personal AI trading agent empowering comprehensive capabilities with one command

zh.tag: 把整个项目文件夹变成可查询知识图谱的 AI 技能
zh.what: 给 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码助手用的 skill：输入 /graphify，它就把整个项目（代码、SQL schema、文档、PDF、图片、视频）映射成一张可查询的知识图谱，代替 grep 翻文件。代码解析走 tree-sitter AST —— 确定性、不用 LLM、完全本地；文档类内容才走模型做语义处理。不是向量索引，是真图谱，每条边标注 EXTRACTED（直接读到）还是 INFERRED（推断出来）。
zh.content: 以 CLI 形式分发（PyPI 包 graphifyy，uv tool install 或 pipx 安装），仓库含 docs/（30 多种语言 README 翻译）和交互式 graph.html 可视化产物；默认分支 v8，迭代很快。
zh.stack: Python + tree-sitter 代码解析，产出力导向 HTML 图；挂到各家 CLI 助手上当 skill 用。
zh.hot: 它用知识图谱补足纯向量检索的局限，直接回应团队构建上下文型 AI 助手时遇到的 RAG 难题。
uses: 接手中大型老项目的开发者 —— 一条命令生成知识图谱，快速搞清代码结构
AI 重度用户 —— 给 agent 换图谱上下文，替代检索不准的向量 RAG
技术文档团队 —— 把文档 / PDF / 图纸一起纳入可查询图谱

en.tag: An AI skill that turns a whole project folder into a queryable knowledge graph
en.what: A skill for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI and more: type /graphify and your entire project — code, SQL schemas, docs, PDFs, images, videos — is mapped into a queryable knowledge graph, replacing grep-and-scroll. Code parsing uses tree-sitter AST: deterministic, no LLM, fully local; only document content goes through a model. Not a vector index — a real graph, with every edge labeled EXTRACTED (read directly) or INFERRED.
en.content: Distributed as a CLI (PyPI package graphifyy, install via uv tool install or pipx); the repo holds docs/ (README translations in 30+ languages) and interactive graph.html visualizations; default branch v8, iterating fast.
en.stack: Python + tree-sitter, outputting force-directed HTML graphs; hooks into each CLI assistant as a skill.
en.hot: Its knowledge-graph alternative to vector-only retrieval speaks directly to limitations teams encounter when building contextual AI assistants.
uses: Developers inheriting large legacy projects — one command maps the codebase into a knowledge graph
Heavy AI users — swap vector RAG for graph context that retrieves the right thing
Docs teams — fold docs, PDFs and diagrams into one queryable graph

zh.tag: 流式3D重建的几何上下文Transformer基础模型
zh.what: LingBot-Map 是一个前馈式 3D 基础模型，能够从流式数据中实时重建三维场景。它通过几何上下文 Transformer 架构，在单一流式框架内统一了坐标定位、密集几何线索编码与长程漂移校正。
zh.content: 仓库提供交互式演示脚本 demo.py、离线批量渲染管线，以及 KITTI 和 Oxford Spires 评估基准；预训练模型权重已同步发布在 HuggingFace 与 ModelScope。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 与 PyTorch 构建，核心采用 Transformer 架构，支持 SDPA 与 FlashInfer 双后端以加速超长序列的流式推理。
zh.hot: 该模型可在 518×378 分辨率下以约 20 FPS 稳定处理超 10,000 帧的长序列，月增 4,765 Star，总星数突破 12,000，跻身 GitHub Python 月榜第 18 名。
uses: 自动驾驶与机器人感知 —— 需要实时从连续视频流构建大规模 3D 场景地图。
AR/VR 内容生成 —— 为沉浸式应用提供高效的长序列几何重建与离线渲染能力。
计算机视觉研究者 —— 探索流式 3D 基础模型、几何 Transformer 与长程漂移校正的前沿方向。

en.tag: Geometric Context Transformer for real-time streaming 3D reconstruction
en.what: LingBot-Map is a feed-forward 3D foundation model that reconstructs scenes from streaming data in real time. It unifies coordinate grounding, dense geometric cues, and long-range drift correction within a single streaming framework via its Geometric Context Transformer architecture.
en.content: The repo ships an interactive demo script (`demo.py`), an offline rendering pipeline, and evaluation benchmarks for KITTI and Oxford Spires, with pretrained weights hosted on both HuggingFace and ModelScope.
en.stack: Built in Python on PyTorch with a Transformer core, supporting both SDPA and FlashInfer backends to accelerate inference over extremely long sequences.
en.hot: Delivering stable ~20 FPS inference at 518×378 across sequences exceeding 10,000 frames, the project gained 4,765 stars this month, surpassing 12,000 total and hitting #18 on GitHub’s monthly Python Trending list.
uses: Autonomous driving & robotics teams — for real-time large-scale 3D mapping from continuous video streams.
AR/VR content creators — seeking efficient long-sequence geometric reconstruction and offline rendering for immersive experiences.
Computer-vision researchers — exploring streaming 3D foundation models, geometric Transformers, and long-range drift correction.

zh.tag: LLM 结构化输出生成引擎

zh.hot: 本周新增 813 星，总星数超 1.5 万。LLM 应用开发中结构化输出是刚需，Outlines 提供优雅的解决方案，被 NVIDIA、Cohere、HuggingFace 等采用。
uses: 开发者构建需要可靠 JSON 输出的 LLM 应用（如 API 调用、数据提取）
需要跨模型切换且保持输出格式一致的项目
希望避免手动解析和验证 LLM 输出的团队

en.tag: Structured output generation engine for LLMs
en.what: Outlines is a library that guarantees LLM outputs conform to predefined structures (JSON, XML, Pydantic models, etc.). It constrains outputs during generation, avoiding fragile post-hoc parsing. Supports multiple model backends (OpenAI, vLLM, Ollama, etc.) with a unified API.
en.content: The repo contains the core library, model integrations (OpenAI, vLLM, Transformers, etc.), structured output types (JSON, Regex, Pydantic, etc.), examples, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily Python, depends on Pydantic, regex, and model backend SDKs (e.g., openai, vllm).
en.hot: Gained 813 stars this week, total over 15k. Structured output is a must-have in LLM app development; Outlines provides an elegant solution, adopted by NVIDIA, Cohere, HuggingFace, etc.
uses: Developers building LLM apps requiring reliable JSON output (e.g., API calls, data extraction)
Projects needing consistent output formats across different models

zh.hot: 拥有 36.7k Star 的 Fastify 凭借比 Express 更低的性能开销和原生的异步/等待支持，成为 Node.js 生态中构建高并发服务的首选框架之一。本周新增 85 Star 并冲入 JavaScript 周榜第 7，反映出社区对其 v5 版本稳定性与插件生态的持续认可。
uses: 需要支撑高并发 API 服务的后端开发团队
希望从 Express 迁移到更现代、更低开销框架的 Node.js 开发者
构建微服务架构并需要强大插件扩展能力的工程师
追求高性能日志与请求链路管理的运维型开发者

en.tag: High-performance, low-overhead Node.js web framework with plugin architecture
en.what: Fastify is a high-performance web framework for Node.js designed to deliver the best developer experience with minimal overhead. Its powerful plugin architecture enables developers to build scalable backend services that maintain excellent responsiveness under heavy load.
en.content: The repository contains the Fastify v5 core source code, complete TypeScript definitions, official website source, and comprehensive benchmarks. The core consists of a lightweight router, request lifecycle manager, and plugin system with extensive CI/CD workflows.
en.stack: Built on Node.js with JavaScript core and full TypeScript support. It relies on find-my-way for routing, Pino for logging, and the official @fastify plugin ecosystem.
en.hot: With 36.7k stars, Fastify has become a top choice for high-concurrency Node.js services by offering lower overhead than Express and native async/await support. Its 85 new stars this week and #7 spot on the JavaScript trending list reflect sustained community confidence in its v5 stability and plugin ecosystem.
uses: Backend teams building high-concurrency API services
Node.js developers migrating from Express to a more modern, lower-overhead framework
Engineers building microservices that require a powerful plugin extension system
Developers seeking high-performance logging and request lifecycle management

zh.tag: JavaScript 代码检查与修复工具
zh.what: ESLint 是一个用于识别和报告 ECMAScript/JavaScript 代码中模式的工具，类似于 JSLint 和 JSHint，但使用 Espree 解析器，基于 AST 评估代码模式，并且完全可插拔，每条规则都是一个插件，可以在运行时添加更多规则。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ESLint 的核心源代码、文档（网站、配置指南、规则列表）、贡献指南、行为准则、问题报告模板、常见问题、发布说明、安全政策、语义化版本政策、ESM 依赖说明、许可证、团队和赞助商信息。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js（要求 ^20.19.0、^22.13.0 或 >=24），使用 Espree 解析器，支持 TypeScript 类型定义（需要 TypeScript 5.3+），可通过 npm 或 pnpm 安装。
zh.hot: ESLint 是 JavaScript 生态中最流行的代码检查工具，月增 251 星，总星数达 27449，持续保持高热度，因为它是保证代码质量和一致性的必备工具。
uses: JavaScript/TypeScript 开发者：在开发过程中自动检查代码错误和风格问题。
团队协作：通过共享配置统一代码风格，减少代码审查中的争议。
CI/CD 流程：集成到持续集成中，在合并前自动检查代码质量。
开源项目维护者：为项目贡献者提供代码规范，保证代码库健康。

en.tag: Find and fix problems in your JavaScript code
en.what: ESLint is a tool for identifying and reporting on patterns found in ECMAScript/JavaScript code. It is similar to JSLint and JSHint but uses Espree for parsing, evaluates patterns via AST, and is completely pluggable—every rule is a plugin and you can add more at runtime.
en.content: The repository contains ESLint's core source code, documentation (website, configuration guide, rules list), contribution guide, code of conduct, issue templates, FAQ, release notes, security policy, semantic versioning policy, ESM dependencies, license, team, and sponsors.
en.stack: Built on Node.js (requires ^20.19.0, ^22.13.0, or >=24), uses Espree parser, supports TypeScript type definitions (requires TypeScript 5.3+), installable via npm or pnpm.
en.hot: ESLint is the most popular linting tool in the JavaScript ecosystem, gaining 251 stars this month to reach 27,449 total, maintaining high popularity as an essential tool for code quality and consistency.
uses: JavaScript/TypeScript developers: automatically catch errors and style issues during development.
Team collaboration: unify code style via shared configs, reducing review disputes.
CI/CD pipelines: integrate into continuous integration to check code quality before merge.
Open source maintainers: provide contribution guidelines to keep the codebase healthy.

zh.tag: 基于 React 的全栈 Web 框架
zh.what: Next.js 是一个基于 React 的全栈 Web 框架，支持服务端渲染、静态生成和增量静态再生。它提供了文件系统路由、API 路由、中间件等开箱即用的功能，让开发者可以快速构建高性能的 Web 应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Next.js 的核心源码、文档、示例以及贡献指南。主要目录包括 packages（核心包）、examples（示例应用）、test（测试）等。
zh.stack: 基于 React 和 Node.js，使用 Rust 编写的 Turbopack 作为打包工具。依赖包括 React、Webpack（可选）、Babel 等。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的 React 框架之一，Next.js 拥有超过 141k 的 Star，持续活跃的社区和 Vercel 的商业支持使其长期占据 GitHub 热门榜。
uses: 前端开发者 —— 构建全栈 React 应用的首选框架
团队/企业 —— 需要高性能、SEO 友好的生产级 Web 应用
初创公司 —— 快速搭建 MVP 或产品级网站

en.tag: The React Framework for Production
en.what: Next.js is a React-based full-stack web framework that supports server-side rendering, static generation, and incremental static regeneration. It provides file-system routing, API routes, middleware, and other out-of-the-box features, enabling developers to quickly build high-performance web applications.
en.content: The repository contains Next.js core source code, documentation, examples, and contribution guidelines. Key directories include packages (core packages), examples (sample apps), test (tests), etc.
en.stack: Built on React and Node.js, with Turbopack (Rust-based) as the bundler. Dependencies include React, Webpack (optional), Babel, etc.
en.hot: As one of the most popular React frameworks, Next.js has over 141k stars, with an active community and commercial support from Vercel, keeping it consistently trending on GitHub.
uses: Frontend developers — the go-to framework for building full-stack React apps
Teams/enterprises — need high-performance, SEO-friendly production web apps
Startups — quickly build MVP or production-grade websites

zh.tag: 跨平台隐私优先语音转文字工具，支持本地与云端模型
zh.what: OpenWhispr 是一款开源的桌面端语音听写应用，用户可通过全局热键在任何软件中将语音实时转为文字。它支持完全离线的本地转录（Whisper / NVIDIA Parakeet），也允许接入自有密钥的云模型，确保音频数据不出本地即可隐私可控地完成输入。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的跨平台桌面客户端源码与构建产物，覆盖 macOS、Windows、Linux 的全局热键、语音听写、会议转录、AI 笔记及 Agent 功能模块，并附带安装包、API 文档与官网。
zh.stack: 项目以 JavaScript 为主语言开发，基于 Electron 或同类跨平台桌面框架，前端采用现代 Web 技术栈，后端通过本地绑定集成 Whisper 与 NVIDIA Parakeet，并提供 REST API 以对接第三方云服务。
zh.hot: 在 WisprFlow、Granola 等付费语音转写工具备受关注的背景下，OpenWhispr 以“完全开源、零数据收集”的隐私定位成为热门替代方案，本月新增 802 Star，累计达 4,617 Star，跻身 GitHub JavaScript 月榜第 10 名。
uses: 需要高效语音输入的写作者与开发者——通过全局热键在任意编辑器中快速 dictation。
对隐私敏感的用户与团队——利用本地模型实现完全离线的会议转录与笔记生成。
寻求免费替代方案的知识工作者——以开源方案替换 WisprFlow/Granola 进行日常语音记录。

en.tag: Privacy-first cross-platform voice-to-text dictation with local & cloud models
en.what: OpenWhispr is an open-source desktop dictation app that turns speech into text anywhere via a global hotkey. It offers fully offline transcription with local engines like Whisper and NVIDIA Parakeet, or cloud processing via BYOK, keeping user audio data private and under their own control.
en.content: The repository includes the full cross-platform desktop client source and release builds for macOS, Windows, and Linux, featuring global hotkey handling, voice dictation, meeting transcription, AI note-taking, and agent modules, plus API docs and a website.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript and built on a cross-platform desktop framework (likely Electron or Tauri) with a modern web-based UI, it binds locally to Whisper and NVIDIA Parakeet for on-device inference and exposes REST APIs for optional cloud integration.
en.hot: Positioned as a free, open-source and zero-telemetry alternative to paid tools like WisprFlow and Granola, OpenWhispr gained strong traction this month with 802 new stars, reaching 4,617 total stars and ranking #10 on GitHub’s JavaScript monthly trending chart.
uses: Writers and developers needing efficient voice input — dictate into any editor via a global hotkey.
Privacy-conscious users and teams — run fully offline meeting transcription and note-taking with local models.
Knowledge workers seeking free alternatives — replace paid tools like WisprFlow or Granola for daily voice logging.

zh.tag: 面向AI代理的HTML交互式编辑器，支持本地人机协作反馈
zh.what: Lavish 是一款本地优先的 HTML 制品编辑器，专为 AI 代理生成的富交互内容设计。它让开发者直接在浏览器中审阅、标注和修改 HTML 文件，并通过 AXI 协议将反馈无缝回传给 Agent，替代低效的截图与长文本沟通。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Lavish Editor 的核心 CLI、AXI 接口实现、本地浏览器渲染引擎，以及面向 Agent Skills 的 npx skills 安装钩子。README 还提供了面向产品计划、技术方案等场景的内置可视化模板。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js 构建，以 CLI 形式分发，通过 npm 发布；支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 跨平台运行。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1,445 星，以 1,967 星登上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 月榜第 5。它精准切中了 AI Agent 时代“生成 HTML 容易、协作修改难”的痛点，用本地优先和 AXI 协议重新定义了人机协作的编辑体验。
uses: 使用 AI 编程助手并需要可视化审阅 Agent 生成 HTML 报告/原型的开发者
需要与 Agent 进行精细化交互反馈而非截图和文字的产品经理与技术负责人
希望本地安全运行、不愿将 HTML 制品上传云端的企业与隐私敏感用户

en.tag: Local-first interactive HTML editor for human-AI collaboration on agent artifacts.
en.what: Lavish is a local-first HTML editor designed for AI agent-generated rich artifacts. It lets users review, annotate, and edit rendered HTML directly in the browser, then sends structured feedback back to agents via the AXI protocol—replacing inefficient screenshots and long text messages.
en.content: The repo contains the core CLI, AXI interface, local browser rendering engine, and npx skills install hooks for agent integration. It also ships with built-in visualization templates for product planning and technical design scenarios.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript/Node.js and distributed as a cross-platform CLI via npm, supporting macOS, Linux, and Windows.
en.hot: It gained 1,445 stars this month, hitting 1,967 total and ranking 5th on GitHub's monthly JavaScript Trending. It nails the pain point that HTML is easy for agents to generate but hard for humans to collaboratively refine, redefining the human-AI editing loop with local-first principles and the AXI protocol.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants who need to visually review agent-generated HTML reports or prototypes
Product managers and tech leads seeking precise interactive feedback loops with agents instead of screenshots
Privacy-conscious users and enterprises wanting local-first execution without uploading artifacts to the cloud

zh.tag: 用 Claude 操控 TradingView 图表的 AI 助手桥
zh.what: 这是一个 MCP 服务器，通过 Chrome DevTools 协议将 Claude Code 连接到本地运行的 TradingView 桌面应用，实现 AI 辅助的图表分析、Pine Script 开发和流程自动化。所有数据处理均在本地完成，不传输外部。
zh.content: 包含 MCP 服务器实现、CDP 通信模块、Pine Script 辅助工具和示例配置。提供工具让 LLM 读取图表状态、执行脚本并获取反馈。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js，使用 Chrome DevTools Protocol 与 Electron 应用通信，MCP 协议与 Claude Code 集成。
zh.hot: 将 LLM 代理与专业交易工具结合，满足交易者自动化分析需求，4543 Stars 日增 28，登顶 JavaScript 日榜第 3。
uses: 交易者：用自然语言分析图表、编写 Pine Script 策略
开发者：研究 LLM 代理与桌面金融应用的交互模式
量化研究员：自动化回测与指标提取

en.tag: AI bridge connecting Claude Code to TradingView Desktop for chart analysis & automation
en.what: An MCP server that connects Claude Code to your locally running TradingView Desktop via Chrome DevTools Protocol, enabling AI-assisted chart analysis, Pine Script development, and workflow automation. All data processing stays local.
en.content: Includes MCP server implementation, CDP communication module, Pine Script helpers, and example configs. Provides tools for LLM to read chart state, execute scripts, and get feedback.
en.stack: Node.js-based, uses Chrome DevTools Protocol to communicate with Electron apps, integrates with Claude Code via MCP protocol.
en.hot: Combines LLM agents with professional trading tools, meeting traders' automation needs. 4543 stars (+28/day), #3 on JavaScript daily trending.
uses: Traders: analyze charts and write Pine Script strategies via natural language
Developers: study LLM agent interaction with desktop financial apps
Quant researchers: automate backtesting and indicator extraction

zh.tag: 跨平台 JavaScript 运行时环境
zh.what: Node.js 是一个开源的、跨平台的 JavaScript 运行时环境，允许在服务器端运行 JavaScript 代码。它基于 V8 引擎，采用事件驱动、非阻塞 I/O 模型，适合构建高性能网络应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Node.js 核心源码、构建系统、测试套件、文档及治理文件。提供 Current、LTS 和 Nightly 三种发布类型，支持多平台二进制下载。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 JavaScript 和 C++，依赖 V8 引擎、libuv、OpenSSL 等底层库。构建系统使用 GYP 和 Makefile。
zh.hot: 作为 JavaScript 生态的基石，Node.js 持续获得广泛关注，今日新增 36 星，总星数超 11.8 万，稳居日榜第 7。
uses: 后端开发者 —— 构建高性能 Web 服务、API 和微服务
全栈开发者 —— 使用同一语言开发前后端
DevOps 工程师 —— 构建命令行工具和自动化脚本
初学者 —— 学习服务器端 JavaScript 编程

en.tag: Cross-platform JavaScript runtime environment
en.what: Node.js is an open-source, cross-platform JavaScript runtime environment that executes JavaScript code server-side. Built on the V8 engine, it uses an event-driven, non-blocking I/O model, making it ideal for high-performance network applications.
en.content: The repository contains Node.js core source code, build system, test suite, documentation, and governance files. It offers Current, LTS, and Nightly release types with multi-platform binary downloads.
en.stack: Primary languages are JavaScript and C++, with dependencies on V8 engine, libuv, OpenSSL, etc. Build system uses GYP and Makefile.
en.hot: As the cornerstone of the JavaScript ecosystem, Node.js continues to attract widespread attention, gaining 36 stars today with over 118k total stars, ranking 7th on the daily trending list.
uses: Backend developers — building high-performance web services, APIs, and microservices
Full-stack developers — using the same language for frontend and backend
DevOps engineers — building CLI tools and automation scripts
Beginners — learning server-side JavaScript programming

zh.tag: 非官方 ChatGPT Linux 桌面端，从 macOS 官方包提取并本地构建
zh.what: 该项目将 OpenAI 官方仅提供 macOS 版本的 ChatGPT 桌面应用（含 Chat、Work、Codex）转换为可在 Linux 运行的 Electron 应用。它通过提取上游 DMG 文件、应用 Linux 兼容性补丁并重建原生模块，最终打包成多种 Linux 发行版支持的安装格式。
zh.content: 仓库包含从 macOS DMG 提取、打补丁、构建原生模块的完整脚本，以及用于 Debian/Ubuntu、Fedora、Arch 和 Nix 的安装包配置；可选的 Linux 专属功能存放在 `linux-features/` 目录，同时提供 AppImage 自构建和本地更新管理器支持。
zh.stack: 基于 Electron 与 JavaScript 开发，依赖 Node.js 运行时；构建系统使用 Makefile 驱动，通过 CI 工作流自动化打包 .deb、.rpm、pacman 及 AppImage，并支持 Wayland 与 X11 显示协议。
zh.hot: OpenAI 迟迟未推出官方 Linux 客户端，该项目填补了空白；本周新增 395 Star 并登上 JavaScript 周榜第 5，反映出 Linux 开发者对原生 ChatGPT 桌面体验的强烈需求。
uses: Linux 开发者/用户 —— 想在 Debian、Fedora、Arch 等发行版上获得原生 ChatGPT 桌面体验
AI 重度使用者 —— 需要本地安装 Chat、Work 和 Codex 功能，而非仅使用网页版
偏好桌面端工作流的用户 —— 希望利用系统级快捷键、本地集成和离线更新管理
开源社区贡献者 —— 参与非官方 Linux 适配、Electron 跨平台补丁与打包流程改进

en.tag: Unofficial ChatGPT Desktop for Linux, extracted & rebuilt from official macOS DMG
en.what: This project converts OpenAI's official macOS-only ChatGPT Desktop app (including Chat, Work, and Codex) into a runnable Linux Electron application. It extracts the upstream DMG, applies Linux compatibility patches, rebuilds native modules, and packages the result for various Linux distributions.
en.content: The repository contains complete scripts for extracting the macOS DMG, applying patches, and rebuilding native modules, alongside packaging configs for Debian/Ubuntu, Fedora, Arch, and Nix. Optional Linux-only integrations live in `linux-features/`, with support for AppImage self-builds and a local update manager.
en.stack: Built with Electron and JavaScript, requiring Node.js; the build system is driven by Makefiles and CI workflows that automate packaging into .deb, .rpm, pacman, and AppImage formats, with support for both Wayland and X11.
en.hot: With no official Linux client from OpenAI, this project fills a critical gap; it gained 395 stars this week and hit #5 on the JavaScript Trending list, reflecting strong demand from Linux users for a native ChatGPT desktop experience.
uses: Linux developers/users seeking a native ChatGPT desktop experience on Debian, Fedora, Arch, and other distros.
Power users who need local access to Chat, Work, and Codex features instead of relying solely on the web app.
Desktop-centric workflow users wanting system-level shortcuts, local integrations, and an offline update manager.
Open-source contributors interested in unofficial Linux ports, Electron cross-platform patching, and packaging improvements.

zh.tag: Nuclei 引擎的社区漏洞检测模板库
zh.what: 这是 Nuclei 扫描引擎的官方模板仓库，存储由团队和社区贡献的各类安全检测模板。这些模板定义了如何检测应用中的安全漏洞，是 Nuclei 扫描器的核心部分。
zh.content: 仓库包含数千个 YAML 格式的模板，按漏洞类型、严重性、目录等分类，并提供统计文件（TEMPLATES-STATS.md 和 JSON）以及针对 CISA KEV 等已知被利用漏洞的覆盖。
zh.stack: 模板使用 YAML 编写，依赖 Nuclei 引擎（Go 编写）执行。项目本身主要包含模板文件和统计生成脚本，主语言标记为 JavaScript 可能因统计工具。
zh.hot: 拥有 12766 颗星，今日新增 9 颗，位列 JavaScript 日榜第 8。作为安全扫描的核心资源，持续吸引社区贡献，覆盖大量已知漏洞，是安全研究者的必备工具。
uses: 安全研究人员：快速检测目标应用是否存在已知漏洞
渗透测试人员：利用现成模板进行漏洞扫描和验证
DevSecOps 工程师：集成到 CI/CD 流程中实现自动化安全测试
CTF 玩家：查找和利用常见漏洞模板

en.tag: Community-curated templates for the Nuclei vulnerability scanner
en.what: This is the official template repository for the Nuclei scanning engine, storing security detection templates contributed by the team and community. These templates define how to detect vulnerabilities in applications and are the core of the Nuclei scanner.
en.content: The repository contains thousands of YAML templates categorized by vulnerability type, severity, directory, etc., along with statistics files (TEMPLATES-STATS.md and JSON) and coverage for known exploited vulnerabilities like CISA KEV.
en.stack: Templates are written in YAML and rely on the Nuclei engine (written in Go) for execution. The project mainly contains template files and statistics generation scripts; the primary language is marked as JavaScript possibly due to tooling.
en.hot: With 12,766 stars and 9 new stars today, ranking 8th on the JavaScript daily trending list. As a core resource for security scanning, it continuously attracts community contributions, covers numerous known vulnerabilities, and is essential for security researchers.
uses: Security researchers: quickly detect known vulnerabilities in target applications
Penetration testers: use ready-made templates for vulnerability scanning and verification
DevSecOps engineers: integrate into CI/CD pipelines for automated security testing
CTF players: find and exploit common vulnerability templates

zh.tag: 现代 JavaScript 实用工具库，模块化与性能兼备
zh.what: Lodash 是一个流行的 JavaScript 实用工具库，提供数组、对象、字符串等操作的模块化方法，简化日常编码。它支持多种构建（完整版、核心版、FP 版），并可通过 npm 或浏览器直接使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含源码、构建脚本（lodash-cli）、文档、测试和配置文件。主要目录有 dist/（预构建文件）、test/、以及按类别划分的模块源码。
zh.stack: 纯 JavaScript 实现，无运行时依赖。构建工具为 lodash-cli，支持 UMD 模块格式，兼容现代环境。
zh.hot: Lodash 作为 JavaScript 生态的基石，拥有 6 万+ Star，月增 106，持续稳居趋势榜。近期获得 OpenJS 基金会支持，治理重启，确保长期稳定维护，引发社区关注。
uses: 前端开发者：快速处理数组、对象、字符串等常见操作，减少重复代码。
Node.js 后端开发者：在服务端使用模块化方法提升开发效率。
学习 JavaScript 函数式编程：通过 FP 构建体验自动柯里化和数据优先风格。
维护旧项目：作为稳定依赖，提供兼容性补丁和性能优化。

en.tag: A modern JavaScript utility library delivering modularity, performance, & extras.
en.what: Lodash is a popular JavaScript utility library providing modular methods for arrays, objects, strings, etc., simplifying everyday coding. It supports multiple builds (full, core, FP) and can be used via npm or directly in the browser.
en.content: The repository contains source code, build scripts (lodash-cli), documentation, tests, and configuration files. Main directories include dist/ (pre-built files), test/, and module sources organized by category.

zh.tag: Tailwind CSS 最流行的免费开源组件库
zh.what: daisyUI 是一个基于 Tailwind CSS 的组件库，提供大量即用型 UI 组件，无需编写自定义 CSS。它通过简单的类名即可快速构建美观的界面，并支持主题定制。

en.what: A 100% client-side tool for removing watermarks from Gemini AI-generated images and videos. Privacy-conscious users, as all processing is local with no uploads

zh.tag: 用 Rust 重写的高性能 Minecraft 服务端

zh.tag: 开源可扩展的离线语音转录桌面工具

zh.hot: 在隐私焦虑与云服务费高涨的背景下，Handy 以「完全开源、完全离线」的差异化定位迅速获得开发者关注，本月新增近 3,000 Star，累计突破 2.6 万，登榜 GitHub Rust 月榜第 17 名。

开发者与极客 —— 希望 Fork 并二次扩展自定义模型或工作流的技术用户。

en.tag: Free, open-source & extensible offline speech-to-text desktop app
en.what: Handy is a cross-platform desktop speech-to-text app that transcribes your voice entirely offline with a privacy-first approach. Press a configurable shortcut, speak, and it pastes the transcribed text directly into any text field. All audio processing happens locally on your machine, with no data sent to the cloud.

Developers & tinkers — technical users who want to fork and extend custom models or workflows.
Cross-platform workers — remote workers on Windows, macOS, or Linux seeking efficient offline dictation.
Accessibility seekers — users needing assistive voice-input tools without paid subscriptions.

zh.tag: Git 工作树 + tmux 窗口的零摩擦并行开发管理器，专为 AI Agent 打造
zh.what: workmux 是一款高度定制化的终端工作流工具，通过将 git worktree 与 tmux（以及 kitty、WezTerm、Zellij 等）窗口一一绑定，为每个任务提供独立的开发环境。它特别适合同时运行多个 AI Agent 进行并行编码，无需 stash 或切换分支，实现真正的零摩擦上下文切换。

uses: 需要同时维护多个功能分支、避免频繁切换上下文的终端开发者
在本地并行运行多个 AI Agent（如编码、review、测试）的工程师
使用 tmux/Zellij/Kitty 等终端复用器并追求自动化工作流的重度 CLI 用户
希望一键清理（合并分支、删除 worktree、关闭窗口）的全栈开发者

en.tag: Git worktree + tmux parallel dev manager built for AI agents
en.what: workmux is a highly opinionated terminal workflow tool that pairs git worktrees with tmux (and kitty, WezTerm, Zellij) windows to create isolated dev environments per task. Its 'zero-friction' philosophy of leveraging existing terminal tools rather than new GUIs directly addresses developer pain points in managing multi-agent workflows.
uses: Terminal developers juggling multiple feature branches who want to avoid constant context switching
Engineers running multiple AI agents (coding, review, testing) in parallel locally
Heavy CLI users of tmux/Zellij/Kitty seeking automated, opinionated workflows
Full-stack developers who want one-command cleanup after merging branches

zh.tag: 本地优先的 AI 会议助手，实时转录并自动总结纪要

uses: 企业合规团队 —— 需在完全离线环境下处理敏感会议内容，满足数据主权与隐私合规要求。
远程办公用户 —— 希望自动获得带说话人分离的实时转录与会议纪要，无需上传云端。
开发者与隐私爱好者 —— 寻求可自托管、可审计的开源会议工具，并能基于 Rust 源码二次定制。

en.what: Meetily is a Rust-built, privacy-first AI meeting assistant that delivers 100% on-device live transcription, speaker diarization, and smart summarization for macOS and Windows. Remote professionals —— Automatically obtain real-time transcripts with speaker diarization and summaries without cloud uploads.

Consulting and legal sectors —— Handle confidential client conversations with locally stored, fully controllable AI meeting records.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 重写的极速 Python 包与项目管理器
zh.what: uv 是一个用 Rust 编写的 Python 包和项目管理工具，旨在替代 pip、pip-tools、pipx、poetry、pyenv 等多个工具。它提供比 pip 快 10-100 倍的性能，并支持项目依赖管理、脚本运行、Python 版本管理等功能。

CI/CD 环境：利用其速度和缓存机制，减少构建时间
多版本 Python 管理：通过 uv 安装和管理不同 Python 版本
脚本运行：直接运行带内联依赖声明的 Python 脚本

en.tag: An extremely fast Python package and project manager written in Rust
en.what: uv is a Python package and project manager written in Rust, designed to replace pip, pip-tools, pipx, poetry, pyenv, and more. It is 10-100x faster than pip and offers comprehensive project management, script execution, and Python version management.
en.content: The repository contains uv's Rust source code, documentation, benchmarks, and installation scripts. Key components include a CLI, dependency resolver, global cache, and lockfile mechanism.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, leveraging the crates.io ecosystem. Installable via curl or pip without requiring Rust or Python.
en.hot: uv has gained massive popularity due to its incredible speed and comprehensive features, amassing 88k+ stars. With 354 new stars this week, ranking #9 on the Rust weekly trending list, it reflects developers' strong demand for high-performance Python tooling.
uses: Python developers: replace pip and poetry for faster dependency installation and project management
CI/CD environments: leverage speed and caching to reduce build times
Multi-version Python management: install and manage Python versions via uv
Script running: run Python scripts with inline dependency metadata

zh.tag: 比 MinIO 快 2.3 倍的 S3 兼容对象存储
zh.what: RustFS 是一个基于 Rust 构建的高性能分布式对象存储系统，兼容 S3 API。它针对小对象（如 4KB）进行了极致优化，性能可达 MinIO 的 2.3 倍，同时支持与 MinIO、Ceph 等平台无缝迁移和共存。

zh.stack: 主要编程语言为 Rust，依赖 Tokio 异步运行时、S3 兼容库（如 aws-sdk-s3）、以及 RocksDB 或自研存储引擎。
zh.hot: 凭借比 MinIO 快 2.3 倍的性能优势和 Rust 的内存安全特性，RustFS 在 GitHub 上获得 30k+ Stars，并登上 Trending 周榜。其 S3 兼容性降低了迁移成本，吸引了大量数据湖和 AI 场景用户。
uses: 数据湖与 AI 训练场景 —— 需要高性能小对象存储的机器学习平台
替代 MinIO/Ceph —— 追求更高吞吐和更低延迟的 S3 兼容存储
边缘计算与 IoT —— 轻量级分布式存储部署在资源受限环境
云原生基础设施 —— 作为 Kubernetes 的持久化存储后端

en.tag: 2.3x faster than MinIO for small objects, S3-compatible object storage
en.what: RustFS is a high-performance, distributed object storage system built in Rust, compatible with S3 API. It is extremely optimized for small objects (e.g., 4KB), achieving 2.3x the performance of MinIO, while supporting seamless migration and coexistence with other S3-compatible platforms like MinIO and Ceph.
en.content: The repository contains the core storage engine, S3 API gateway, CLI tools, Docker deployment configs, and comprehensive documentation with examples. The project uses a modular architecture supporting distributed deployment and horizontal scaling.
en.stack: Primarily built in Rust, relying on Tokio async runtime, S3-compatible libraries (e.g., aws-sdk-s3), and RocksDB or custom storage engine.
en.hot: With 2.3x performance advantage over MinIO and Rust's memory safety, RustFS has gained 30k+ stars on GitHub and made it to the Trending weekly list. Its S3 compatibility reduces migration costs, attracting users in data lake and AI scenarios.
uses: Data lakes & AI training — high-performance small object storage for ML platforms
MinIO/Ceph replacement — S3-compatible storage with higher throughput and lower latency
Edge computing & IoT — lightweight distributed storage for resource-constrained environments
Cloud-native infrastructure — persistent storage backend for Kubernetes

zh.tag: Rust 全栈跨平台 UI 框架，一套代码覆盖 Web、桌面与移动端
zh.what: Dioxus 是一个基于 Rust 的全栈应用框架，开发者只需维护一套代码库即可构建 Web、桌面和移动应用。它提供了类似 React 的组件化开发体验，并内置基于 Signals 的状态管理、热重载与零配置启动能力。通过 Server Functions 还能直接在同一代码库中编写后端逻辑，实现真正的全栈开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 UI 库、跨平台渲染器（Web/桌面/移动端）、CLI 打包工具以及 Server Functions 全栈运行时。此外还提供了丰富的官方示例、文档站点和多语言 README，方便开发者快速上手。
zh.stack: 完全基于 Rust 生态，核心使用自研的 Virtual DOM 与 Signals 响应式系统，编译目标涵盖 WebAssembly、桌面端（基于 Winit/Tao）及移动端原生渲染。
zh.hot: 凭借 36.8K Star 的热度和本周 Rust 趋势榜第 18 名的成绩，Dioxus 吸引了大量希望用 Rust 替代 JavaScript 技术栈的开发者。其“一套代码、多端运行”的全栈能力，加上对热重载和零配置体验的重视，精准击中了 Rust 社区对高性能跨平台 UI 方案的强烈需求。
uses: Rust 开发者 —— 希望用单一代码库同时覆盖前端页面与桌面/移动原生应用的项目。
全栈工程师 —— 想在前端组件中直接调用 Server Functions，减少前后端语言切换成本的团队。
跨平台应用团队 —— 需要高性能、内存安全且拒绝 Electron 厚重方案的产品组。

en.tag: Rust fullstack cross-platform UI framework for web, desktop, and mobile
en.what: Dioxus is a Rust-based fullstack framework that lets developers build for the web, desktop, and mobile from a single codebase. It offers a React-like component model with zero-config setup, integrated hot-reloading, and signals-based state management. Server Functions enable backend logic to live alongside the UI, streamlining fullstack development in Rust.
en.content: The repo contains the core UI library, cross-platform renderers for web, desktop, and mobile, a CLI bundler, and a fullstack runtime for Server Functions. It also ships with extensive examples, documentation, and multilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Built entirely on Rust, featuring a custom Virtual DOM and signals-based reactivity, compiling to WebAssembly, desktop (via Winit/Tao), and mobile native targets.
en.hot: With 36.8K stars and ranking 18th on this week's GitHub Rust Trending, Dioxus is drawing developers eager to replace JavaScript stacks with Rust. Its promise of a single codebase spanning web, desktop, and mobile—backed by hot-reload and zero-config DX—directly addresses the Rust community's demand for high-performance cross-platform UI solutions.
uses: Rust developers —— teams wanting a single codebase for web, desktop, and mobile apps without sacrificing performance.
Fullstack engineers —— those looking to colocate Server Functions with UI components to cut language-switching overhead.

zh.tag: 基于 Rust 的现代化 JavaScript/TypeScript 安全运行时
zh.what: Deno 是一个基于 V8、Rust 和 Tokio 构建的 JavaScript、TypeScript 与 WebAssembly 运行时，默认启用安全沙箱和权限控制。它提供出色的开发者体验，可用于构建 Web 服务器、CLI 工具及各类现代应用。

zh.stack: 核心引擎基于 Google V8 执行 JavaScript，底层使用 Rust 编写，异步 IO 由 Tokio 驱动，并支持 WebAssembly。
zh.hot: 作为 Node.js 的现代化替代方案，Deno 凭借原生 TypeScript 支持、内置安全权限和单一可执行文件等优势持续吸引开发者。目前累计获星 107,711 颗，本周新增 290 星并跻身 Rust 语言周榜第 12 位。
uses: 前端/后端开发者：希望用原生 TypeScript 开发高性能 Web 服务与 API。
DevOps 与 CLI 工具开发者：需要安全沙箱和单一可执行文件部署脚本。
Rust/JavaScript 混合生态建设者：寻求基于 V8 和 Rust 的高性能运行时。

en.tag: Modern Rust-based JavaScript/TypeScript runtime with secure defaults
en.what: Deno is a JavaScript, TypeScript, and WebAssembly runtime built on V8, Rust, and Tokio, featuring secure-by-default permissions and sandboxing. It delivers a great developer experience for building web servers, CLI tools, and modern applications.

en.stack: Built on the Google V8 engine for JavaScript execution, with a Rust-written core and Tokio-powered asynchronous I/O, plus WebAssembly support.
en.hot: As a modern alternative to Node.js, Deno continues to attract developers with native TypeScript support, built-in security permissions, and a single executable. It has amassed 107,711 stars, gaining 290 this week and ranking 12th on the Rust trending chart.
uses: Frontend/backend developers building high-performance web services and APIs with native TypeScript.
DevOps and CLI tool developers who need secure sandboxing and single-binary deployment.
Builders of hybrid Rust/JavaScript ecosystems seeking a high-performance V8-based runtime.
Cloud-native developers leveraging Deno Deploy for rapid edge-computing deployment.

zh.tag: 本地录屏+AI记忆，让智能体记住你的工作

Teams generating SOPs and automations from screen data
Privacy-conscious users wanting AI memory without compromising data security

zh.tag: 面向 AI Agent 的即时并发安全沙箱服务
zh.what: CubeSandbox 是一个基于 RustVMM 和 KVM 的高性能安全沙箱服务，专为 AI Agent 执行代码和任务而设计。它支持在 60 毫秒内启动硬件级隔离的运行环境，且兼容 E2B SDK，可无缝对接现有 AI Agent 工作流。无论是单节点部署还是多节点集群扩展，它都能提供极低内存开销（<5MB）的高并发沙箱服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含基于 Rust 实现的沙箱核心运行时、兼容 E2B 的 API 服务端、Python SDK（PyPI 发布）以及完整的文档与快速开始指南，支持单节点和集群部署形态。
zh.stack: 核心以 Rust 编写，基于 Linux KVM 虚拟化与 RustVMM 构建硬件级隔离；对外提供 E2B 兼容 API，并通过 PyPI 提供 Python SDK 便于集成。
zh.hot: 在 AI Agent 爆发期，安全沙箱需求激增；该项目凭借 60ms 极速启动和 <5MB 的超低内存开销，一周新增 918 Star 冲上 Trending 第 4，成为 E2B 生态的热门开源替代方案。
uses: 为 AI Agent 提供安全代码执行环境——适用于大模型代码生成与工具调用的隔离运行
需要 E2B 兼容沙箱的开发者与平台——可作为 E2B 的开源自托管替代方案
追求高并发、低延迟沙箱的云计算场景——适合大规模并发创建与销毁容器化工作负载
构建多租户 AI 应用的基础设施团队——提供硬件级隔离保障租户安全

en.tag: Instant, secure, lightweight sandbox purpose-built for AI agents
en.what: CubeSandbox is a high-performance, secure sandbox service built on RustVMM and KVM, designed for running AI agent code and tasks. It spins up hardware-isolated environments in under 60 ms with less than 5 MB memory overhead and is compatible with the E2B SDK for seamless integration into existing AI agent workflows. It supports both single-node deployments and easy scaling to multi-node clusters for high-concurrency workloads.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust-based core sandbox runtime, an E2B-compatible API server, a Python SDK published on PyPI, and comprehensive documentation with quick-start guides, supporting both single-node and clustered deployments.
en.stack: Written in Rust and built on Linux KVM virtualization and RustVMM for hardware-level isolation; it exposes an E2B-compatible API and offers a Python SDK via PyPI for easy integration.
en.hot: Amid the AI agent boom, demand for secure execution environments is surging; its sub-60ms startup and under-5MB memory footprint have earned it 918 new stars in a week, landing 4th on the Rust Trending chart as a popular open-source alternative in the E2B ecosystem.
uses: AI agent developers needing secure code execution — ideal for isolating LLM-generated code and tool calls
Teams seeking an E2B-compatible, self-hostable sandbox — a drop-in open-source alternative to E2B
Cloud platforms requiring high-concurrency, low-latency isolation — suited for massive concurrent workload creation and teardown
Infrastructure teams building multi-tenant AI apps — provides hardware-level isolation for tenant security

zh.tag: 本地优先的罗技 Options+ 开源替代，Rust 编写
zh.what: OpenLogi 是一个用 Rust 编写的原生、本地优先的 Logitech Options+ 替代品。它通过 HID++ 协议与罗技外设通信，支持按键重映射、DPI 调节和 SmartShift 功能，无需账户或遥测。

zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本月新增约 2682 星，总星数达 8265，位列 Rust 月榜第 21 名。它满足了用户对无账户、无遥测的本地替代品的需求，且处于积极开发中，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 罗技外设用户：希望摆脱官方 Options+ 的账户和遥测要求，获得本地控制。
隐私敏感用户：偏好无云、无遥测的本地配置管理。
开发者：对 Rust 和 GPUI 桌面应用开发感兴趣，或想参与开源项目。
