en.tag: Local-first open-source alternative to Logitech Options+, written in Rust
en.what: OpenLogi is a native, local-first alternative to Logitech Options+, written in Rust. It communicates with Logitech peripherals via HID++, enabling button remapping, DPI adjustment, and SmartShift without requiring an account or telemetry.
en.content: The repository contains two main components: OpenLogi GUI (a GPUI-based desktop app with an interactive mouse diagram, per-button action picker, DPI presets, SmartShift, RGB keyboard lighting, per-application profiles, etc.) and OpenLogi agent (a background service owning the input hook and all device I/O).
en.stack: Written in Rust, the GUI is built on GPUI, communicates via HID++ protocol over Logi Bolt, Unifying receivers, Bluetooth-direct, or USB. Configuration is in TOML.
en.hot: The project has gained rapid popularity on GitHub, adding ~2,682 stars this month to reach 8,265 total, ranking 21st in the Rust monthly trend. It addresses the need for a local, account-free, telemetry-free alternative and is under active development, drawing significant attention.
uses: Logitech peripheral users: seeking local control without official Options+ account and telemetry.
Privacy-conscious users: preferring cloud-free, telemetry-free local configuration.
Developers: interested in Rust and GPUI desktop app development, or contributing to open source.
Power users: needing per-application profiles, custom button mappings, and DPI presets.

zh.tag: 基于 WireGuard 的零配置安全组网与远程访问基础设施
zh.what: Tailscale 基于 WireGuard 协议构建安全的虚拟专用网络，让用户无需公网 IP 或端口转发即可将设备组成私有网络。它集成了身份验证和两因素认证（2FA），简化了团队和设备之间的安全远程访问与内网穿透。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含 tailscaled 守护进程与 tailscale 命令行工具的核心源码，覆盖 Linux、Windows、macOS 及 BSD 系统的网络栈与控制逻辑。移动端 App 的底层网络库亦来源于此，但各平台 GUI 包装代码位于其他独立仓库。
zh.stack: 项目以 Go 语言为主开发，要求使用最新版 Go 1.26 编译，并基于 WireGuard 协议实现加密通信。构建脚本 `build_dist.sh` 用于将版本信息嵌入二进制，支持多种 Linux 发行版及跨平台打包。
zh.hot: 凭借“零配置”即可在任意设备间建立加密组网的能力，Tailscale 已成为远程办公和云原生时代的核心网络工具，GitHub 累计获得 34k+ Stars，本周再以 583 新增 Star 登上 Go 语言 Trending 榜第 2 名。
uses: 远程办公团队 —— 无需公网 IP 即可安全访问公司内网与私有云资源
开发运维人员 —— 快速搭建跨云、跨地域的容器与服务器调试网络
个人技术爱好者 —— 将家庭 NAS、树莓派等设备组成加密私有网络
安全合规企业 —— 基于 SSO/2FA 的零信任网络替代传统 VPN 方案

en.tag: Zero-config WireGuard VPN for secure remote access and private networking
en.what: Tailscale builds secure virtual private networks on top of WireGuard, allowing devices to form a private mesh network without public IPs or port forwarding. It integrates identity-based authentication and two-factor authentication (2FA) to simplify secure remote access and intranet penetration for teams and devices.
en.content: The repository primarily contains the core source code for the `tailscaled` daemon and the `tailscale` CLI tool, covering the networking stack and control logic for Linux, Windows, macOS, and BSD systems. It also serves as the underlying network library for mobile apps, while platform-specific GUI wrappers reside in separate repositories.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go and requiring the latest Go 1.26 release, it implements encrypted communication over the WireGuard protocol. The `build_dist.sh` script embeds version metadata into binaries, supporting packaging for multiple Linux distributions and cross-platform deployments.
en.hot: Its "zero-config" approach to encrypted mesh networking across any device has made it an essential tool for remote work and cloud-native environments. With over 34k total stars and 583 new stars this week, it ranks #2 on GitHub's Go Trending chart, reflecting strong community traction.
uses: Remote teams — Securely access corporate intranets and private cloud resources without public IPs
DevOps engineers — Quickly build debug networks across multi-cloud and multi-region servers and containers
Homelab enthusiasts — Encrypt and interconnect personal devices like NAS and Raspberry Pi into a private mesh
Security-focused enterprises — Replace legacy VPNs with zero-trust networking based on SSO and 2FA

zh.tag: Kubernetes 声明式 GitOps 持续交付工具
zh.what: Argo CD 是面向 Kubernetes 的声明式 GitOps 持续交付工具，通过监控 Git 仓库中的配置声明自动将应用状态同步到目标集群。它支持 Kustomize、Helm、Jsonnet 等多种配置管理工具，让应用部署和生命周期管理实现自动化、可审计且易于理解。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Argo CD 核心服务端、Web UI、CLI 命令行工具及完整文档，源码以 Go 为主，同时提供 Helm Chart 和标准化安装清单。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，深度依赖 Kubernetes 及其 API，前端采用 React/TypeScript 构建，并集成 Kustomize、Helm、Jsonnet 等主流配置管理工具。
zh.hot: 作为云原生 GitOps 领域的标杆项目，Argo CD 已获 23.6k+ Star，本周新增 163 Star 并跻身 Go 语言周榜第 4，反映出 Kubernetes 社区对声明式交付和自动化运维的强烈需求。
uses: 云平台运维团队 —— 需要为多个 Kubernetes 集群实现声明式、自动化的应用持续交付
DevOps 工程师 —— 希望以 Git 为唯一可信源，落地 GitOps 工作流并提升部署可审计性
云原生架构师 —— 构建多环境（开发/测试/生产）一致性的 Kubernetes 应用交付体系

en.tag: Declarative GitOps continuous delivery tool for Kubernetes
en.what: Argo CD is a declarative GitOps continuous delivery tool for Kubernetes that automatically syncs application states to target clusters by monitoring configuration declarations in Git repositories. It supports multiple configuration management tools including Kustomize, Helm, and Jsonnet, enabling automated, auditable, and transparent application deployment and lifecycle management.
en.content: The repository contains the Argo CD core server, Web UI, CLI tool, and comprehensive documentation. The source code is primarily written in Go, with Helm charts and standard installation manifests provided.
en.stack: Built primarily in Go and relies on Kubernetes and its APIs. The frontend is built with React/TypeScript, and it integrates configuration management tools including Kustomize, Helm, and Jsonnet.
en.hot: As a landmark project in the cloud-native GitOps space, Argo CD has garnered over 23.6k stars, with 163 new stars this week and a ranking of #4 on the GitHub Go Trending weekly list, reflecting strong community demand for declarative delivery and automated operations in Kubernetes environments.
uses: Platform/Ops teams —— Automating declarative app delivery across multiple Kubernetes clusters
DevOps engineers —— Implementing GitOps workflows with Git as the single source of truth for auditable deployments
Cloud-native architects —— Building consistent Kubernetes application delivery pipelines across dev, test, and production environments

zh.tag: 容器安全沙箱与用户态应用内核，兼容 K8s/Docker
zh.what: gVisor 是 Google 开源的容器应用内核，用 Go 语言在用户态实现了一套 Linux 兼容接口，为容器提供额外的安全隔离层。它通过限制应用对宿主机内核的直接访问，大幅降低容器逃逸风险，同时保持接近原生容器的启动速度与资源开销。
zh.content: 仓库包含 runsc（兼容 OCI 的容器运行时）、Sentry（用户态内核）、Gofer（文件系统代理）等核心组件，以及大量 Linux 系统调用的 Go 语言实现与测试套件。
zh.stack: 主要采用 Go 语言编写，支持 x86_64 与 ARM64 架构；作为 OCI 运行时可直接对接 Docker、containerd 与 Kubernetes 生态。
zh.hot: 在容器安全需求激增的背景下，gVisor 以近 1.9 万 Star 成为云原生沙箱的热门选择，本周新增 85 Star 并跻身 Go 语言周榜第 13 位，体现了社区对"轻量隔离"方案的持续追捧。
uses: 云原生平台运维者 —— 为多租户集群或不可信工作负载提供安全沙箱。
安全合规团队 —— 在保持容器敏捷性的同时满足更严格的内核隔离要求。
边缘与 Serverless 开发者 —— 利用快速启动、低开销的用户态内核运行短时函数或微服务。

en.tag: Userspace application kernel for sandboxed containers with OCI/K8s compatibility
en.what: gVisor is an open-source application kernel from Google that implements a Linux-compatible interface in userspace using Go, adding an extra security isolation layer to containers. By limiting direct access to the host kernel, it significantly reduces container escape risks while maintaining near-native startup speed and resource overhead.
en.content: The repository contains the runsc OCI runtime, the Sentry userspace kernel, the Gofer filesystem proxy, and extensive Go implementations of Linux system calls along with test suites.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go and supports x86_64 and ARM64 architectures; as an OCI runtime it integrates directly with Docker, containerd, and Kubernetes.
en.hot: With nearly 19k stars, gVisor is trending as a top cloud-native sandbox amid surging container security demands; its 85 new stars this week and #13 spot on the Go trending list reflect strong community interest in lightweight isolation.
uses: Cloud-native platform operators —— providing secure sandboxes for multi-tenant clusters or untrusted workloads.
Security and compliance teams —— meeting stricter kernel isolation requirements without sacrificing container agility.
Edge and serverless developers —— leveraging fast-start, low-overhead userspace kernels for short-lived functions or microservices.

zh.tag: 微软用 Go 原生重写 TypeScript 编译器，迈向高性能 TS 7
zh.what: 这是 TypeScript 编译器的原生 Go 语言移植版，目标是用原生性能替代现有的 TypeScript-on-JavaScript 架构。它将成为 TypeScript 7 的核心基础，最终合并回主仓库。目前大部分核心功能（解析、类型检查、代码生成等）已实现，并提供可预览的 npm 包和 VS Code 扩展。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的编译器管线实现（扫描、解析、类型解析与检查、声明和 JS 输出），以及 LSP 语言服务原型和命令行工具链。开发者可通过 npm 安装 `@typescript/native-preview` 使用 `tsgo` 命令，或在 VS Code 中安装预览版扩展体验。
zh.stack: 整体以 Go 语言原生实现编译器核心，兼顾跨平台性能；通过 npm 分发预览包并提供 Node.js 可用的 CLI 封装，同时配套发布 VS Code 扩展以集成语言服务。
zh.hot: 作为 TypeScript 生态的基石级重写，该项目在 GitHub 已斩获 25.9k Star，本周新增 110 Star 并冲入 Go 语言周榜第 3 名，社区高度关注编译速度可能带来的数量级提升。
uses: 前端/全栈开发者 —— 希望在大型代码库中获得更快的类型检查和编译速度。
TypeScript 工具链贡献者 —— 关注编译器架构迁移与 Go 实现细节，提前适配 TS 7。
VS Code 用户 —— 想抢先体验基于原生编译器的语言服务与实时反馈。
基础设施团队 —— 评估将核心开发工具从 JavaScript 运行时迁移到原生二进制的影响。

en.tag: Microsoft's Go rewrite of the TypeScript compiler for high-performance TS 7
en.what: This is a native Go port of the TypeScript compiler, aiming to replace the existing TypeScript-on-JavaScript architecture with native performance. It will serve as the foundation for TypeScript 7 and eventually merge back into the main TypeScript repository. Most core features like parsing, type checking, and emit are already implemented, with preview npm packages and a VS Code extension available.
en.content: The repo houses the full compiler pipeline (scanning, parsing, type resolution and checking, declaration and JS emit), plus an LSP language service prototype and CLI toolchain. Developers can try it via the `@typescript/native-preview` npm package using the `tsgo` command, or through a preview VS Code extension.
en.stack: The compiler core is built natively in Go for cross-platform performance, distributed via npm with a Node.js-compatible CLI wrapper, and paired with a VS Code extension that integrates the language service.
en.hot: As a cornerstone rewrite of the TypeScript ecosystem, the project has garnered 25.9k stars on GitHub, adding 110 this week and hitting #3 on the Go Trending chart, reflecting massive community interest in potential order-of-magnitude compile-speed gains.
uses: Front-end/full-stack developers seeking faster type-checking and compilation in large codebases.
TypeScript toolchain contributors tracking the compiler architecture migration and Go implementation ahead of TS 7.
VS Code users wanting to preview the native-compiler-based language service and real-time feedback.
Infrastructure teams evaluating the impact of migrating core dev tools from JavaScript runtime to native binaries.

zh.tag: 基于 YAML 模板的快速漏洞扫描器，安全社区驱动
zh.what: Nuclei 是一款高性能的漏洞扫描工具，通过简洁的 YAML 领域特定语言让全球安全社区协作编写检测模板。它能够快速发现应用程序、API、网络、DNS 及云配置中的安全漏洞，并以极低的误报率模拟真实攻击场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心扫描引擎、YAML 模板解析器、丰富的官方模板库以及多协议支持模块（HTTP/DNS/TCP/SSL 等），同时提供完善的 CLI 工具和 SDK 集成接口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言编写，依托 YAML 模板引擎实现漏洞检测逻辑。支持跨平台运行并可与 CI/CD 流程及各类云原生工具链无缝集成。
zh.hot: 凭借 29,811 Stars 和本周新增 228 Stars 的热度，Nuclei 已成为安全社区事实上的漏洞扫描标准。其 YAML 模板生态让全球研究者能够实时响应最新漏洞，实现了「当天漏洞、当天检测」的协作式安全防御。
uses: 企业安全团队 —— 用于资产梳理、漏洞巡检与红蓝对抗演练
渗透测试工程师 —— 快速验证目标环境中已知 CVE 与配置缺陷
DevSecOps 工程师 —— 集成至 CI/CD 流水线实现自动化安全左移
安全研究员 —— 编写并共享 YAML 模板，跟踪分析最新漏洞趋势

en.tag: Fast, community-powered vulnerability scanner using YAML templates
en.what: Nuclei is a high-performance vulnerability scanner that uses a simple YAML-based DSL to enable global security collaboration on detection templates. It rapidly identifies vulnerabilities across applications, APIs, networks, DNS, and cloud configurations while mimicking real-world attack scenarios with minimal false positives.
en.content: The repository houses the core scanning engine, YAML template parser, extensive official template libraries, and multi-protocol support modules (HTTP/DNS/TCP/SSL), along with a comprehensive CLI tool and SDK integration interfaces.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go, it relies on a YAML template engine for vulnerability detection logic. It supports cross-platform execution and integrates seamlessly with CI/CD pipelines and various cloud-native toolchains.
en.hot: With 29,811 Stars and 228 new Stars this week, Nuclei has become the de facto standard for community-driven vulnerability scanning. Its YAML template ecosystem allows global researchers to respond to emerging threats in real time, enabling same-day detection of trending vulnerabilities through collaborative security defense.
uses: Enterprise security teams — for asset inventory, vulnerability patrols, and red/blue team exercises
Penetration testers — to rapidly verify known CVEs and misconfigurations in target environments
DevSecOps engineers — integrating into CI/CD pipelines for automated shift-left security
Security researchers — writing and sharing YAML templates to track and analyze emerging vulnerability trends

zh.tag: 最易用的自托管通行密钥身份认证提供商
zh.what: Pocket ID 是一个基于 OpenID Connect 和 OAuth 2.0 的身份认证提供商，支持用户通过通行密钥（passkeys）登录你的应用。它旨在简化自托管身份认证，避免像 Keycloak 等复杂方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Pocket ID 的完整源代码，包括后端（Go）和前端（Web），支持 Docker 部署，并提供文档和演示站点。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，前端可能使用现代 JavaScript 框架，依赖 Docker 进行部署，支持通行密钥（WebAuthn）和 OpenID Connect 协议。
zh.hot: Pocket ID 在 GitHub 上获得 8723 颗星，本月新增 472 颗，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 9。它因提供简单易用的通行密钥认证方案而受到自托管社区欢迎。
uses: 自托管服务提供者：为你的应用添加通行密钥登录，无需管理密码。
家庭或小型团队：统一管理多个自托管服务的身份认证。
安全爱好者：使用 YubiKey 等硬件密钥登录所有服务。

en.tag: The most user-friendly self-hosted passkey authentication provider
en.what: Pocket ID is an OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 provider that allows users to sign in to your applications using passkeys. It aims to simplify self-hosted authentication, avoiding the complexity of solutions like Keycloak.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Pocket ID, including backend (Go) and frontend (Web), with Docker deployment support, documentation, and a demo site.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with a modern JavaScript frontend, deployed via Docker, supporting WebAuthn passkeys and OpenID Connect protocol.
en.hot: Pocket ID has 8,723 stars on GitHub, with 472 added this month, ranking 9th on the Go trending list. It is popular among self-hosting enthusiasts for its simple passkey authentication solution.
uses: Self-hosters: Add passkey login to your apps without password management.
Families or small teams: Centralize authentication for multiple self-hosted services.
Security enthusiasts: Use hardware keys like YubiKey to sign in to all services.

zh.tag: 单文件开源实时后端，内置数据库、用户认证与管理后台
zh.what: PocketBase 是一个开源 Go 后端，将 SQLite 数据库、实时订阅、文件存储、用户认证和管理后台打包在一个可执行文件中。它让开发者无需部署和维护多个服务，就能快速启动包含后端的全栈项目。
zh.content: 仓库提供各平台预构建可执行文件、Go 框架源码与基础示例，以及官方 JavaScript 和 Dart SDK；预构建版本默认启用 JS VM 插件，允许通过 JavaScript 扩展后端逻辑。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 1.25+ 构建，内嵌 SQLite 并提供 REST-ish API；客户端通过 JavaScript（浏览器、Node.js、React Native）或 Dart（全平台）SDK 与后端交互。
zh.hot: 凭借「一个文件搞定后端」的极简理念，PocketBase 已积累近 6 万 Star，日增 37 星并登上 Go 语言日榜，成为个人开发者和快速原型场景中 Firebase 的热门轻量替代品。
uses: 个人开发者与独立黑客 —— 无需运维，单二进制文件即可部署上线全栈应用
移动/Web 原型团队 —— 借助 Dart/JS SDK 快速搭建带实时同步与文件存储的后端
追求成本可控的中小项目 —— 作为 Firebase 的自托管开源替代，减少云服务依赖

en.tag: Open-source realtime backend in a single file with embedded DB, auth and admin UI
en.what: PocketBase is an open-source Go backend that bundles an embedded SQLite database with realtime subscriptions, file storage, user authentication, and an admin dashboard into a single portable executable. It enables developers to bootstrap full-stack projects without deploying and managing multiple separate services.
en.content: The repository ships prebuilt executables for multiple platforms, the Go framework source code with base examples, plus official JavaScript and Dart SDKs; the prebuilt binary enables a JS VM plugin by default for extending backend logic with JavaScript.
en.stack: Built with Go 1.25+ around an embedded SQLite database and exposed through a REST-ish API; client interaction is handled via official JavaScript (Browser, Node.js, React Native) and Dart (Web, Mobile, Desktop, CLI) SDKs.
en.hot: With its "backend in one file" philosophy, PocketBase has gained nearly 60k stars—adding 37 today and hitting the Go daily trending list—making it a popular lightweight, self-hosted alternative to Firebase for indie hackers and rapid prototyping.
uses: Indie developers and hackers — ship a zero-ops backend in a single portable binary
Mobile and web prototyping teams — rapidly build backends with realtime sync and file storage using Dart and JS SDKs
Cost-conscious small-to-medium projects — a self-hosted, open-source alternative to Firebase that reduces cloud vendor lock-in

zh.tag: Kubernetes 的包管理器，像 apt/yum 一样管理应用
zh.what: Helm 是用于管理 Kubernetes 应用程序的工具，通过 Charts 打包预配置的 Kubernetes 资源。它简化了 Kubernetes 应用的安装、升级和管理，类似于 Linux 中的包管理器。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Helm 的源代码、文档、测试和示例 Charts。核心是 Go 编写的 CLI 工具，支持模板渲染、发布管理和仓库交互。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes API 和模板引擎。支持多种安装方式，包括二进制、Homebrew、Chocolatey 等。
zh.hot: 作为 Kubernetes 生态的标配工具，拥有 3 万+ Star，本月新增 189，持续活跃。v4 稳定版发布，v3 维护至 2026 年，社区关注度高。
uses: Kubernetes 开发者：快速打包和部署应用
DevOps 工程师：管理复杂应用的生命周期
平台团队：标准化应用交付和配置管理

en.tag: The Kubernetes package manager, like apt/yum for K8s apps
en.what: Helm is a tool for managing Kubernetes applications by packaging pre-configured resources as Charts. It streamlines installing, upgrading, and managing K8s apps, akin to a package manager for Kubernetes.
en.content: The repo contains Helm's source code, docs, tests, and example charts. Core is a Go CLI for templating, release management, and repo interactions.
en.stack: Developed in Go, leveraging Kubernetes API and templating. Supports multiple installation methods: binaries, Homebrew, Chocolatey, etc.
en.hot: As a standard tool in the K8s ecosystem, it has 30k+ stars, +189 this month, and remains active. v4 stable release and v3 support until 2026 keep community interest high.
uses: K8s developers: quickly package and deploy apps
DevOps engineers: manage complex app lifecycles
Platform teams: standardize app delivery and config management

zh.tag: 高颜值现代化终端文件管理器
zh.what: superfile 是一款在终端中运行的文件管理器，采用现代化的 TUI 界面，让开发者无需离开命令行即可高效浏览、预览和操作文件。它支持多面板布局、主题定制与插件扩展，致力于在保持终端工作流的同时提供图形化般的交互体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Go 源码、安装脚本与构建指南，以及丰富的主题包、插件文档和快捷键配置示例。同时提供了面向 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 的跨平台发布与安装说明。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言构建，采用现代化终端 UI 技术实现跨平台渲染，支持多架构二进制分发与 Homebrew 等包管理器集成。
zh.hot: 凭借精致的多栏 TUI 设计与流畅的交互体验，superfile 在开发者中迅速走红，目前已积累 18.6k Stars，本月新增 1,295 颗，跻身 GitHub Go 语言月榜第 11 位，成为传统终端文件管理器的强力现代替代品。
uses: 终端重度用户与键盘党 —— 追求不离开命令行即可完成复杂文件操作
DevOps 与运维工程师 —— 需要在远程服务器上快速浏览、编辑和管理文件
追求美观的开发者 —— 希望终端工具拥有现代 UI 与丰富主题定制
跨平台工作者 —— 在 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 间寻求一致的文件管理体验

en.tag: A fancy, modern terminal file manager with rich TUI
en.what: superfile is a terminal-based file manager that delivers a modern, fancy TUI interface, allowing developers to browse, preview, and manipulate files without leaving the command line. It features multi-panel layouts, customizable themes, and plugin support, blending the efficiency of terminal workflows with a near-GUI interactive experience.
en.content: The repository ships full Go source code, installation scripts, build guides, and a rich collection of themes, plugin docs, and hotkey configuration samples. It also provides cross-platform release notes and installation instructions for macOS, Linux, and Windows.
en.stack: Built in Go with modern terminal UI libraries for cross-platform rendering, supporting multi-arch binaries and package managers like Homebrew.
en.hot: Thanks to its polished multi-pane TUI design and smooth interactions, superfile has gained strong traction among developers, amassing 18.6k stars with 1,295 added this month and ranking 11th on GitHub's Go monthly trending list as a compelling modern alternative to classic terminal file managers.
uses: Terminal power users and keyboard-driven developers who want to handle complex file operations without leaving the CLI
DevOps and system administrators who need to quickly browse, edit, and manage files on remote servers
Aesthetics-minded developers looking for modern UI, rich themes, and customization in terminal tools
Cross-platform workers seeking a consistent file management experience across macOS, Linux, and Windows

zh.tag: 云原生监控告警系统与多维时序数据库
zh.what: Prometheus 是 CNCF 毕业项目，通过拉取模式采集目标指标，基于多维数据模型存储时序数据，并提供 PromQL 查询与灵活的告警规则。它能独立完成监控、可视化与告警闭环，无需依赖分布式存储。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Prometheus 主服务源码、PromQL 查询引擎、告警规则评估器、HTTP API、多种服务发现适配器，以及官方文档与架构图。
zh.stack: 以 Go 为主语言实现，支持通过 HTTP 拉取或 Push Gateway 接收指标，可与 Grafana 等可视化工具及多种服务发现后端（Kubernetes、Consul 等）集成。
zh.hot: 作为云原生监控的事实标准，Prometheus 已积累 65,191 Stars，本周新增 277，位列 GitHub Go 周榜第 14，是 Kubernetes 生态不可或缺的观测基础设施。
uses: SRE / 运维团队 —— 构建云原生监控与统一告警体系
后端开发者 —— 为微服务与容器集群埋点暴露指标
企业 IT 架构 —— 进行基础设施监控、容量规划与故障定位
平台厂商 —— 集成或基于 Prometheus 二次开发可观测性产品

en.tag: Cloud-native monitoring and multi-dimensional time series database
en.what: A CNCF graduated project that scrapes metrics from targets using a pull model, stores them in a multi-dimensional time series model, and offers PromQL querying with flexible alerting. It operates as autonomous single nodes without distributed storage dependencies.
en.content: The repository holds the Prometheus server source, PromQL query engine, rule evaluator, HTTP APIs, various service discovery adapters, plus official documentation and architecture diagrams.
en.stack: Implemented primarily in Go, supporting HTTP scraping or Push Gateway ingestion, and integrating with visualization tools like Grafana and service discovery backends such as Kubernetes and Consul.
en.hot: With 65,191 stars and 277 new this week, it ranks #14 on GitHub's Go Trending weekly list, serving as the de facto observability standard in the Kubernetes and cloud-native ecosystem.
uses: SRE / DevOps teams — building unified cloud-native monitoring and alerting stacks
Backend developers — instrumenting microservices and container clusters with metrics
Enterprise IT — monitoring infrastructure, capacity planning, and incident diagnosis
Platform vendors — integrating or extending Prometheus for commercial observability offerings

zh.tag: 基础设施即代码的行业标准工具
zh.what: Terraform 是一个基础设施即代码工具，允许用户通过声明式配置文件安全、可预测地创建、更改和改进基础设施。它支持众多云服务商和内部解决方案，将 API 编码为可共享、版本控制的配置。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Terraform 核心引擎，提供 CLI 工具、配置语言（HCL）解析器、状态管理、资源图构建和执行计划生成等核心功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 HashiCorp 的配置语言 HCL 和插件系统。
zh.hot: Terraform 是基础设施即代码领域的标杆项目，拥有近 5 万星标，长期稳定在 GitHub 热门榜。其强大的多云管理能力和活跃的社区生态持续吸引开发者。
uses: 云基础设施工程师 —— 使用 Terraform 管理多云环境，实现基础设施自动化部署与变更
DevOps 团队 —— 将基础设施配置纳入版本控制，实现 CI/CD 集成与协作
平台工程师 —— 构建内部开发者平台，提供自助式基础设施服务
初学者 —— 通过 Terraform 学习基础设施即代码概念和实践

en.tag: Industry-standard Infrastructure as Code tool
en.what: Terraform is an Infrastructure as Code tool that enables users to safely and predictably create, change, and improve infrastructure using declarative configuration files. It supports numerous cloud providers and in-house solutions, codifying APIs into version-controlled, shareable configurations.
en.content: The repository contains the Terraform core engine, including CLI tools, HCL parser, state management, resource graph construction, and execution plan generation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on HashiCorp Configuration Language (HCL) and a plugin system.
en.hot: Terraform is the benchmark in IaC with nearly 50k stars, consistently appearing on GitHub trending. Its multi-cloud management capabilities and vibrant community keep attracting developers.
uses: Cloud infrastructure engineers — manage multi-cloud environments with automated deployment and changes
DevOps teams — version control infrastructure configs for CI/CD integration and collaboration
Platform engineers — build internal developer platforms with self-service infrastructure
Beginners — learn Infrastructure as Code concepts and practices via Terraform

zh.tag: 开源 Google Maps 数据抓取工具，支持 CLI/Web/REST
zh.what: 这是一个从 Google Maps 提取商业数据的开源工具，可获取名称、地址、电话、网站、评分、评论数、经纬度、邮箱等信息。支持命令行、Web 界面和 REST API，并可与 AI 代理集成，用于潜在客户生成、本地商业研究等。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心抓取库、命令行工具、Web 界面、REST API 服务，以及可选的 AI Agent Skill（通过 npx 安装）。还提供 Docker 镜像和代理支持，方便大规模抓取。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 Chromedp 或类似库进行浏览器自动化，支持 Docker 部署，并提供 Node.js 的 Agent Skill 集成。
zh.hot: 本月新增 773 星，总星数 5447，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 14。因其强大的数据提取能力和 AI 代理集成，成为商业智能和销售线索生成的热门工具。
uses: 销售与市场人员：快速收集潜在客户信息，如商家邮箱和网站
数据科学家：获取本地商业数据用于分析和建模
开发者：通过 REST API 或 CLI 自动化数据抓取流程
AI 代理用户：用自然语言指令让代理自动完成抓取任务

en.tag: Open-source Google Maps scraper with CLI, Web UI, and REST API
en.what: This is an open-source tool to scrape business data from Google Maps, extracting names, addresses, phone numbers, websites, ratings, review counts, coordinates, emails, and more. It offers CLI, Web UI, and REST API, and integrates with AI agents for lead generation and local business research.
en.content: The repo includes a Go core scraping library, CLI tool, Web UI, REST API server, and an optional AI Agent Skill (installable via npx). It also provides Docker images and proxy support for large-scale scraping.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, using browser automation libraries like Chromedp, with Docker deployment support and a Node.js-based Agent Skill integration.
en.hot: Gained 773 stars this month, reaching 5,447 total, ranking #14 on the Go trending list. Its powerful data extraction and AI agent integration make it popular for business intelligence and lead generation.
uses: Sales and marketing professionals: quickly collect prospect info like emails and websites
Data scientists: obtain local business data for analysis and modeling
Developers: automate scraping via REST API or CLI
AI agent users: instruct agents in natural language to perform scraping tasks

zh.tag: 跨平台安全文件传输工具，支持端到端加密与断点续传
zh.what: croc 是一款命令行工具，可在任意两台计算机之间简单、安全地传输文件与文件夹。它基于 PAKE 协议实现端到端加密，无需配置本地服务器或端口转发，通过中继即可完成跨平台传输。支持断点续传、多文件传输、IPv6-first 及代理（如 Tor）等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Go 源码、CLI 主程序、中继服务器实现，以及多平台安装脚本和 CI 配置。README 提供了详细的安装指南（涵盖 Homebrew、Scoop、Nix 等主流包管理器）和动态演示 GIF。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，使用 PAKE 算法实现密钥交换，通过自定义中继协议传输数据，支持 IPv6/IPv4 双栈及 SOCKS5 代理（如 Tor）。
zh.hot: 凭借「开箱即用、安全无痛」的跨设备传输体验，croc 在开发者社区积累了 35.6K Star，本周再增 167 星并冲入 GitHub Go 周榜第 20 名。它填补了传统 scp/rsync 配置繁琐与即时传输工具缺乏加密之间的空白。
uses: 开发运维人员 —— 在不同服务器或本地与远程之间快速安全地传输配置文件与日志
跨平台协作团队 —— 在 Windows、macOS、Linux 同事之间即开即用地分享大文件或项目目录
隐私敏感用户 —— 借助端到端加密和 Tor 代理，在不信任网络中安全收发文件
命令行爱好者 —— 替代 scp/rsync，无需配置 SSH 或端口转发即可点对点传输

en.tag: Secure CLI tool for effortless cross-platform file transfers with encryption
en.what: croc is a CLI tool that lets any two computers simply and securely transfer files and folders. It uses PAKE for end-to-end encryption and works through a relay, eliminating the need for local servers or port forwarding. It supports resumable transfers, multiple files, IPv6-first with IPv4 fallback, and proxies like Tor.
en.content: The repository contains the full Go source code, CLI entry point, relay server implementation, and cross-platform install scripts with CI configs. The README includes detailed installation guides for Homebrew, Scoop, Nix, and more, plus a demo GIF.
en.stack: Written in Go, it uses PAKE for key exchange, a custom relay protocol for data transfer, and supports IPv6/IPv4 dual-stack with SOCKS5 proxy support (e.g., Tor).
en.hot: With an out-of-the-box, pain-free cross-device transfer experience, croc has earned 35.6K stars, gaining 167 this week and hitting #20 on GitHub's Go Trending chart. It fills the gap between tedious scp/rsync setup and instant tools that lack encryption.
uses: DevOps/Developers —— quickly and securely transfer configs and logs between servers or local and remote machines
Cross-platform teams —— instantly share large files or project folders across Windows, macOS, and Linux colleagues
Privacy-conscious users —— send files securely over untrusted networks using end-to-end encryption and Tor proxy support
CLI power users —— replace scp/rsync without needing SSH setup or port forwarding for ad-hoc transfers

zh.tag: 云存储的 rsync：跨平台文件同步与加密
zh.what: Rclone 是一个命令行程序，用于在不同云存储提供商之间同步文件和目录，支持 70+ 存储后端。它提供类似 rsync 的功能，包括加密、缓存、挂载等高级特性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 语言编写的核心同步引擎、命令行界面、以及针对每个存储后端的适配器。提供完整的文档、安装脚本和 Docker 镜像。
zh.stack: 纯 Go 语言开发，依赖 Go 标准库及少量第三方包（如 FUSE 挂载）。跨平台支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 及 NAS 设备。
zh.hot: 作为云存储同步的瑞士军刀，Rclone 已有 58K+ Stars，本周新增 307 Stars，持续受到数据备份和迁移用户的青睐。
uses: 数据备份与恢复 —— 将本地数据同步到云端或跨云备份
云迁移 —— 在不同云服务商之间迁移数据
媒体服务器 —— 挂载云存储为本地磁盘，用于 Plex 等
DevOps 自动化 —— 在 CI/CD 中同步构建产物到云存储

en.tag: rsync for cloud storage: sync and encrypt files across providers
en.what: Rclone is a command-line program to sync files and directories to and from various cloud storage providers, supporting 70+ backends. It offers rsync-like features including encryption, caching, and mounting.
en.content: The repository contains the core sync engine written in Go, a CLI, and adapters for each storage backend. It includes comprehensive documentation, installation scripts, and Docker images.
en.stack: Developed in pure Go, relying on Go standard library and a few third-party packages (e.g., FUSE for mounting). Cross-platform support for Windows, macOS, Linux, and NAS devices.
en.hot: As the Swiss Army knife for cloud storage sync, Rclone has 58K+ Stars with 307 new this week, consistently favored by users for data backup and migration.
uses: Data backup and recovery — sync local data to cloud or cross-cloud backup
Cloud migration — migrate data between different cloud providers
Media server — mount cloud storage as local disk for Plex etc.
DevOps automation — sync build artifacts to cloud storage in CI/CD

zh.tag: 容器生态的乐高套件，构建自定义容器系统的开源框架
zh.what: Moby 是 Docker 创建的开源项目，旨在提供模块化的容器工具组件和组装框架，让开发者能够构建自定义的容器化系统。它包含构建工具、注册表、编排工具、运行时等组件，可灵活组合。
zh.content: 仓库包含容器构建工具、容器注册表、编排工具、运行时等组件，以及将这些组件组装成系统的框架。项目遵循模块化、可替换、安全可用、开发者优先等原则。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖容器运行时、网络、存储等底层技术，与 Docker 生态紧密集成。
zh.hot: 作为 Docker 的上游项目，Moby 拥有 7.2 万星标，是容器生态的核心基础设施，持续吸引开发者关注和贡献。
uses: 容器引擎开发者 —— 基于 Moby 组件构建或定制容器运行时和工具
系统集成商 —— 利用 Moby 的模块化框架组装自定义容器平台
容器技术爱好者 —— 学习容器内部原理并参与开源贡献

en.tag: A Lego set for the container ecosystem to assemble custom container-based systems
en.what: Moby is an open-source project by Docker that provides a modular toolkit and framework for assembling custom container-based systems. It includes components like build tools, registry, orchestration, and runtime, which can be used as building blocks.
en.content: The repository contains container build tools, a container registry, orchestration tools, a runtime, and a framework for assembling them into systems. It follows principles of modularity, swappable components, usable security, and developer focus.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on container runtime, networking, and storage technologies, tightly integrated with the Docker ecosystem.
en.hot: As the upstream for Docker, Moby has 71,908 stars, making it a core infrastructure in the container ecosystem, continuously attracting developer attention and contributions.
uses: Container engine developers — build or customize container runtimes and tools using Moby components
System integrators — assemble custom container platforms with Moby's modular framework
Container enthusiasts — learn container internals and contribute to open source

zh.tag: Go 编程语言官方仓库
zh.what: Go 是一种开源编程语言，旨在轻松构建简单、可靠且高效的软件。该仓库是 Go 语言的核心源码库，包含编译器、标准库和工具链。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 语言的源代码、文档、测试和构建脚本。主要目录包括 src（源码）、doc（文档）、test（测试）等。

en.tag: Official repository for the Go programming language
en.what: Go is an open-source programming language that makes it easy to build simple, reliable, and efficient software. This repository is the core source code of the Go language, including the compiler, standard library, and toolchain.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, tests, and build scripts for the Go language. Main directories include src (source), doc (documentation), test (tests), etc.

zh.tag: 高人气内网穿透与反向代理工具，支持 TCP/UDP/HTTP/HTTPS 及 P2P 模式
zh.what: frp 是一个快速反向代理工具，用于将位于 NAT 或防火墙后的本地服务器暴露到公网。它支持 TCP、UDP、HTTP 和 HTTPS 协议，并允许通过域名将请求转发到内网服务，同时提供 P2P 直连模式。
zh.content: 仓库包含 frps（服务端）和 frpc（客户端）二进制及源码，提供完整的配置文件示例、文档（含中文）以及多种协议转发和 P2P 穿透的实现代码。
zh.stack: 以 Go 语言为主开发，支持跨平台编译部署，依赖 Go 标准库及网络协议栈实现高性能内网穿透。
zh.hot: 作为内网穿透领域的事实标准工具，frp 已积累超过 10.8 万 Star，本月新增 879 Star，稳居 Go 语言月榜前列，深受开发者与运维人员信赖。
uses: 远程办公与家庭服务器运维——将内网 SSH、NAS、Web 服务安全暴露到公网
本地开发调试——让前端、后端、Webhook 在公网可访问
云原生与 IoT 场景——为无公网 IP 的容器、边缘设备提供稳定入口
技术爱好者与极客——快速搭建个人博客、图床、游戏服务器等内网穿透服务

en.tag: Popular fast reverse proxy for NAT traversal, supporting TCP/UDP/HTTP/HTTPS and P2P mode
en.what: frp is a fast reverse proxy that exposes local servers behind NAT or firewalls to the internet. It supports TCP, UDP, HTTP, and HTTPS protocols, forwards requests to internal services via domain names, and offers a P2P connect mode.
en.content: The repository contains frps (server) and frpc (client) binaries and source code, complete configuration examples, documentation (including Chinese), and implementations for multi-protocol forwarding and P2P tunneling.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go with cross-platform compilation support, relying on Go's standard library and networking stack to deliver high-performance NAT traversal.
en.hot: A de-facto standard for NAT traversal, frp has accumulated over 108K stars, gaining 879 this month alone and ranking high on the Go monthly trending list, trusted by developers and ops worldwide.
uses: Remote work and homelab ops — securely expose internal SSH, NAS, and web services to the internet
Local development and debugging — make frontend, backend, and webhook endpoints publicly accessible
Cloud-native and IoT scenarios — provide stable ingress for containers and edge devices without public IPs
Hobbyists and geeks — quickly tunnel personal blogs, image hosting, and game servers from behind NAT

zh.tag: Google 开源 C++ 通用库，生产级标准库扩展
zh.what: Abseil 是 Google 开源的 C++ 通用库集合，旨在补充和扩展 C++ 标准库。它从 Google 内部代码库提取，经过大规模生产环境验证，提供 C++17 兼容的高可靠基础组件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 base、algorithm、cleanup、container、debugging、flags、hash、log、numeric、strings、synchronization、time 等模块代码，覆盖初始化、算法扩展、容器、日志与并发工具等基础能力，支持 Bazel 和 CMake 构建。
zh.stack: 基于 C++17 标准开发，官方支持 Bazel 与 CMake 构建，兼容主流编译器与平台，无外部运行时依赖，仅依赖 C++ 标准库。
zh.hot: 本周新增 608 Star 冲上 GitHub 周榜第 2，反映出 C++ 开发者对经过 Google 生产环境验证、能填补标准库空白的高质量基础组件的强劲需求。17964 Star 的积累也证明了其作为现代 C++ 基础设施的核心地位。
uses: C++ 后端/基础架构开发者 —— 需要可靠的基础工具库替代或补充标准库
追求代码稳定性与工程规范的大型项目 —— 使用 Google 内部验证过的高质量保证库
跨平台 C++ 应用开发团队 —— 借助其良好的编译器与平台支持降低移植成本

en.tag: Google's open-source C++ common libraries extending the standard library
en.what: Abseil is an open-source collection of C++ libraries from Google designed to augment the standard library. Extracted from Google's internal codebase and battle-tested in production, it provides C++17-compliant foundational utilities.
en.content: The repository includes modular components such as base, algorithm, cleanup, container, debugging, flags, hash, log, strings, synchronization, and time, supporting both Bazel and CMake build systems.
en.stack: Built on C++17 with official Bazel and CMake support, compatible with major compilers and platforms, with zero external runtime dependencies beyond the C++ standard library.
en.hot: Surging to #2 on GitHub Trending with 608 new stars this week, it reflects strong demand from C++ developers for battle-tested, production-grade utilities that fill gaps in the standard library. Its 17,964 total stars cement its role as essential modern C++ infrastructure.
uses: C++ backend and infrastructure developers who need reliable foundational utilities to complement or replace the standard library
Large-scale projects prioritizing code stability and engineering rigor, leveraging Google's internally battle-tested libraries
Cross-platform C++ teams looking to reduce porting costs through broad compiler and platform support

zh.tag: 多核友好的C++刚体物理与碰撞检测引擎，服务3A游戏与VR
zh.what: Jolt Physics 是一个为现代多核 CPU 优化的刚体物理与碰撞检测库，专为游戏和 VR 应用设计。它支持在后台线程并行加载物理数据、执行碰撞查询，同时保持主模拟循环的稳定性能与即时可见的数据一致性。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的物理引擎源码、可独立运行的示例程序与测试用例，以及针对布娃娃、车辆、碰撞查询等模块的详细文档。代码采用 C++17 编写，提供了跨平台的 CMake 构建系统与 CI 配置。
zh.stack: 核心基于现代 C++17 标准开发，无第三方运行时依赖，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 及主流游戏主机平台。构建系统采用 CMake，并集成了 SonarCloud 质量门禁与自动化测试。
zh.hot: 凭借《地平线：西之绝境》与《死亡搁浅2》等3A大作的背书，该仓库已获得近 1.1 万 Star，本周新增 242 星并登上 GitHub C++ 周榜第 2 名。开发者在寻求 PhysX/Havok 替代方案时，高度关注其多核并行架构与即时可见的数据一致性设计。
uses: 3A游戏工作室 —— 需要高性能、可定制物理引擎以驱动开放世界与复杂交互的团队
VR/AR开发者 —— 追求稳定物理模拟与低延迟交互的沉浸式应用制作人
独立游戏开发者 —— 寻找零授权费用、跨平台支持且生产验证过的物理中间件
图形引擎研究者 —— 学习现代多核物理架构、碰撞检测算法与无锁数据设计的工程师

en.tag: Multi-core C++ rigid body physics engine powering AAA games and VR apps
en.what: Jolt Physics is a modern, multi-core optimized rigid body physics and collision detection library designed for games and VR applications. It supports background loading of physics data and concurrent collision queries while maintaining stable simulation performance and immediately visible data consistency.
en.content: The repository contains the full engine source, standalone sample applications, test suites, and detailed documentation for ragdolls, vehicles, and collision queries. It is written in C++17 with cross-platform CMake build systems and CI configurations.
en.stack: The core is written in modern C++17 with no third-party runtime dependencies, supporting Windows, Linux, macOS, and major game consoles. It uses CMake for building and integrates SonarCloud quality gates with automated testing.
en.hot: Backed by AAA titles like Horizon Forbidden West and Death Stranding 2, the repo has amassed nearly 11k stars, gaining 242 this week and hitting #2 on GitHub's C++ Trending list. Developers exploring alternatives to PhysX/Havok are drawn to its multi-core parallel architecture and immediate data consistency.
uses: AAA game studios needing high-performance, customizable physics for open worlds and complex interactions
VR/AR developers building immersive apps that require stable simulation and low-latency interaction
Indie developers seeking a zero-license-fee, cross-platform, production-proven physics middleware
Engine researchers studying modern multi-core physics architectures and lock-free data design

zh.tag: 跨平台 C++ 异步网络与底层 I/O 基础设施库
zh.what: Asio 是一个跨平台的 C++ 库，专注于提供异步网络与底层 I/O 编程能力，统一封装了各操作系统的复杂原生 API。开发者可用它高效构建 TCP/UDP 套接字、串口通信及定时器等组件，广泛应用于高并发服务器、实时系统和嵌入式通信场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含头文件-only 与源码编译两种形态的完整实现，以及示例程序、单元测试和离线 HTML 文档。根目录按 src、include、doc、example 组织，便于直接集成或打包构建。
zh.stack: 核心为现代 C++（C++11 起），零依赖或可选衔接 Boost，支持 Linux、Windows、macOS 及嵌入式平台。编译系统覆盖 Autotools、CMake 和纯 Makefile，适配多种工具链。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 异步网络编程的事实标准之一，Asio 凭借稳定 API 与卓越性能持续吸引开发者，目前获星 6.1k，本周新增 175 星并跻身 C++ 周榜第 8。最新 1.38.1 版本的发布进一步印证了社区对高性能底层 I/O 基础设施的旺盛需求。
uses: 需要构建高并发网络服务或实时通信系统的后端 C++ 开发者
追求跨平台一致 API、不想直接编写操作系统原生 I/O 代码的嵌入式/工具链团队
希望基于成熟异步模型开发游戏服务器、金融行情网关或物联网网关的工程团队

en.tag: Cross-platform C++ library for asynchronous networking and low-level I/O
en.what: Asio is a cross-platform C++ library for network and low-level I/O programming, offering a consistent asynchronous model across operating systems. It abstracts complex native APIs into composable components like TCP/UDP sockets, serial ports, and timers, making it ideal for high-concurrency servers and real-time systems.
en.content: The repository ships the library in both header-only and compiled source forms, alongside examples, unit tests, and offline HTML documentation. It is organized under src, include, doc, and example directories for easy integration or packaging.
en.stack: Written in modern C++ (C++11 and up) with zero mandatory dependencies—optionally interoperable with Boost—and supports Linux, Windows, macOS, and embedded targets. Build systems include Autotools, CMake, and plain Makefiles for broad toolchain compatibility.
en.hot: A de-facto standard for C++ asynchronous networking, Asio maintains strong momentum with 6.1k stars and 175 added this week, ranking 8th on the GitHub C++ Trending list. The recent 1.38.1 release underscores continued community demand for robust, high-performance low-level I/O infrastructure.
uses: Backend C++ developers building high-concurrency network services or real-time communication systems
Embedded and tooling teams seeking a cross-platform, consistent API without managing native OS I/O directly
Engineering teams developing game servers, financial market gateways, or IoT hubs on a proven asynchronous model

zh.tag: 网格优化库，让模型更小渲染更快
zh.what: 这是一个用于优化三角形网格的库，通过减少网格复杂度和存储开销，使 GPU 渲染更高效。它提供了 C/C++ 接口，并支持通过 FFI 从其他语言调用，同时还有配套的 gltfpack 工具和 clusterlod 库。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库源码（src/）、gltfpack 命令行工具（gltf/）、clusterlod 单头文件库（demo/），以及测试和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，提供 C 和 C++ 接口；支持 CMake 构建，也可直接添加源文件；有 Rust 和 JavaScript 的绑定。
zh.hot: 本月新增 464 星，总星数 8187，位列 GitHub Trending 月榜（C++）第 4 名。其高效的网格优化算法对游戏开发和 3D 渲染领域至关重要，且提供了多种语言绑定和工具链，受到广泛关注。
uses: 游戏开发者：优化 3D 模型以减少 GPU 负载和内存占用
3D 内容创作者：使用 gltfpack 自动优化 glTF 文件
引擎开发者：集成到渲染管线中提升性能
需要跨语言调用的开发者：通过 FFI 或绑定使用

en.tag: Mesh optimization library for smaller meshes and faster rendering
en.what: This library optimizes triangle meshes to reduce complexity and storage overhead, making GPU rendering more efficient. It provides C/C++ interfaces, supports FFI for other languages, and includes companion tools like gltfpack and clusterlod.
en.content: The repository contains core library sources (src/), the gltfpack command-line tool (gltf/), the clusterlod single-header library (demo/), along with tests and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, offering C and C++ interfaces; supports CMake builds or direct source inclusion; has Rust and JavaScript bindings.
en.hot: Gained 464 stars this month, total 8187, ranking 4th on GitHub Trending monthly (C++). Its efficient mesh optimization algorithms are crucial for game development and 3D rendering, with multiple language bindings and tools, attracting wide attention.
uses: Game developers: optimize 3D models to reduce GPU load and memory usage
3D content creators: use gltfpack to automatically optimize glTF files
Engine developers: integrate into rendering pipelines for performance
Developers needing cross-language calls: use via FFI or bindings

zh.tag: OpenAI Whisper 的 C/C++ 高性能移植，支持端侧与多硬件加速
zh.what: whisper.cpp 是 OpenAI Whisper 自动语音识别（ASR）模型的纯 C/C++ 实现，专注于高性能推理与零依赖部署。它支持从移动端到服务器的全场景运行，可在本地完成语音转文字而无需联网。
zh.content: 仓库核心仅包含 whisper.h 与 whisper.cpp，其余依赖 ggml 机器学习库；提供面向 iOS、Android、WebAssembly、Java 等平台的示例与绑定，以及 Docker 镜像和 C 风格 API。
zh.stack: 基于纯 C/C++ 与 ggml 张量库，无外部依赖；通过 ARM NEON、Metal、Core ML、Vulkan、CUDA、ROCm 等后端实现跨平台硬件加速，并支持 INT8/INT4 量化。
zh.hot: 凭借 51.8k Stars 和本周 238 新增热度，whisper.cpp 以极致轻量化和「苹果芯片优先」策略成为端侧 AI 语音标杆，几乎覆盖了从手机到 NPU 的所有推理场景。
uses: 移动端开发者 —— 需在 iOS/Android 实现离线语音输入与实时字幕
嵌入式与 IoT 工程师 —— 在树莓派等低功耗设备上部署无网 ASR
跨平台桌面应用开发者 —— 通过 C API 或 WebAssembly 集成转写功能
AI 基础设施团队 —— 构建支持多硬件（NVIDIA/AMD/昇腾）的后端推理服务

en.tag: C/C++ Whisper port optimized for edge & multi-hardware inference
en.what: whisper.cpp is a pure C/C++ implementation of OpenAI's Whisper ASR model, optimized for high-performance inference and zero-dependency deployment. It enables on-device speech-to-text across the full spectrum from mobile to server, all without requiring a network connection.
en.content: The repo centers on whisper.h and whisper.cpp, leveraging the ggml library for ML primitives; it ships with platform examples and bindings for iOS, Android, WebAssembly, Java, plus Docker images and a C-style API.
en.stack: Built on pure C/C++ and the ggml tensor library with zero external dependencies; it accelerates inference across hardware via ARM NEON, Metal, Core ML, Vulkan, CUDA, and ROCm, with support for INT8/INT4 quantization.
en.hot: With 51.8k stars and 238 new stars this week, whisper.cpp has become the go-to edge-AI voice benchmark by pairing extreme lightweight design with an Apple Silicon-first strategy, covering nearly every inference scenario from phones to NPUs.
uses: Mobile developers needing offline speech input and real-time captions on iOS/Android.
Embedded and IoT engineers deploying network-free ASR on Raspberry Pi and low-power devices.
Cross-platform desktop developers integrating transcription via C API or WebAssembly.
AI infrastructure teams building backend inference services across NVIDIA, AMD, and Ascend hardware.

zh.tag: 跨语言高性能开源 RPC 框架与通信基础设施
zh.what: gRPC 是由 Google 开源的现代高性能远程过程调用（RPC）框架，旨在让客户端与服务端应用透明通信。它基于 HTTP/2 和 Protocol Buffers 构建，支持多种编程语言，简化了分布式连接系统的构建。
zh.content: 仓库包含基于 C++ 的核心运行时、多语言绑定（Python、Ruby、PHP、C#、Go、Java 等）以及丰富的示例代码。同时提供构建脚本、测试套件和每日更新的预编译包。
zh.stack: 核心基于 C++ 实现，依赖 Protocol Buffers 作为接口定义与序列化格式，通过 HTTP/2 传输。提供各语言原生 SDK，涵盖 Node.js、Go、Java、Dart、Kotlin 等主流生态。
zh.hot: 凭借 45.1K+ Star 的社区认可度与本周新增 158 Star 的持续热度，gRPC 已成为云原生时代服务间通信的事实标准。其多语言支持与卓越性能使其在微服务架构中广受欢迎，稳居 C++ 周榜第 4。
uses: 后端开发者构建跨语言微服务与分布式系统
云原生架构师设计服务网格与容器化通信方案
基础平台团队打造高性能内部 API 与基础设施
多语言技术栈团队统一服务调用协议与接口规范

en.tag: Cross-language, high-performance open-source RPC framework
en.what: gRPC is a modern, high-performance open-source RPC framework by Google that enables transparent communication between client and server applications. Built on HTTP/2 and Protocol Buffers, it supports multiple languages and simplifies building distributed connected systems.
en.content: The repository contains the C++-based core runtime, multi-language bindings (Python, Ruby, PHP, C#, Go, Java, etc.), and extensive examples. It also includes build scripts, test suites, and daily precompiled packages.
en.stack: The core is implemented in C++, relying on Protocol Buffers for IDL and serialization over HTTP/2. It offers native SDKs for major ecosystems including Node.js, Go, Java, Dart, and Kotlin.
en.hot: With 45.1K+ stars and 158 new stars this week, gRPC has become the de facto standard for service-to-service communication in the cloud-native era. Its multi-language support and outstanding performance make it widely adopted in microservices, ranking 4th on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: Backend developers building cross-language microservices and distributed systems
Cloud-native architects designing service mesh and containerized communication
Platform teams building high-performance internal APIs and infrastructure
Polyglot teams standardizing service call protocols and interface specifications

zh.tag: 低延迟语音 AI 工具包，构建实时语音代理
zh.what: Moonshine Voice 是一个开源 AI 工具包，用于构建实时语音代理和界面。它提供语音转文本、意图识别和文本转语音功能，所有处理均在设备端完成，确保低延迟和隐私保护。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库、预训练模型、跨平台示例应用（iOS、Android、macOS、Windows、Raspberry Pi 等）以及微控制器部署支持。提供高级 API 用于转录、TTS、语音克隆、说话人识别和对话代理。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 C++，支持 Python、iOS、Android、macOS、Linux、Windows 等多平台。模型基于 PyTorch 训练，推理使用 ONNX Runtime 或自定义引擎。
zh.hot: 凭借极低延迟（优于 Whisper）和完全本地运行的特点，吸引了近万 Star，今日新增 282，适合隐私敏感和实时场景。
uses: 语音助手开发者 —— 快速集成低延迟 STT/TTS 到应用中
边缘设备开发者 —— 在 Raspberry Pi、微控制器上部署语音 AI
隐私敏感场景 —— 医疗、金融等需要本地处理的语音应用
多语言语音应用 —— 支持中英西日韩等多语种 STT 和 TTS

en.tag: Low-latency speech AI toolkit for building real-time voice agents
en.what: Moonshine Voice is an open-source AI toolkit for building real-time voice agents and interfaces. It offers speech-to-text, intent recognition, and text-to-speech, all running on-device for low latency and privacy.
en.content: The repo includes the core library, pre-trained models, cross-platform example apps (iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Raspberry Pi, etc.), and microcontroller deployment support. High-level APIs for transcription, TTS, voice cloning, speaker diarization, and conversational agents.
en.stack: Primarily C++, with bindings for Python, iOS, Android, macOS, Linux, Windows. Models trained with PyTorch, inference via ONNX Runtime or custom engine.
en.hot: With ultra-low latency (outperforming Whisper) and fully on-device processing, it has gained nearly 10K stars (+282 today), appealing to privacy-conscious and real-time applications.
uses: Voice assistant developers — integrate low-latency STT/TTS into apps
Edge device developers — deploy voice AI on Raspberry Pi, microcontrollers
Privacy-sensitive scenarios — medical, finance requiring on-device processing
Multilingual voice apps — STT/TTS supporting English, Chinese, Spanish, Japanese, etc.

zh.tag: Google 边缘端 ML/GenAI 高性能推理运行时
zh.what: LiteRT 是 TensorFlow Lite 的继任者，提供在边缘设备上部署机器学习与生成式 AI 的高性能运行时。它支持 GPU/NPU 加速，并集成了 LLM 推理、Web 推理、C++ 张量操作和 CLI 工具链。
zh.content: 仓库包含 LiteRT 运行时核心、构建状态徽章、文档链接以及多个子项目（LiteRT-LM、LiteRT.js、Tensor API、LiteRT CLI）的入口。

浏览器中通过 WebGPU/WASM 运行客户端 AI
AI 编码代理工作流加速（通过 LiteRT CLI）
边缘端 LLM 部署（通过 LiteRT-LM）

en.tag: Google's on-device runtime for high-performance ML & GenAI deployment on edge platforms
en.what: LiteRT, the successor to TensorFlow Lite, is Google's on-device runtime for deploying ML and GenAI on edge platforms with high performance. It features GPU/NPU acceleration, LLM inference, Web inference via WebGPU/WASM, C++ tensor API, and a CLI toolkit.

Running client-side AI in browsers via WebGPU/WASM
Accelerating AI coding agent workflows via LiteRT CLI
On-device LLM deployment via LiteRT-LM

zh.tag: vLLM 昇腾 NPU 社区插件，让大模型推理原生支持国产算力
zh.what: 这是 vLLM 推理引擎的社区维护硬件插件，旨在让主流大模型能够高效运行在华为昇腾（Ascend）NPU 上；它为国产 AI 算力提供了与 CUDA 生态对标的高性能推理方案，降低异构迁移成本。
zh.content: 仓库包含昇腾定制的算子实现、Attention 与采样后端加速模块、vLLM 版本兼容层，以及完整的构建脚本与中文/英文文档。
zh.stack: 核心模块以 C++ 编写并绑定 Python，底层调用华为 CANN 计算架构与 PyTorch 昇腾后端，通过 vLLM 的硬件插件接口完成对接。
zh.hot: 在国产算力替代与自主可控需求推动下，该插件补全了 vLLM 在昇腾生态的关键一环；仓库已获 2,431 Star，本周新增 52 星并跻身 GitHub C++ Trending 第 13 位，关注度持续走高。
uses: 昇腾 NPU 集群用户 —— 希望在华为 910B/310P 等硬件上无缝运行 vLLM 推理服务的工程团队。
国产算力平台构建者 —— 需要基于自主可控芯片搭建大模型推理底座的云厂商与科研机构。
异构适配开发者 —— 从事 AI 推理引擎后端移植、算子优化与硬件插件集成的系统工程师。

en.tag: Community plugin for running vLLM inference natively on Huawei Ascend NPUs
en.what: This community-maintained hardware plugin enables the vLLM inference engine to run efficiently on Huawei Ascend NPUs. It provides a high-performance serving solution for domestic AI hardware, reducing the migration cost from CUDA-centric ecosystems.
en.content: The repository houses Ascend-customized operators, attention and sampling acceleration backends, vLLM compatibility layers, plus build scripts and bilingual documentation.
en.stack: Core modules are written in C++ with Python bindings, calling Huawei's CANN stack and PyTorch Ascend backend underneath, and interfacing with vLLM through its hardware plugin API.
en.hot: Driven by demand for domestic hardware independence, the plugin fills a critical gap for vLLM on Ascend; having earned 2,431 stars with 52 added this week and a spot at #13 on GitHub's C++ Trending, it is gaining significant traction.
uses: Ascend NPU cluster users — Engineering teams seeking to run vLLM inference natively on Huawei 910B/310P hardware.
Domestic AI platform builders — Cloud providers and research institutes building LLM serving stacks on homegrown chips.
Heterogeneous adaptation developers — Systems engineers working on backend porting, operator optimization, and hardware plugin integration for inference engines.

zh.tag: 微软官方 Windows 终端与命令行宿主开源仓库
zh.what: 这是微软官方维护的 Windows Terminal 和 Windows 控制台主机的源代码仓库。它包含了 Windows Terminal、Windows Terminal Preview 以及 conhost.exe 的实现，并共享组件和示例项目。

en.tag: Microsoft's official open-source repo for Windows Terminal and console host
en.what: This is Microsoft's official source repository for Windows Terminal and the Windows console host. It contains the implementation of Windows Terminal, Windows Terminal Preview, and conhost.exe, along with shared components and sample projects.
en.content: The repo contains the full source code for Windows Terminal and the Windows console host, along with tools like ColorTool and sample projects demonstrating how to consume the Windows Console APIs.

Developers: learn Microsoft's large-scale C++ architecture and Windows console implementation
Contributors: submit code, fix issues, or improve terminal features

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 原生单元测试与微基准框架，支持 TDD/BDD
zh.what: Catch2 是一个专为 C++ 设计的现代单元测试框架，同时提供微基准测试与基础 BDD 宏支持。它让测试代码看起来像普通 C++ 布尔表达式，无需繁琐的宏定义即可自然编写测试用例。
zh.content: 仓库包含多头文件库源码、CMake 构建配置、CI 工作流及详尽文档；v3 版本从单头文件重构为常规多文件库，提供独立的 benchmark 模块与测试宏集合。
zh.stack: 核心基于现代 C++（C++14/17/20 为主），使用 CMake 构建，支持 Linux、macOS、Windows 多平台 CI，并提供 Godbolt 在线体验。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 生态最流行的测试框架之一，Catch2 已积累超 21k Star，本周新增 769 星并跻身 GitHub C++ 周榜第 7 名，反映出 C++ 社区对简洁、现代测试工具的旺盛需求。
uses: C++ 开发者 —— 需要为项目快速引入单元测试与回归测试
TDD/BDD 实践者 —— 想用接近自然语言的断言和场景描述写测试
性能工程师 —— 需要集成微基准测试以追踪代码性能回归
开源库维护者 —— 寻求跨平台、 header-only（v2）或现代库形态（v3）的测试方案

en.tag: Modern C++-native unit-testing & micro-benchmarking framework for TDD/BDD
en.what: Catch2 is a modern, C++-native unit testing framework that also offers micro-benchmarking capabilities and basic BDD macros. It lets you write tests using natural C++ boolean expressions without cumbersome macro boilerplate.
en.content: The repository houses a multi-header library source, CMake build configs, CI workflows, and extensive docs. Starting with v3, it was restructured from a single-header library into a normal multi-file library with a dedicated benchmark module and test macro suite.
en.stack: Built on modern C++ (primarily C++14/17/20), uses CMake, supports cross-platform CI on Linux, macOS, and Windows, and offers Godbolt online playground integration.
en.hot: One of the most popular C++ testing frameworks with over 21k stars, Catch2 gained 769 stars this week and hit #7 on the GitHub C++ Trending list, signaling strong demand for lightweight, modern C++ testing tools.
uses: C++ developers looking to quickly integrate unit and regression tests
TDD/BDD practitioners who want natural-language-like assertions and scenario descriptions
Performance engineers needing built-in micro-benchmarking to track code regressions
Open-source maintainers seeking cross-platform testing in header-only (v2) or modern library (v3) form

zh.tag: GTA 5 增强版的开源作弊菜单 DLL
zh.what: 《GTA 5: Enhanced》的实验性修改菜单（mod menu）：编译成 DLL 后用 Xenos 等注入器在游戏主菜单注入，按 INSERT 或 Ctrl+\ 呼出菜单。建议配合 FSL 把存档数据重定向到本地磁盘以保号，且需要关闭 BattlEye 反作弊（目前没有 BE 绕过，公共战局会被心跳检测踢出）。
