zh.stack: C++，DLL 注入式单机/联机修改器，依赖外部注入器和 FSL，GPL-2.0；默认分支 enhanced。
zh.hot: 它面向 GTA5 增强版 Mod 社区的具体需求，并延续 YimMenu 项目路线，为需要开源菜单的用户提供选择。
uses: GTA5 单机玩家 —— 刷车刷钱体验全部游戏内容
mod 开发者 —— 基于源码学习或二次开发游戏菜单
离线娱乐 —— 关 BattlEye 后在私人战局整活

en.tag: The open-source mod menu DLL for GTA 5: Enhanced
en.what: An experimental mod menu for GTA 5: Enhanced: compile to a DLL, inject at the main menu with an injector like Xenos, then press INSERT or Ctrl+\ to open. Pairing with FSL (redirecting save data to local disk) is recommended to protect your account, and BattlEye anti-cheat must be disabled (there's no BE bypass — public sessions will kick you via heartbeat checks).
en.content: C++ source plus a short README covering the workflow (FSL → nightly release → injector → disable BattlEye → inject) and fixes for common issues (disconnects, missing saves, game won't launch).
en.stack: C++, a DLL-injection single/multiplayer mod menu relying on external injectors and FSL; GPL-2.0; default branch enhanced.
en.hot: It targets a concrete need in the GTA5 Enhanced modding community and continues the familiar YimMenu project line for users seeking an open menu.
uses: GTA5 single-player fans — unlock vehicles and cash to experience all content
mod developers — learn from or fork the source for custom game menus
Offline fun — mess around in private sessions with BattlEye off

zh.tag: Google 跨语言结构化数据序列化标准
zh.what: Protocol Buffers 是 Google 开发的语言中立、平台中立、可扩展的结构化数据序列化机制，用于高效编码和交换数据。它通过 .proto 文件定义数据结构，并生成多种语言的代码，广泛应用于 RPC 系统和数据存储。
zh.content: 仓库包含 protobuf 的完整源码，包括 C++ 实现的编译器（protoc）、运行时库、多种语言的生成代码（如 Java、Python、Go 等），以及构建系统（Bazel、CMake）和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持多种语言绑定，依赖 Bazel、CMake 等构建工具，并集成 OpenSSF 安全评分。
zh.hot: 作为数据序列化的行业标准，protobuf 在微服务和分布式系统中被广泛采用，本月新增 302 星，持续保持高热度。
uses: 后端开发者：用于定义 API 请求/响应结构，生成高效序列化代码
微服务架构团队：作为 gRPC 等 RPC 框架的数据交换格式
数据工程师：用于大数据管道中的结构化数据编码和存储

en.tag: Google's language-neutral structured data serialization standard
en.what: Protocol Buffers is Google's language-neutral, platform-neutral, extensible mechanism for serializing structured data. It defines data structures in .proto files and generates code in multiple languages, widely used in RPC systems and data storage.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of protobuf, including the C++-based compiler (protoc), runtime libraries, code generators for multiple languages (Java, Python, Go, etc.), build systems (Bazel, CMake), and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, supports multiple language bindings, relies on build tools like Bazel and CMake, and integrates OpenSSF security scorecard.
en.hot: As an industry standard for data serialization, protobuf is widely adopted in microservices and distributed systems, gaining 302 stars this month and maintaining high popularity.
uses: Backend developers: define API request/response structures and generate efficient serialization code
Microservices teams: use as data interchange format for RPC frameworks like gRPC
Data engineers: encode and store structured data in big data pipelines

zh.tag: 极速 C++ 日志库，支持头文件-only与编译双模式
zh.what: spdlog 是一款高性能 C++ 日志库，支持头文件-only和编译两种集成方式。它提供丰富的日志输出目标、异步/同步模式、运行时与编译时日志级别过滤，以及基于 fmt 的现代化格式化语法。
zh.content: 仓库包含头文件目录、CMake 构建脚本、多平台 CI 配置、示例代码及基准测试；用户可直接拷贝 include 文件夹以头文件方式使用，或通过 CMake 编译为静态/动态库。
zh.stack: 核心为现代 C++11/14 实现，格式化层依赖 fmt 库；支持通过 CMake 构建，并覆盖 Linux、Windows、macOS、Android 等主流平台。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 生态最广泛采用的日志方案之一，spdlog 凭借极致性能与零成本抽象累积近 3 万 Star；本月新增 141 Star 并登 Trending 月榜第 16，足见其在高性能后端与嵌入式场景的持续热度。
uses: 高性能 C++ 后端服务开发者 —— 需要纳秒级延迟的同步或异步日志记录
跨平台桌面与嵌入式应用团队 —— 寻求覆盖 Windows、Linux、macOS 及 Android 的统一日志方案
游戏引擎与中间件开发者 —— 追求头文件-only快速集成或编译库以缩短构建时间
DevOps 与系统工具开发者 —— 需要日志轮转、syslog、环境变量级别控制等生产级特性

en.tag: Blazing-fast C++ logging library with header-only & compiled modes
en.what: spdlog is a high-performance C++ logging library offering both header-only and compiled integration modes. It supports multiple sinks, asynchronous/sync logging, runtime and compile-time level filtering, and modern formatting powered by the fmt library.
en.content: The repo provides header-only sources, CMake build scripts, cross-platform CI configs, usage examples, and benchmarks. Users can either copy the include folder for header-only use or build a static/shared library via CMake.
en.stack: Built on modern C++11/14, it relies on the fmt library for formatting and uses CMake for building, supporting Linux, Windows, macOS, Android, and more.
en.hot: As one of the most widely adopted C++ logging solutions, spdlog has amassed nearly 30k stars thanks to its extreme performance and zero-cost abstractions; gaining 141 stars this month and ranking 16th on the Trending monthly chart reflects its enduring popularity in high-performance backends and embedded systems.
uses: High-performance C++ backend engineers — needing nanosecond-scale sync or async logging
Cross-platform desktop and embedded teams — seeking a unified logging solution across Windows, Linux, macOS, and Android
Game engine and middleware developers — pursuing header-only quick integration or compiled libraries for faster build times
DevOps and systems tool builders — requiring production-grade features like log rotation, syslog, and environment-level controls

zh.tag: 跨平台 PlayStation 4 模拟器，已可运行 Bloodborne 等独占大作
zh.what: shadPS4 是一款使用 C++ 编写的早期 PlayStation 4 模拟器，支持在 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 上运行 PS4 游戏。目前它已能成功启动并运行《血源诅咒》《如龙0》等热门独占作品，尽管仍处于开发初期，尚未达到完美体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含模拟器核心源码、图形/音频后端、指令翻译模块及系统服务实现，同时提供文档、兼容性列表与截图。用户可搭配独立的 QtLauncher 获得完整的图形界面体验。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 开发，利用 Vulkan 等图形 API 实现 GPU 指令转译与渲染，跨平台兼容 Windows、Linux 与 macOS。
zh.hot: 凭借已能运行《血源诅咒》等 PS4 独占 3A 大作的突破性进展，该项目吸引了大量玩家与开发者关注，本周新增 332 Star 并累积至 32K+，跻身 GitHub C++ 周榜第 16 名。
uses: 硬核主机玩家 —— 想在 PC 或 Mac 上体验 PS4 独占大作。
模拟器开发者 —— 研究 PS4 系统架构、图形渲染与指令转译技术。
开源贡献者 —— 参与兼容性测试、漏洞修复与性能优化。
游戏研究者 —— 分析 PS4 游戏运行原理与系统调用实现。

en.tag: Cross-platform PS4 emulator already running exclusives like Bloodborne
en.what: shadPS4 is an early-stage PlayStation 4 emulator written in C++, enabling users to run PS4 titles on Windows, Linux, and macOS. It can already boot and play popular exclusives such as Bloodborne and Yakuza 0, though it remains a work in progress with known issues.
en.content: The repository houses the emulator core, graphics/audio backends, instruction translation modules, and system service implementations, along with documentation, compatibility lists, and screenshots. Users can pair it with the separate QtLauncher for a full GUI experience.
en.stack: Built primarily in C++, it leverages Vulkan and other graphics APIs to translate and render GPU instructions, with cross-platform support for Windows, Linux, and macOS.
en.hot: Its breakthrough ability to run PS4 exclusives like Bloodborne has drawn massive attention from gamers and developers, earning 332 new stars this week for a total of 32K+ and placing it 16th on GitHub's C++ Trending chart.
uses: Hardcore console gamers who want to play PS4 exclusives on PC or Mac.
Emulator developers studying PS4 system architecture, graphics rendering, and instruction translation.
Open-source contributors helping with compatibility testing, bug fixes, and performance optimization.
Game researchers analyzing PS4 game execution principles and system call implementations.

zh.tag: C++即时模式GUI库，轻量无依赖，专为工具与调试界面而生
zh.what: Dear ImGui 是一个无冗余、自包含的 C++ 即时模式图形用户界面库，专注于为开发者提供内容创作与调试工具的快速迭代能力。它输出优化后的顶点缓冲区，可无缝集成到现有 3D 渲染管线中，无需外部依赖。与传统保留模式 UI 不同，它更适合构建高性能的内部工具、可视化面板和调试窗口。
zh.content: 仓库以核心头文件与单文件源码（imgui.h / imgui.cpp）为主体，并附带大量官方渲染后端与平台绑定（DirectX、OpenGL、Vulkan、Metal、GLFW、SDL、Win32 等）。同时提供开箱即用的示例程序、综合 Demo 窗口、文档 Wiki，以及独立的 imgui_test_engine 测试引擎。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 编写，自包含且无任何外部依赖；通过可插拔后端接入 DirectX、OpenGL、Vulkan、Metal、WebGPU 等现代图形 API，并可绑定至 GLFW、SDL、Win32 等窗口系统。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 生态中事实标准的工具型 UI 方案，Dear ImGui 已积累 74.7K Stars，本月新增 338 星并位列 Trending 月榜第 13。它几乎被所有主流游戏引擎和 3D 工具链采用，填补了高性能即时调试界面的长期空白。
uses: 游戏/图形引擎开发者 —— 为自研引擎快速搭建关卡编辑器、材质调试与性能分析面板
实时可视化与监控工具 —— 构建机器人、量化交易、嵌入式系统的实时数据看板
桌面工具软件作者 —— 为 C++ 桌面程序创建轻量、可移植的 ImGui 原生界面
算法与科研调试 —— 在图形/仿真/AI 训练过程中快速可视化参数与中间状态

en.tag: Bloat-free immediate-mode GUI library for C++ with minimal dependencies
en.what: Dear ImGui is a bloat-free, self-contained immediate-mode GUI library for C++ that empowers developers to build content creation and debugging tools with rapid iteration. It outputs optimized vertex buffers that can be rendered directly into any 3D pipeline, requiring zero external dependencies. Unlike retained-mode UI libraries, it is purpose-built for high-performance internal tools, visualizers, and debug windows.
en.content: The repository centers on core single-file headers (imgui.h / imgui.cpp) and ships with official renderer backends and platform bindings (DirectX, OpenGL, Vulkan, Metal, GLFW, SDL, Win32, etc.). It also includes ready-to-run examples, a comprehensive demo window, extensive documentation, and a separate imgui_test_engine for automated testing.
en.stack: Written in pure C++ with zero external dependencies; integrates with modern graphics APIs via swappable backends for DirectX, OpenGL, Vulkan, Metal, and WebGPU, alongside platform bindings for GLFW, SDL, and Win32.
en.hot: With 74.7K Stars and 338 new stars this month (ranking 13th on the monthly GitHub Trending), Dear ImGui is the de-facto standard for tooling UIs in C++. It is adopted by virtually every major game engine and 3D toolchain, filling a long-standing gap for high-performance immediate-mode debugging interfaces.
uses: Game/graphics engine developers — rapidly build level editors, material debuggers, and profiling dashboards for custom engines
Real-time visualization & monitoring — create live data dashboards for robotics, quant trading, and embedded systems
Desktop tool builders — craft lightweight, portable native UIs for C++ applications without heavy framework overhead
Algorithm & research debugging — visualize parameters and intermediate states during graphics, simulation, or AI training runs

zh.tag: 开源跨平台 2D CAD 绘图工具
zh.what: LibreCAD 是一款基于 QCAD 社区版开发的免费 2D CAD 绘图软件，支持读取 DXF/DWG 格式，导出 DXF/DWG/PDF/SVG。它提供点、线、圆、椭圆、抛物线、双曲线、样条曲线等基本图元，并支持高度可定制的 GUI 和 30 多种语言翻译。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 LibreCAD 源代码，基于 Qt 框架和 libdxfrw 库实现 DXF/DWG 读写，并集成了 shapelib 用于 ESRI Shapefile 导入。提供预编译的稳定版和每日构建版，以及命令行工具用于 DXF 到 PDF/PNG/SVG 的转换。
zh.stack: 技术栈：C++、Qt（跨平台 GUI 框架）、libdxfrw（DXF/DWG 读写库）、shapelib（Shapefile 导入）。支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 多平台。
zh.hot: 本月新增 226 星，位列 C++ 月榜第 23 名。作为成熟的免费 CAD 替代方案，持续维护和更新（如 Qt6 支持）吸引了大量用户和贡献者。
uses: 工程师和设计师 —— 用于 2D 工程制图、建筑设计草图
教育领域 —— 作为免费 CAD 教学工具，降低学习成本
DIY 爱好者 —— 制作激光切割、CNC 加工图纸
企业用户 —— 替代昂贵的商业 CAD 软件进行基础绘图

en.tag: Open-source cross-platform 2D CAD drawing tool
en.what: LibreCAD is a free 2D CAD drawing tool based on the community edition of QCAD. It can read DXF/DWG files and export to DXF/DWG/PDF/SVG. It supports primitives like points, lines, circles, ellipses, parabolas, hyperbolas, and splines, with a highly customizable GUI and translations in over 30 languages.
en.content: The repository contains the full LibreCAD source code, built on Qt framework and libdxfrw for DXF/DWG read/write, with shapelib integration for ESRI Shapefile import. It provides precompiled stable and daily builds, plus command-line tools for DXF to PDF/PNG/SVG conversion.
en.stack: Tech stack: C++, Qt (cross-platform GUI framework), libdxfrw (DXF/DWG read/write), shapelib (Shapefile import). Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: Gained 226 stars this month, ranking 23rd in C++ monthly trending. As a mature free CAD alternative, continuous maintenance and updates (e.g., Qt6 support) attract many users and contributors.
uses: Engineers and designers — for 2D engineering drawings and architectural sketches
Education — as a free CAD teaching tool to reduce learning costs
DIY enthusiasts — creating laser cutting and CNC machining plans
Enterprise users — replacing expensive commercial CAD for basic drafting

zh.tag: NASA 开源飞行软件框架，组件驱动快速开发
zh.what: F´ 是一个组件驱动的飞行软件框架，用于快速开发和部署航天及嵌入式软件应用。它由 NASA 喷气推进实验室开发，已在多个太空任务中成功部署，特别适合 CubeSats、SmallSats 等小型航天系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 框架核心（消息队列、线程等）、建模工具（自动生成代码）、可复用组件库、单元与集成测试工具，以及详细的用户手册和教程。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 Python 3.10+（用于工具链）、Clang 或 GCC 编译器，支持 Linux、Windows (WSL) 和 macOS。
zh.hot: 作为 NASA 官方开源项目，F´ 在航天软件领域具有权威性，本月新增 488 星，总星数达 11633，反映出开发者对航天级嵌入式框架的浓厚兴趣。
uses: 航天器飞行软件开发者，尤其是 CubeSat/SmallSat 项目
嵌入式系统工程师，希望使用组件化架构快速原型
学术研究者，用于教学或航天软件架构研究
对 NASA 技术栈感兴趣的爱好者，探索开源航天工具

en.tag: NASA's open-source flight software framework for rapid embedded development
en.what: F´ is a component-driven flight software framework enabling rapid development and deployment of spaceflight and embedded software applications. Developed by NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, it has been deployed on several space missions and is tailored for small-scale systems like CubeSats and SmallSats.
en.content: The repository includes the C++ framework core (message queues, threads), modeling tools for automatic code generation, a growing library of ready-to-use components, testing tools for unit and integration levels, plus comprehensive user manuals and tutorials.
en.stack: Primarily C++, with tooling in Python 3.10+, requiring Clang or GCC compilers, and supporting Linux, Windows (WSL), and macOS.
en.hot: As an official NASA open-source project, F´ holds authority in spaceflight software; with 488 new stars this month and 11,633 total, it reflects strong developer interest in aerospace-grade embedded frameworks.
uses: Spacecraft flight software developers, especially for CubeSat/SmallSat missions
Embedded systems engineers seeking component-based rapid prototyping
Academic researchers for teaching or studying aerospace software architecture
Enthusiasts interested in NASA's tech stack exploring open-source space tools

zh.tag: 自建 VPN 的开源客户端，支持多协议与混淆
zh.what: Amnezia VPN 是一个开源 VPN 客户端，允许用户在自己的服务器上轻松部署 VPN 服务。它支持多种经典协议（如 OpenVPN、WireGuard、IKEv2）以及带流量混淆的协议（如 Cloak、Shadowsocks、AmneziaWG、XRay），并提供分流功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面端和移动端的客户端代码，提供安装脚本、文档和界面资源。主要目录包括客户端应用、协议实现、以及用于服务器部署的 Docker 配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，跨平台支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android 和 iOS。依赖 Qt 框架、OpenSSL、以及各 VPN 协议库（如 WireGuard、OpenVPN）。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1606 星，总星数达 1.4 万+，因其自建 VPN 的易用性和强大的混淆功能而受到关注，尤其适合网络受限地区的用户。
uses: 需要自建 VPN 的个人用户，希望快速部署并连接自己的服务器。
在严格网络环境下需要绕过封锁的用户，利用混淆协议隐藏流量特征。
开发者和技术爱好者，希望定制或贡献 VPN 客户端代码。
企业或组织需要内部安全远程访问，可基于此客户端搭建专属 VPN。

en.tag: Open-source VPN client for self-hosted servers with multi-protocol & obfuscation
en.what: Amnezia VPN is an open-source VPN client that lets users easily deploy VPN servers on their own machines. It supports classic protocols like OpenVPN, WireGuard, IKEv2, and obfuscated protocols such as Cloak, Shadowsocks, AmneziaWG, and XRay, plus split tunneling.
en.content: The repo contains client code for desktop and mobile, with installation scripts, docs, and UI assets. Key directories include client apps, protocol implementations, and Docker configs for server deployment.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, cross-platform for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS. Uses Qt framework, OpenSSL, and VPN protocol libraries like WireGuard and OpenVPN.
en.hot: Gained 1,606 stars this month, reaching 14k+ total, due to its ease of self-hosting VPN and robust obfuscation features, appealing to users in restricted regions.
uses: Individuals wanting to self-host VPN and quickly deploy on their own servers.
Users in censored networks needing to bypass blocks with obfuscation protocols.
Developers and tinkerers looking to customize or contribute to VPN client code.
Organizations requiring secure remote access, can build custom VPN on this client.

zh.tag: 开源一体化产品数据平台：分析、回放、实验、LLM 观测全包
zh.what: 知名开源产品数据平台：产品分析、Web 分析、session 回放、feature flag、A/B 实验、错误追踪、日志、问卷、数据仓库、CDP、LLM 可观测性全部集成在一个系统。最新定位「构建自驱动产品（self-driving products）」：把错误、rage click 等产品信号自动转成分析报告和 PR 供你 review 合并，可从 Slack、Web、桌面端或 MCP 操作，支持 Docker 自托管。
zh.content: 超大型 monorepo：posthog/（Django 后端）、frontend/、products/（各产品线）、rust/、services/、ee/（企业版，单独授权），大量 docker-compose 部署文件与全平台 SDK。
zh.stack: Python/Django + TypeScript/React + Rust 服务，底层 ClickHouse；MIT（ee/ 目录除外）。
zh.hot: 它把完整的产品分析套件与面向 Agent 的自动化能力结合，既有成熟开发者用户，也有清晰的新使用场景。
uses: 产品团队 —— 一个平台替代 GA + 回放 + 实验工具的组合订阅
注重数据合规的公司 —— 自托管部署，用户数据不出机房
AI 产品团队 —— 用 LLM 可观测性追踪自家 agent 的成本与质量

en.tag: The open-source all-in-one product data platform
en.what: The well-known open-source product data platform: product analytics, web analytics, session replay, feature flags, A/B experiments, error tracking, logs, surveys, a data warehouse, CDP pipelines and LLM observability in one system. Its latest positioning is 'self-driving products': product signals like errors and rage clicks are automatically turned into analysis reports and PRs for you to review and merge — operable from Slack, web, desktop or MCP, and self-hostable via Docker.
en.content: A huge monorepo: posthog/ (Django backend), frontend/, products/ (each product line), rust/, services/, ee/ (enterprise code, separately licensed), lots of docker-compose files and SDKs for every platform.
en.stack: Python/Django + TypeScript/React + Rust services over ClickHouse; MIT (except ee/).
en.hot: The project combines a broad product-analytics suite with an agent-facing automation narrative, giving an established developer audience a clear reason to revisit it.
uses: Product teams — replace the GA + replay + experimentation stack with one platform
Compliance-sensitive companies — self-host so user data never leaves your infra
AI product teams — track your agents' cost and quality with LLM observability

zh.tag: 1-bit/三值超压缩大模型 Bonsai 的本地运行 demo
zh.what: PrismML 的 Bonsai 系列语言模型官方演示仓库，主打极致量化：1-bit 版每权重约 1.125 bit，27B 模型能塞进现代 iPhone；三值（Ternary）版约 1.7 bit，是质量更高的默认选项。最新 27B 是视觉语言模型，支持看图、tool calling、MCP、256k+ 长上下文和推理努力度调节。
zh.content: 纯 Shell 脚本工程：setup.sh / setup.ps1 一键装依赖下模型，scripts/ 放运行和下载脚本，另有三份白皮书 PDF、AGENTS.md（写给 AI agent 看的配置指南）、VISION/TOOLS 等专题文档与社区 benchmark。
zh.stack: Shell + llama.cpp 服务端，模型托管在 HuggingFace；支持 Mac Metal、CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm 和纯 CPU，Apache-2.0。
zh.hot: 视觉语言模型与 iPhone 端侧演示把技术卖点变得直观，配套脚本也降低了上手与复现实验的门槛。
uses: 手机 / 边缘设备开发者 —— 在 iPhone 上离线跑 27B 视觉语言模型
隐私敏感场景 —— 医疗、法律等数据不出本地的本地 AI 助手
硬件玩家 —— 在树莓派等低功耗设备上体验大模型

en.tag: Local-run demo of Bonsai, the 1-bit / ternary ultra-compressed LLMs
en.what: The official demo repo for PrismML's Bonsai model family, built around extreme quantization: the 1-bit version uses ~1.125 bits per weight so a 27B model fits a modern iPhone; the ternary version (~1.7 bits) is the higher-quality default. The newest 27B is a vision-language model with image input, tool calling, MCP, 256k+ context and adjustable reasoning effort.
en.content: A pure Shell project: setup.sh / setup.ps1 one-liners install dependencies and pull models, scripts/ holds run/download scripts, plus three whitepaper PDFs, an AGENTS.md (a config guide written for AI agents), topical docs (VISION/TOOLS/…) and community benchmarks.
en.stack: Shell + a llama.cpp server, models hosted on HuggingFace; runs on Mac Metal, CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm or plain CPU; Apache-2.0.
en.hot: The vision-language model and on-device iPhone demo make a technically ambitious claim concrete, while the included scripts reduce trial friction.
uses: Mobile / edge developers — run a 27B vision-language model offline on an iPhone
Privacy-sensitive settings — local AI assistants for medical or legal data that can't leave the device
Hardware tinkerers — run LLMs on low-power boards like a Raspberry Pi

zh.tag: 教你从零重写各种技术的教程大合集
zh.what: CodeCrafters 维护的著名教程索引仓库，理念是费曼那句「我不能创造的东西，我就不理解」。收录大量「从零重写某技术」的 step-by-step 教程链接，覆盖数据库、操作系统、Git、Docker、编程语言、神经网络、Web 浏览器等约 30 个类别。
zh.content: 主体是一个巨大的 README 列表，按「Build your own X」分类组织，每条标注所用编程语言和链接（如用 Python 写 LLM、用 C++ 写光线追踪）；无代码本体。
zh.stack: 纯 Markdown 文档；收录的教程本身横跨 C/C++/Python/Go/Rust 等各种语言。
zh.hot: 它用「亲手实现一遍」把抽象的计算机科学原理变成具体项目，学习路径清晰，因此长期具有传播力。
uses: 在校生 / 转行者 —— 按「造一遍」路线真正理解数据库、操作系统原理
资深工程师 —— 面试前用手写 Git / Docker 项目补底层功底
技术布道者 —— 按分类找写作和分享素材

en.tag: The giant collection of 'rebuild your favorite tech from scratch' tutorials
en.what: CodeCrafters' famous tutorial index, founded on Feynman's 'What I cannot create, I do not understand'. It collects step-by-step 'build your own X' tutorial links across ~30 categories: databases, operating systems, Git, Docker, programming languages, neural networks, web browsers and more.
en.content: Essentially one huge README list organized by 'Build your own X' categories, each entry tagged with its language and link (e.g. write an LLM in Python, a raytracer in C++); no code of its own.
en.stack: Pure Markdown; the tutorials themselves span C/C++/Python/Go/Rust and more.
en.hot: Its learn-by-building catalog remains useful because it turns abstract computer-science concepts into concrete implementation projects.
uses: Students & career switchers — truly understand databases and OS internals by building them
Senior engineers — shore up fundamentals before interviews by hand-rolling Git / Docker
Tech writers — find writing and talk material by category

zh.tag: 把 GitHub Copilot 智能体嵌进你自己应用的官方 SDK
zh.what: GitHub 官方出的多语言 SDK：在自己的应用或服务里直接调用 Copilot Agent 的能力。它暴露的是 Copilot CLI 背后同一套经过生产验证的 agent 运行时 —— 你不用自己搭编排层，定义好 agent 行为，规划、工具调用、文件编辑都交给 Copilot 处理。
zh.content: 单仓库 6 套 SDK，按目录分：nodejs/、python/、go/、dotnet/、java/、rust/，另有 docs/、test/ 和 cookbook 示例；各语言经 npm / PyPI / NuGet / Maven Central / crates.io 分发。
zh.stack: 多语言 monorepo（TS/Python/Go/.NET/Java/Rust 六个 SDK），MIT；2026 年 1 月创建，推送非常活跃。
zh.hot: 「Copilot agent 能力开放给第三方应用」的定位自带关注度，GitHub 官方背书。
uses: SaaS 厂商 —— 在产品里内嵌 Copilot 级 AI 助手（IDE、低代码平台等）
企业内部工具 —— 快速给内部系统加 agent 能力，不用自研编排
多语言团队 —— JS / Python / Go / .NET / Java / Rust 任选

en.tag: GitHub's official SDK for embedding the Copilot agent in your own apps
en.what: GitHub's official multi-language SDK: call the Copilot Agent's capabilities directly from your own apps and services. It exposes the same production-proven agent runtime behind the Copilot CLI — no need to build your own orchestration layer: define the agent's behavior and let Copilot handle planning, tool calls and file edits.
en.content: Six SDKs in one repo, by directory: nodejs/, python/, go/, dotnet/, java/, rust/, plus docs/, test/ and cookbook examples; distributed via npm / PyPI / NuGet / Maven Central / crates.io.
en.stack: A multi-language monorepo (TS/Python/Go/.NET/Java/Rust), MIT; created January 2026, committing very actively.
en.hot: 'Copilot agent capabilities opened to third-party apps' draws attention by itself — with GitHub's official stamp on it.
uses: SaaS vendors — embed Copilot-grade AI assistance into products (IDEs, low-code platforms)
Internal tooling — add agent capabilities to internal systems without building orchestration
Polyglot teams — pick from JS / Python / Go / .NET / Java / Rust

zh.tag: 你的「AI 团队总管」：把一堆 agent 组织起来 7×24 干活
zh.what: 定位「Chief Agent Operator」：把多个 AI agent 当工作单元统一招聘、调度和汇报。核心功能包括 Agent Builder（描述需求即可自动配置出可用 agent）、Agent Groups（多 agent 并行协作）、Pages/Schedule/Project/Workspace 协作面板，以及白盒可编辑的 Personal Memory；支持接入任意模型和模态，号称 10000+ skills 和 MCP 插件生态。
zh.content: 可自部署的 Web 应用（Vercel/Docker/Zeabur/Sealos 一键部署），仓库含完整中英文档、Changelog、插件体系和本地开发指南；默认分支 canary，今天仍在高频 push。
zh.stack: TypeScript + Next.js 系 Web 应用，Docker 自托管，插件走 MCP 协议；许可证为自定义（非标准）。
zh.hot: 多 Agent 调度与即时通信网关的组合，让这一成熟 AI 应用平台形成了明确的协作化方向。
uses: 一人公司 / 自由职业者 —— 组建 7×24 自动干活的 agent 团队处理重复工作
运营团队 —— 定时调度 agent 做日报、巡检、内容分发
进阶玩家 —— 用 Personal Memory 和 10000+ skills 定制专属助手

en.tag: Your 'Chief Agent Operator' — an AI team working 7×24
en.what: Positioned as a 'Chief Agent Operator': hire, schedule and hear reports from multiple AI agents as work units. Key features: Agent Builder (describe the need, get a configured agent), Agent Groups (parallel multi-agent collaboration), Pages/Schedule/Project/Workspace panels, and a white-box editable Personal Memory; any model and modality, with a claimed 10,000+ skills and MCP plugin ecosystem.
en.content: A self-deployable web app (one-click Vercel/Docker/Zeabur/Sealos), with full bilingual docs, a changelog, the plugin system and local dev guides; default branch canary, still pushing frequently today.
en.stack: TypeScript + Next.js, self-hosted via Docker, plugins over MCP; custom (non-standard) license.
en.hot: Its combination of multi-agent orchestration and messaging gateways gives an established AI application platform a clear collaboration-focused direction.
uses: Solo founders & freelancers — run a 7×24 agent team for repetitive work
Ops teams — schedule agents for daily reports, patrols and content distribution
Power users — craft custom assistants with Personal Memory and 10,000+ skills

zh.tag: 终端里的编程 agent，专为便宜小模型优化
zh.what: 跑在终端里的 AI 编程助手（OpenAI Codex 的 fork），核心思路「换 harness 不换模型」：内置 claude-code、kimi-cli、qwen-code、deepseek-tui 等多种 agent 运行框架，让低成本开源模型也打出好表现。自带 QA 技能，可驱动真实浏览器或原生 App 做界面测试，支持 macOS/Linux/Windows 原生沙箱执行。
zh.content: 完整 Rust 工程：终端 TUI、文档站（openinterpreter.com/docs）、安装脚本；配置与会话存本地 ~/.openinterpreter，支持 /model 切模型、/harness 切框架、MCP、hooks、AGENTS.md。
zh.stack: Rust（2023 年创建的老牌项目，刚从 Python 重写），Apache-2.0；支持 ACP 协议接入编辑器，可接多家模型 provider。
zh.hot: Rust 重写与「低成本模型运行框架」定位，正好契合开发者对更高效编程 Agent 基础设施的需求。
uses: 预算有限的开发者 —— 用 DeepSeek / Qwen 等便宜模型跑编程 agent，成本降一个量级
多工具用户 —— 一套终端切换 claude-code、kimi-cli 等不同框架
QA 团队 —— 让 agent 驱动真实浏览器做界面自动化测试

en.tag: A coding agent in your terminal, tuned for low-cost models
en.what: An AI coding assistant in your terminal (a fork of OpenAI Codex) built on the idea of 'swap the harness, not the model': it bundles multiple agent runtimes — claude-code, kimi-cli, qwen-code, deepseek-tui — so cheap open models still perform well. It ships a QA skill that drives real browsers or native apps for UI testing, with native sandboxing on macOS/Linux/Windows.
en.content: A full Rust project: the terminal TUI, a docs site (openinterpreter.com/docs) and install scripts; config and sessions live in ~/.openinterpreter, with /model to switch models, /harness to switch runtimes, plus MCP, hooks and AGENTS.md support.
en.stack: Rust (a 2023 veteran, freshly rewritten from Python), Apache-2.0; supports ACP (Agent Client Protocol) for editors and multiple model providers.
en.hot: The Rust rewrite and focus on serving as a harness for lower-cost models align with demand for efficient coding-agent infrastructure.
uses: Budget-conscious devs — run coding agents on cheap models like DeepSeek / Qwen, an order of magnitude cheaper
Multi-tool users — swap between claude-code, kimi-cli and other harnesses in one terminal
QA teams — let agents drive real browsers for UI automation testing
